zh.hot: 拥有超过 4.1 万星标，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的网络代理工具之一。其强大的功能和持续的更新吸引了大量用户，今日新增 24 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第五。
uses: 网络受限环境下的科学上网工具，适合个人用户突破防火墙。
开发者可基于其协议和代码构建自定义代理服务。
企业或组织可用于搭建安全的内部网络通道。
对隐私和安全性有高要求的用户，利用其加密特性保护通信。

en.tag: Network proxy core that penetrates everything, supporting multiple protocols and platforms.
en.what: Xray-core is the core network tool of Project X, based on the XTLS protocol, providing powerful proxy capabilities with support for VLESS, VMess, Trojan, and other protocols, including advanced features like REALITY. It aims to bypass network restrictions for secure and efficient communication.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, installation scripts (e.g., Xray-install), Docker image links, and sponsor/donation information. It also offers NFT collectibles and related discussion links.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, relying on the XTLS protocol, supporting multiple platforms (Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.), and deployable via Docker.
en.hot: With over 41k stars, it's one of the most popular network proxy tools on GitHub. Its powerful features and continuous updates attract many users, gaining 24 stars today and ranking 5th on the Go trending list.
uses: For individuals in restricted networks to bypass censorship and access the open internet.
Developers can build custom proxy services based on its protocols and code.
Enterprises or organizations can use it to establish secure internal network tunnels.
Users with high privacy and security needs can leverage its encryption features to protect communications.

zh.tag: 开源 IT 职位搜索引擎，直连公司官网
zh.what: freehire 是一个专为求职者设计的开源搜索引擎，直接从公司官方招聘页面（如 Workday、Greenhouse 等 ATS）抓取职位信息，提供超过 330 万个实时职位。它去除了招聘中介和重复信息，确保每个职位链接都有效，并支持按地区、工作形式、专业和资历进行筛选。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端爬虫与搜索服务、前端界面、文档（features/architecture）、API 接口，以及添加新职位来源的指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖各类 ATS 的抓取适配器，前端可能涉及 HTML/JS，部署在 freehire.me 上。
zh.hot: 今日新增 20 星，总星数 397，登上 GitHub Trending（Go 语言）日榜第 6 名。其“直连来源、无中介”的定位切中求职痛点，加上 330 万+职位数据，吸引了大量关注。
uses: IT 求职者：直接查看公司官网职位，避免虚假或过期信息
开发者：学习 Go 爬虫、数据去重和搜索系统实现
招聘平台研究者：分析职位数据聚合与规范化方法

en.tag: Open-source IT job search engine, pulling live postings straight from company career pages
en.what: freehire is an open-source search engine for job seekers that crawls job postings directly from company career pages (ATS like Workday, Greenhouse, etc.), offering 3.3M+ live listings. It eliminates recruiter reposts and dead links, normalizes and deduplicates postings, and supports faceted search by region, work format, specialization, and seniority.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based backend crawler and search service, a frontend interface, documentation (features/architecture), API endpoints, and guidelines for adding new job sources.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, with adapters for various ATS systems; frontend likely uses HTML/JS; deployed at freehire.me.
en.hot: Gained 20 stars today, total 397, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily. Its 'straight from the source, no middlemen' positioning hits a pain point for job seekers, and the 3.3M+ live postings attract significant attention.
uses: IT job seekers: browse company career pages directly, avoiding fake or outdated listings
Developers: learn Go crawler, deduplication, and search system implementation
Recruiting platform researchers: analyze job data aggregation and normalization methods

zh.tag: AI视频翻译配音全链路工具，支持人类与AI Agent调用
zh.what: KrillinAI 是一款由 Krillin AI 团队开发的音视频本地化与增强工具，面向人类用户和 AI Agent。它覆盖从视频下载、语音转录、字幕翻译、TTS 配音、人像转换到封面生成的完整流程，支持横竖屏格式，适配 B站、小红书、抖音、YouTube 等主流平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 客户端、分阶段命令接口、skills/ 目录提供各阶段 Agent Skills，以及多语言文档（中英日韩等）。支持一键端到端本地化，也可通过 CLI 分阶段调用，AI Agent 可按需编排。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 LLM 进行翻译，TTS 引擎进行配音，支持 100+ 语言。
zh.hot: 本周新增 384 星，总星数破万，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Go）第 19 名。其面向 AI Agent 的 Skills 设计和对多平台适配的完整流程吸引了大量关注。
uses: 内容创作者：一键翻译配音视频，快速发布到海外平台
AI Agent 开发者：利用 Skills 集成视频本地化能力到自动化工作流
本地化团队：批量处理多语言视频内容，提高效率

en.tag: Full-pipeline AI video translation & dubbing tool for humans and agents
en.what: KrillinAI is a versatile audio/video localization and enhancement tool by Krillin AI team, designed for both human users and AI Agents. It covers the complete pipeline including video download, speech transcription, subtitle translation, TTS dubbing, portrait conversion, and cover generation, supporting both landscape and portrait formats for major platforms like Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube, etc.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI client, phased command-line interface, skills/ directory with per-stage Agent Skills, and multi-language docs (EN, ZH, JP, etc.). It supports one-click end-to-end localization and phased CLI invocation for AI Agents to orchestrate.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging LLMs for translation and TTS engines for dubbing, supporting 100+ languages.
en.hot: Gained 384 stars this week, surpassing 10k total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its Agent Skills design and full multi-platform pipeline have drawn significant attention.
uses: Content creators: one-click translate and dub videos for global platforms
AI Agent developers: integrate video localization into automated workflows via Skills
Localization teams: batch process multi-language video content efficiently

zh.tag: 跨平台网络资源嗅探下载器，支持多平台多格式
zh.what: 这是一款基于 Go 和 Wails 的跨平台资源下载工具，通过代理抓包方式嗅探并下载网络资源。它支持微信视频号、小程序、抖音、快手、小红书、酷狗音乐、QQ音乐等平台的视频、音频、图片、m3u8 和直播流等资源。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，包括前端 UI（基于 Wails）、核心抓包与资源解析逻辑、构建配置、文档及安装包。项目还提供 Mini 版（使用默认浏览器展示 UI）和 Electron 旧版（支持 Win7）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，结合 Wails 框架构建跨平台桌面应用，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。依赖系统代理进行网络抓包，并集成多种资源解析与下载功能。
zh.hot: 该项目以 19k+ stars 持续走红，今日新增 40 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 8。其简单易用、支持多平台资源下载的特性满足了大量用户对短视频、音乐等资源获取的需求。
uses: 普通用户：想下载微信视频号、抖音、快手等平台的视频或音乐，无需技术背景
内容创作者：需要保存素材用于二次创作或离线备份
资源收藏爱好者：批量下载 m3u8 视频或直播流进行本地存储
开发者：研究代理抓包和资源嗅探技术的参考实现

en.tag: Cross-platform network resource sniffer & downloader for multiple platforms and formats
en.what: A cross-platform resource downloader built with Go and Wails, which sniffs and downloads network resources via proxy packet capture. It supports videos, audio, images, m3u8, and live streams from platforms like WeChat Channels, mini-programs, Douyin, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu, Kugou Music, and QQ Music.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, including the Wails-based UI, core packet capture and resource parsing logic, build configs, docs, and installers. It also offers a Mini version (UI in default browser) and an old Electron version (Win7 support).
en.stack: Primarily Go with the Wails framework for cross-platform desktop apps (Windows, macOS, Linux). It uses system proxy for packet capture and integrates various resource parsing and downloading capabilities.
en.hot: With 19k+ stars and 40 new stars today, it ranks #8 on the Go trending list. Its ease of use and support for downloading resources from multiple platforms meet the widespread demand for saving short videos and music.
uses: General users: want to download videos/music from WeChat Channels, Douyin, Kuaishou, etc., without technical background
Content creators: need to save materials for remixing or offline backup
Resource collectors: batch download m3u8 videos or live streams for local storage
Developers: reference implementation for proxy packet capture and resource sniffing

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理与 IDE 打造的高性能代码知识图谱引擎
zh.what: Gortex 是一个代码智能引擎，将代码索引为图结构，并通过 CLI、MCP 服务器和 Web UI 暴露给 AI 代理和 IDE。它支持多仓库、257 种语言，并利用编译器级解析生成持久化的知识图谱，帮助 AI 代理只获取所需信息，最多可减少 50 倍 token 消耗。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心引擎、CLI 工具、MCP 服务器实现、Web UI 以及文档和基准测试。提供 175 个可配置的 MCP 工具，支持 19 种编码代理，并附带安装指南和语言支持列表。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，基于 tree-sitter 进行语法分析，并针对多种语言提供编译器级解析。无运行时依赖，提供静态二进制文件，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 凭借减少 token 消耗、支持多仓库和 257 种语言等特性，在 AI 编码代理工具中脱颖而出，今日新增 26 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜 Go 语言第 9 名。
uses: AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor）开发者，希望减少 token 消耗并提高代码理解能力。
IDE 插件开发者，需要为编辑器提供代码智能功能。
大型项目团队，需要跨仓库的代码导航和依赖分析。
对本地代码智能引擎感兴趣的研究者或爱好者。

en.tag: High-performance code-intelligence engine for AI agents and IDEs
en.what: Gortex is a code-intelligence engine that indexes code into a graph and exposes it via CLI, MCP server, and web UI for AI agents and IDEs. It supports multi-repository, 257 languages, and uses compiler-grade parsing to build a persistent knowledge graph, enabling AI agents to access only needed information, cutting token usage by up to 50x.
en.content: The repository contains the core engine written in Go, a CLI tool, MCP server implementation, web UI, along with documentation and benchmarks. It offers 175 configurable MCP tools, supports 19 coding agents, and includes installation guides and language support lists.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging tree-sitter for syntax analysis and compiler-grade resolution for multiple languages. It has zero runtime dependencies, ships as a static binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: It stands out among AI coding agent tools for its token reduction, multi-repo support, and 257-language coverage, gaining 26 stars today and ranking 9th on GitHub Trending for Go.
uses: Developers of AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) looking to reduce token usage and improve code comprehension.
IDE plugin developers needing code intelligence features for editors.
Teams working on large projects requiring cross-repository code navigation and dependency analysis.
Researchers or enthusiasts interested in local code-intelligence engines.

zh.tag: 多协议多用户 Xray 管理面板，支持流量/期限/IP 限制
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器高级 Web 管理面板，支持 VLESS、VMess、Trojan、Shadowsocks、WireGuard、Hysteria2 等多种协议。它提供多语言界面，可部署、配置和监控代理/VPN 服务，支持单机到多节点部署，并包含用户管理、流量统计、订阅服务等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 面板源码、多语言翻译文件、Telegram 机器人、RESTful API 文档（Swagger）、自定义订阅模板、以及 Docker 和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 Xray-core，前端使用 Vue.js 和 Element Plus，数据库支持 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL，可通过 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 44.8k 星标，今日新增 69，位列 Go 趋势榜第 10。作为 X-UI 的增强分支，它提供更广的协议支持、更稳定的性能和丰富的管理功能，深受自建代理用户喜爱。
uses: 个人用户：自建科学上网代理，管理多协议多端口
小型团队：多节点管理，集中监控流量和用户
开发者：通过 RESTful API 集成或定制面板功能

en.tag: Multi-protocol Xray panel with per-client traffic, expiry & IP limits
en.what: 3X-UI is an advanced open-source web panel for managing Xray-core servers, supporting protocols like VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, WireGuard, Hysteria2, and more. It offers a multi-language interface for deploying, configuring, and monitoring proxy/VPN services, from single VPS to multi-node setups, with user management, traffic stats, and subscription features.
en.content: The repo includes full web panel source, multi-language translations, Telegram bot, RESTful API docs (Swagger), custom subscription templates, and Docker/install scripts.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Xray-core; frontend uses Vue.js and Element Plus; storage supports SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL; deployable via Docker.
en.hot: With 44.8k stars and +69 today, ranking #10 on Go trending. As an enhanced fork of X-UI, it offers broader protocol support, improved stability, and rich management features, making it popular among self-hosted proxy users.
uses: Individuals: self-host proxy servers with multi-protocol and multi-port management
Small teams: manage multiple nodes and centrally monitor traffic and users
Developers: integrate via RESTful API or customize panel features

zh.tag: 通用文件存储客户端，支持 20+ 协议
zh.what: Filestash 是一个存储无关的文件管理器，类似 Dropbox，但支持 FTP、SFTP、S3、SMB、WebDAV、IPFS 等 20 多种存储协议。它围绕核心引擎提供 Web 客户端、原生驱动客户端和网关，旨在成为最好的文件管理平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎、插件系统、Web 客户端（原生 JS 编写）、API 和网关（如 SFTP、S3、FTP、WebDAV、MCP、AS2）。插件驱动架构，几乎所有功能都是插件，可扩展存储和认证方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写后端，前端为原生 JavaScript。依赖多种存储协议库，支持插件开发。
zh.hot: Filestash 因支持 20+ 存储协议和插件架构而受欢迎，star 数达 14.5k，今日新增 18，位列 Go 日榜第 11。其灵活性和可扩展性吸引了需要统一文件管理解决方案的用户。
uses: 需要统一管理多种存储（如 FTP、S3、SFTP）的个人或团队
希望自托管 Dropbox 替代方案的用户
开发者，希望利用插件系统扩展存储或认证方式
企业，需要将存储暴露为多种协议（如 SFTP、WebDAV）的网关

en.tag: Universal file storage client supporting 20+ protocols
en.what: Filestash is a storage-agnostic file manager, similar to Dropbox, but supports 20+ storage protocols including FTP, SFTP, S3, SMB, WebDAV, IPFS, and more. It provides a web client, a native drive client, and gateways around a core engine, aiming to be the world's best file management platform.
en.content: The repository contains the core engine, plugin system, web client (handcrafted in vanilla JS), APIs, and gateways (e.g., SFTP, S3, FTP, WebDAV, MCP, AS2). It features a plugin-driven architecture where almost everything is a plugin, extensible for storage and authentication.
en.stack: Backend written in Go, frontend in vanilla JavaScript. Depends on various storage protocol libraries and supports plugin development.
en.hot: Filestash is popular for its support of 20+ storage protocols and plugin architecture, with 14.5k stars and 18 new today, ranking 11th on the Go daily trending. Its flexibility and extensibility attract users needing a unified file management solution.
uses: Individuals or teams needing unified management of multiple storages (e.g., FTP, S3, SFTP)
Users looking for a self-hosted Dropbox alternative
Developers wanting to extend storage or authentication via plugins
Enterprises needing to expose storage over multiple protocols (e.g., SFTP, WebDAV) as a gateway

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造终极CLI的生成器
zh.what: 这是一个CLI生成器，读取官方API文档，研究社区CLI和MCP服务器，嗅探未公开的API，融合所有特性，生成专为AI代理设计的、token高效的Go CLI，同时附带Claude Code技能和MCP服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含生成器源码、预生成的CLI示例（如ESPN、flight-goat、linear-pp-cli）、技能文件（docs/CODEX.md、docs/CURSOR.md）以及指向完整目录的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用Go语言，依赖SQLite进行本地数据同步和离线搜索，可能涉及MCP协议和Claude Code技能。
zh.hot: 4.4k星，日增7星，登上Go趋势榜，因为AI代理时代对高效CLI的需求激增，而它通过嗅探未公开API和复合命令提供了独特价值。
uses: AI代理开发者：需要为代理提供高效CLI工具，减少token消耗。
API爱好者：希望为无官方API的服务（如Google Flights）创建CLI。
CLI工具使用者：想要快速获取复合查询能力的命令行工具。

en.tag: Generate the GOAT CLI for AI agents from any API
en.what: A CLI generator that reads official API docs, studies community CLIs and MCP servers, sniffs out unpublished APIs, fuses all features, and prints token-efficient Go CLIs designed for AI agents, along with Claude Code skills and MCP servers.
en.content: Contains generator source code, pre-printed CLI examples (ESPN, flight-goat, linear-pp-cli), skill docs (docs/CODEX.md, docs/CURSOR.md), and links to the full catalog.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with SQLite for local sync and offline search, likely involving MCP protocol and Claude Code skills.
en.hot: 4.4k stars, +7 today, trending in Go, because of surging demand for efficient CLIs in the AI agent era, and its unique value in sniffing unpublished APIs and compound commands.
uses: AI agent developers: need efficient CLIs for agents to reduce token spend.
API enthusiasts: want to create CLIs for services without official APIs (e.g., Google Flights).
CLI users: desire command-line tools with compound query capabilities.

zh.tag: AI 编码代理的统一终端指挥中心
zh.what: Agent Deck 是一个终端会话管理器，专为 AI 编码代理设计。它在一个 TUI 中统一管理 Claude、Gemini、OpenCode、Codex 等多个代理的会话，支持分组、搜索、分叉、git worktree 和成本跟踪。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 TUI 应用、用于远程控制的 Web 视图（conductor）、安装脚本、文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖终端 UI 库（如 Bubble Tea）和 Git 集成，支持 macOS、Linux 和 WSL。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，开发者需要统一管理多个代理会话，Agent Deck 正好解决了这一痛点，上线不久即获得 737 星，日增 6 星，登上 Go 趋势榜。
uses: 同时运行多个 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、OpenCode）的开发者，需要集中管理会话。
在多个项目间切换的开发者，希望快速查看和切换代理会话状态。
对终端工作流有偏好的开发者，希望用 TUI 而非多个终端窗口。
需要跟踪代理使用成本和 Git 工作树管理的团队。

en.tag: Unified terminal command center for AI coding agents
en.what: Agent Deck is a terminal session manager for AI coding agents. It unifies sessions from Claude, Gemini, OpenCode, Codex, and more in one TUI, with features like grouping, search, forking, git worktrees, and cost tracking.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based TUI app, a web view for remote control (conductor), installation scripts, documentation, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., Bubble Tea) and Git integration, supporting macOS, Linux, and WSL.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need a unified way to manage multiple agent sessions. Agent Deck addresses this pain point, quickly gaining 737 stars with 6 new stars today, landing on the Go trending list.
uses: Developers running multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode) who need centralized session management.
Developers switching between projects who want quick visibility and switching of agent sessions.
Developers preferring terminal workflows and TUI over multiple terminal windows.
Teams needing cost tracking and Git worktree management for agent usage.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 备份与迁移工具
zh.what: Velero 是一个用于备份、恢复和迁移 Kubernetes 集群资源及持久化卷的工具。它支持公有云和本地环境，帮助用户在集群丢失时恢复数据，或将资源迁移到其他集群。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Velero 的源代码、文档、兼容性矩阵和贡献指南。主要组件包括运行在集群上的服务器和本地命令行客户端。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API 和云提供商插件（如 AWS、Azure、GCP）。
zh.hot: 作为 Kubernetes 生态中成熟的备份迁移方案，Velero 持续获得关注，当前拥有超过 1 万颗星，今日新增 13 颗，位列 Go 语言趋势榜。
uses: Kubernetes 管理员：用于集群备份和灾难恢复。
DevOps 团队：用于将生产集群复制到开发/测试环境。
云迁移项目：用于在不同集群或云提供商之间迁移应用。

en.tag: Backup and migrate Kubernetes apps and persistent volumes
en.what: Velero is a tool for backing up, restoring, and migrating Kubernetes cluster resources and persistent volumes. It supports public cloud and on-premises environments, helping users recover data in case of cluster loss or migrate resources to other clusters.
en.content: The repository contains Velero's source code, documentation, compatibility matrix, and contribution guidelines. Main components include a server running in the cluster and a command-line client.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relies on Kubernetes API and cloud provider plugins (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
en.hot: As a mature backup and migration solution in the Kubernetes ecosystem, Velero continues to gain attention, with over 10k stars and 13 new stars today, ranking on the Go trending list.
uses: Kubernetes administrators: for cluster backup and disaster recovery.
DevOps teams: for replicating production clusters to dev/test environments.
Cloud migration projects: for migrating applications between clusters or cloud providers.

zh.tag: 开源身份与访问管理平台，简化企业级认证。
zh.what: ZITADEL 是一个开源的身份和访问管理（IAM）平台，为开发者提供开箱即用的 SSO、MFA、Passkeys、OIDC、SAML、SCIM 和多租户支持。它旨在替代传统认证方案，让团队无需从零构建即可安全地管理用户身份。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 IAM 服务端、管理控制台、文档站点（apps/docs）以及用于快速部署的 Docker 配置。代码结构清晰，包含 API、命令行工具和前端界面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gRPC、REST API、PostgreSQL 和 CockroachDB 等。支持 Docker 部署，并集成了 OpenID Connect 认证。
zh.hot: 随着企业对安全性和合规性要求的提高，ZITADEL 提供了开源、自托管的 IAM 解决方案，避免供应商锁定。其丰富的功能和活跃的社区推动了 14.7k 星标的增长。
uses: SaaS 产品开发者：快速集成 SSO 和 MFA，无需从零构建认证系统。
B2B 平台团队：利用多租户模型管理企业客户的身份和权限。
自托管 IAM 需求者：希望完全控制身份基础设施，避免云供应商锁定。
DevOps 工程师：通过 Docker 或 Kubernetes 部署和管理生产级 IAM 栈。

en.tag: Open-source identity & access management platform, simplifying enterprise-grade authentication.
en.what: ZITADEL is an open-source identity and access management (IAM) platform that provides out-of-the-box SSO, MFA, Passkeys, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and multi-tenancy support. It aims to replace traditional auth solutions, allowing teams to securely manage user identities without building from scratch.
en.content: The repository contains a full IAM server, admin console, documentation site (apps/docs), and Docker configurations for quick deployment. The codebase is well-structured, including APIs, CLI tools, and frontend interfaces.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging gRPC, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, and CockroachDB. Supports Docker deployment and integrates OpenID Connect authentication.
en.hot: With rising security and compliance demands, ZITADEL offers an open-source, self-hosted IAM solution that avoids vendor lock-in. Its rich features and active community have driven growth to 14.7k stars.
uses: SaaS developers: Quickly integrate SSO and MFA without building auth from scratch.
B2B platform teams: Use multi-tenancy to manage identities and permissions for enterprise customers.
Self-hosters: Want full control over identity infrastructure, avoiding cloud vendor lock-in.
DevOps engineers: Deploy and manage production-grade IAM stacks via Docker or Kubernetes.

zh.tag: 本地AI模型热切换代理，零依赖Go实现
zh.what: llama-swap 是一个本地代理，允许你在多个生成式AI模型之间按需热切换。它兼容任何支持 OpenAI 或 Anthropic API 的服务器，如 llama.cpp、vllm 等，只需一个二进制文件和配置文件即可快速部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的代理程序，支持多种 API 端点（OpenAI、Anthropic、llama-server、SDAPI、audio.cpp、ComfyUI），并提供 Web UI 和模型管理 API。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 编写，零外部依赖，性能高且易于部署。
zh.hot: 随着本地AI工作流兴起，llama-swap 提供了简单可靠的模型切换方案，star 数已达 5.4k，今日新增 14，登上 Go 趋势榜。
uses: 本地AI开发者和研究者，需要频繁切换不同模型进行测试或推理
使用 llama.cpp、vllm 等推理服务器的用户，希望统一管理多个模型
希望构建本地AI应用但不想处理复杂配置的开发者

en.tag: Zero-dependency Go proxy for hot-swapping local AI models
en.what: llama-swap is a local proxy that lets you hot-swap between multiple generative AI models on demand. It works with any OpenAI or Anthropic API compatible server, such as llama.cpp, vllm, etc., and can be deployed quickly with just one binary and one config file.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based proxy supporting various API endpoints (OpenAI, Anthropic, llama-server, SDAPI, audio.cpp, ComfyUI), plus a web UI and model management APIs.
en.stack: Written in Go with zero external dependencies, offering high performance and easy deployment.
en.hot: With the rise of local AI workflows, llama-swap offers a simple and reliable model-swapping solution, amassing 5.4k stars with 14 new today, trending in Go.
uses: Local AI developers and researchers needing to switch models frequently for testing or inference
Users of inference servers like llama.cpp, vllm who want unified management of multiple models
Developers building local AI apps without complex configuration

zh.tag: 专为 Kubernetes 设计的现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Talos Linux 是一个专为 Kubernetes 设计的现代操作系统，安全、不可变且极简。它通过 API 进行所有系统管理，没有 shell 或交互式控制台，旨在减少攻击面并消除配置漂移。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Talos Linux 的完整源代码、文档、构建脚本和示例配置。它提供了部署和管理 Kubernetes 集群所需的工具和 API 定义。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux 内核、Kubernetes 和 gRPC 等。它构建为不可变的系统镜像，支持多种平台。
zh.hot: 随着 Kubernetes 的普及，对安全、不可变操作系统的需求增长，Talos 提供了独特的 API 驱动管理方式，吸引了大量关注。其 star 数已超过 1 万，今日新增 7 个，位列 Go 语言趋势榜。
uses: Kubernetes 运维人员：需要安全、不可变的基础设施来运行生产级集群。
DevOps 团队：希望简化 Kubernetes 节点管理，通过 API 实现自动化。
安全敏感场景：需要最小化攻击面并强化系统安全性的企业。
边缘计算：适合在资源受限或需要远程管理的环境中部署 Kubernetes。

en.tag: A modern Linux distribution built specifically for Kubernetes
en.what: Talos Linux is a modern OS designed specifically for Kubernetes, secure, immutable, and minimal. All system management is done via API, with no shell or interactive console, aiming to reduce attack surface and eliminate configuration drift.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, build scripts, and example configurations for Talos Linux. It provides the tools and API definitions needed to deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, and gRPC. It is built as immutable system images, supporting multiple platforms.
en.hot: With the rise of Kubernetes, the demand for secure, immutable operating systems has grown. Talos offers a unique API-driven management approach, attracting significant attention. Its star count has exceeded 10k, with 7 new stars today, ranking on the Go trending list.
uses: Kubernetes operators: Need secure, immutable infrastructure for production clusters.
DevOps teams: Want to simplify Kubernetes node management via API-driven automation.
Security-sensitive environments: Enterprises that need to minimize attack surface and harden systems.
Edge computing: Suitable for deploying Kubernetes in resource-constrained or remotely managed environments.

zh.tag: 实时基础设施可观测性平台，AI 加持，秒级指标采集
zh.what: Netdata 是一个开源的全栈可观测性平台，能够以每秒一次的频率采集服务器、容器和应用的各项指标，并通过交互式仪表盘实时展示。它内置 AI 异常检测和告警功能，帮助团队快速定位问题，即使人力有限也能轻松监控整个基础设施。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Netdata 的核心代理（用 C 语言编写，但主语言标记为 Go 可能指其新组件）、仪表盘、告警引擎、AI 功能模块，以及丰富的采集插件（如系统、容器、数据库等）。还提供 Docker 镜像、安装脚本和详细的文档。
zh.stack: 核心代理使用 C 语言，但仓库主语言标记为 Go（可能指新组件或工具）。依赖包括 libuv、LZ4、OpenSSL 等，支持多种平台（Linux、macOS、FreeBSD）和容器环境。
zh.hot: Netdata 拥有超过 8 万 star，是监控领域最受欢迎的开源项目之一。它因实时、零配置、AI 驱动和轻量级而广受好评，适合各种规模的团队快速部署。
uses: DevOps 和 SRE 团队：需要实时监控服务器和容器性能，快速定位故障。
中小型企业：缺乏专职监控团队，希望用轻量工具获得全栈可观测性。
个人开发者：用于个人项目或实验室环境，监控资源使用情况。
云原生环境：监控 Kubernetes 集群、容器和微服务。

en.tag: AI-powered real-time infrastructure observability platform with per-second metrics
en.what: Netdata is an open-source full-stack observability platform that collects metrics from servers, containers, and applications every second, presenting them in real-time interactive dashboards. It includes built-in AI anomaly detection and alerting to help teams quickly identify issues, making it easy for even lean teams to monitor their entire infrastructure.
en.content: The repository contains the Netdata core agent (written in C, though the primary language is listed as Go possibly for new components), dashboards, alerting engine, AI features, and numerous collectors for systems, containers, databases, etc. It also includes Docker images, installation scripts, and extensive documentation.
en.stack: The core agent is written in C, but the repo's primary language is listed as Go (possibly for new components or tools). Dependencies include libuv, LZ4, OpenSSL, etc., supporting multiple platforms (Linux, macOS, FreeBSD) and container environments.
en.hot: With over 80k stars, Netdata is one of the most popular open-source projects in monitoring. It is praised for its real-time, zero-configuration, AI-driven, and lightweight nature, making it easy for teams of all sizes to deploy quickly.
uses: DevOps and SRE teams: need real-time monitoring of servers and containers to quickly identify issues.
SMBs: lack dedicated monitoring teams, want lightweight full-stack observability.
Individual developers: monitor resource usage for personal projects or lab environments.
Cloud-native environments: monitor Kubernetes clusters, containers, and microservices.

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的开源门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证和授权服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）。它作为反向代理的认证门户，保护应用免受未授权访问，并支持 OpenID Connect 协议。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Authelia 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置、Docker 镜像构建文件以及 CI/CD 配置。项目采用 Go 编写，提供可执行二进制文件和容器化部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种开源库如 fasthttp、jwt-go 等，支持 SQLite 和 MySQL 后端存储，并集成 Redis 用于会话管理。
zh.hot: 随着自托管和隐私保护意识的增强，Authelia 作为成熟的开源 SSO/MFA 解决方案受到广泛关注，28.6k 的 star 数体现了其稳定性和社区认可。
uses: 自托管爱好者：为家庭实验室或私有云中的多个应用提供统一登录和二次验证。
中小型企业：需要为内部 Web 应用实现安全访问控制，但预算有限。
开发者：希望集成 OpenID Connect 或学习 Go 语言认证系统实现。

en.tag: Open-source SSO and MFA portal for web apps, OpenID Certified
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication and authorization server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication portal behind a reverse proxy, protecting apps from unauthorized access and supporting OpenID Connect.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, Docker image build files, and CI/CD setup. Written in Go, it offers executable binaries and containerized deployment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging libraries like fasthttp and jwt-go, with support for SQLite and MySQL backends, and Redis for session management.
en.hot: With rising self-hosting and privacy awareness, Authelia has gained traction as a mature open-source SSO/MFA solution, reflected in its 28.6k stars and steady daily growth.
uses: Self-hosters: provide unified login and 2FA for multiple apps in home labs or private clouds.
SMBs: need secure access control for internal web apps with limited budget.
Developers: want to integrate OpenID Connect or learn Go-based auth system implementation.

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，支持多协议与多平台
zh.what: sing-box 是一个通用代理平台，旨在提供高性能、可配置的网络代理服务。它支持多种代理协议（如 Shadowsocks、VMess、Trojan 等）和出站协议，适用于科学上网、网络调试等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 sing-box 的源代码、文档链接、许可证信息。代码用 Go 编写，提供命令行工具和库，可配置入站/出站代理、路由规则等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖如 gVisor、WireGuard 等库，支持多平台（Linux、Windows、macOS、Android、iOS）。
zh.hot: 拥有 37k+ stars，今日新增 45，因其功能强大、配置灵活且跨平台，在代理工具中广受欢迎。
uses: 科学上网用户：配置代理客户端，绕过网络限制。
网络开发者：测试和调试代理协议。
系统管理员：搭建代理服务器，管理网络流量。

en.tag: Universal proxy platform supporting multiple protocols and platforms
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform designed to provide high-performance, configurable network proxy services. It supports various proxy protocols (like Shadowsocks, VMess, Trojan) and outbound protocols, suitable for circumvention and network debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation links, and license info for sing-box. Written in Go, it provides a CLI tool and libraries for configuring inbound/outbound proxies, routing rules, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with dependencies like gVisor and WireGuard, supporting multiple platforms (Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, iOS).
en.hot: With 37k+ stars and 45 new today, it's popular among proxy tools for its powerful features, flexible configuration, and cross-platform support.
uses: Users needing circumvention: configure proxy clients to bypass restrictions.
Network developers: test and debug proxy protocols.
System administrators: set up proxy servers and manage network traffic.

zh.tag: 自托管一站式软件开发服务，Git 托管与协作平台
zh.what: Gitea 是一个用 Go 编写的轻量级自托管 Git 服务，提供代码托管、代码审查、问题跟踪、项目看板、Wiki、团队协作、包注册表和 CI/CD 等功能。它旨在成为最简单、最快、最无痛的自托管软件开发解决方案，并支持复用 GitHub Actions。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Gitea 源代码、文档（包括安装、管理、使用、开发指南）、构建脚本和本地化文件。支持多种语言（如简体中文、繁体中文），并提供 Docker 镜像和云服务选项。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，跨平台支持 Linux、macOS、FreeBSD/OpenBSD 和 Windows，以及多种架构（x86, amd64, ARM, RISC-V 64, PowerPC）。依赖包括 Go 标准库、各种开源库，并支持 SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL 等数据库。
zh.hot: Gitea 作为 GitHub 的轻量级替代品，因其自托管、易部署、功能全面而持续受到开发者青睐。尽管今日新增星标不多，但总星标超过 57k，长期保持热门，尤其在 Go 社区中具有重要地位。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队：希望自建 Git 服务，完全掌控代码和隐私。
企业或组织：需要内部代码托管和协作平台，且希望低成本、易维护。
开源项目维护者：寻找 GitHub 的替代方案，或需要与 GitHub Actions 兼容的 CI/CD。
教育或研究机构：用于教学或内部项目，需要轻量级且功能完整的开发服务。

en.tag: Painless self-hosted all-in-one software development service with Git hosting
en.what: Gitea is a lightweight self-hosted Git service written in Go, offering code hosting, code review, issue tracking, project kanban, wiki, team collaboration, package registry, and CI/CD. It aims to be the easiest, fastest, and most painless way to set up a self-hosted all-in-one software development service, with support for reusing GitHub Actions.
en.content: The repository contains the full Gitea source code, documentation (including installation, administration, usage, development guides), build scripts, and localization files. It supports multiple languages (e.g., Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese) and offers Docker images and cloud service options.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, cross-platform supporting Linux, macOS, FreeBSD/OpenBSD, and Windows on various architectures (x86, amd64, ARM, RISC-V 64, PowerPC). Dependencies include Go standard library, various open-source libraries, and support for SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL databases.
en.hot: Gitea, as a lightweight alternative to GitHub, remains popular among developers for its self-hosting, easy deployment, and comprehensive features. Despite modest daily star gains, its total stars exceed 57k, maintaining long-term popularity, especially within the Go community.
uses: Individual developers or small teams: want to self-host Git service for full control over code and privacy.
Enterprises or organizations: need an internal code hosting and collaboration platform with low cost and easy maintenance.
Open-source maintainers: seeking an alternative to GitHub or needing CI/CD compatible with GitHub Actions.
Educational or research institutions: for teaching or internal projects requiring a lightweight yet full-featured development service.

zh.tag: 用 Markdown 定义 AI 自动化，安全跑在 GitHub Actions 上
zh.what: gh-aw 是一个 GitHub CLI 扩展，让开发者用 Markdown 加 YAML frontmatter 定义 AI 代理工作流，并编译成标准的 GitHub Actions 工作流。它支持多种 AI 引擎（如 Copilot、Claude、Codex 等），默认只读沙箱，通过安全输出实现受控写入。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 扩展源码、安装脚本、文档（包括快速入门、配置指南）以及示例工作流。核心是 `gh aw` 命令，用于初始化、添加和管理代理工作流。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 编写，作为 GitHub CLI 扩展分发。运行时依赖 GitHub Actions，AI 引擎通过 API 或 WIF 认证，支持多种模型提供商。
zh.hot: GitHub 官方出品，将 AI 代理与现有 CI/CD 无缝集成，star 近 5000，登顶 Go 趋势榜，满足开发者对安全、可控 AI 自动化的需求。
uses: 维护者：自动分类 issue、审查 PR、调查 CI 失败，节省维护时间
开发者：用自然语言定义仓库自动化，无需编写复杂 Actions
团队：将 AI 工作流纳入现有 CI/CD，提升效率且保持安全

en.tag: Define AI-powered repo automation in Markdown, run securely on GitHub Actions
en.what: gh-aw is a GitHub CLI extension that lets developers define AI-powered repository automation in Markdown with YAML frontmatter, compiling into standard GitHub Actions workflows. It supports multiple AI engines (Copilot, Claude, Codex, etc.) with read-only sandboxing by default and controlled writes via safe outputs.
en.content: The repo contains the CLI extension source, installer scripts, docs (quick start, setup guides), and example workflows. Core is the `gh aw` command to init, add, and manage agentic workflows.
en.stack: Written in Go, distributed as a GitHub CLI extension. Relies on GitHub Actions for execution, with AI engines authenticated via API keys or WIF, supporting multiple providers.
en.hot: Official GitHub project, seamlessly integrating AI agents with existing CI/CD, nearly 5k stars and trending in Go, addressing developers' need for safe, controlled AI automation.
uses: Maintainers: automate issue triage, PR review, CI failure investigation to save time
Developers: define repo automation in natural language without complex Actions
Teams: integrate AI workflows into existing CI/CD for efficiency and safety

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: Minecraft 多实例启动器，MultiMC 的社区分支
zh.what: Prism Launcher 是一个 Minecraft 启动器，允许用户同时轻松管理多个 Minecraft 安装实例。它是 MultiMC 的分支，但不受 MultiMC 官方认可。
zh.content: 仓库包含启动器的完整源代码，包括程序图标、安装说明、构建指南、社区链接和翻译资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 框架，支持 Linux、Windows 和 macOS，并提供 Flatpak 打包。
zh.hot: 作为 MultiMC 的活跃分支，它提供了更频繁的更新和社区支持，在 Minecraft 玩家中广受欢迎，目前拥有超过 10k 的 star。
uses: Minecraft 玩家：需要管理多个游戏版本或模组包的玩家。
模组开发者：需要隔离测试不同模组环境的开发者。
服务器管理员：希望为不同服务器配置独立客户端的用户。

en.tag: A custom Minecraft launcher for managing multiple instances, a fork of MultiMC
en.what: Prism Launcher is a custom launcher for Minecraft that allows users to easily manage multiple installations of Minecraft at once. It is a fork of MultiMC, but is not endorsed by it.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the launcher, including program icons, installation instructions, build guides, community links, and translation resources.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on Qt framework, supports Linux, Windows, and macOS, and offers Flatpak packaging.
en.hot: As an active fork of MultiMC, it offers more frequent updates and community support, popular among Minecraft players, with over 10k stars.
uses: Minecraft players: those who need to manage multiple game versions or modpacks.
Mod developers: developers who need isolated environments for testing different mods.
Server admins: users who want separate client configurations for different servers.

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上的机器学习数组框架
zh.what: MLX 是苹果机器学习研究团队推出的面向 Apple 芯片的数组框架，提供类似 NumPy 的 Python API 以及 C++、C、Swift API。它支持自动微分、自动向量化、惰性计算和动态图构建，并采用统一内存模型，可在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、Python 绑定、高层包（如 mlx.nn 和 mlx.optimizers）、文档和示例。示例涵盖 Transformer 训练、LLaMA 推理与 LoRA 微调、Stable Diffusion 图像生成和 Whisper 语音识别等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，提供 Python、C、Swift API。依赖包括 Metal 和 Accelerate 框架，用于 GPU 加速和高效计算。
zh.hot: 作为苹果官方开源的机器学习框架，MLX 在 Apple 生态中备受关注，star 数已达 2.79 万。其统一内存和动态图设计使其在 Apple 芯片上训练和部署模型非常高效，吸引了大量研究人员和开发者。
uses: Apple 平台上的机器学习研究人员，希望快速实验新想法。
在 Mac 上训练或微调大语言模型（如 LLaMA）的开发者。
需要利用 Apple 芯片 GPU 进行高性能计算的工程师。
对 NumPy/PyTorch 熟悉，希望在 Apple 设备上无缝迁移的用户。

en.tag: Array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon
en.what: MLX is an array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon, developed by Apple's ML research team. It offers NumPy-like Python APIs along with C++, C, and Swift APIs, supporting automatic differentiation, vectorization, lazy computation, and dynamic graph construction. With a unified memory model, it runs efficiently on both CPU and GPU.
en.content: The repo contains core C++ implementation, Python bindings, high-level packages (mlx.nn, mlx.optimizers), documentation, and examples. Examples include Transformer training, LLaMA inference with LoRA fine-tuning, Stable Diffusion image generation, and Whisper speech recognition.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Python, C, and Swift APIs. It leverages Metal and Accelerate frameworks for GPU acceleration and efficient computation.
en.hot: As Apple's official open-source ML framework, MLX has gained significant attention in the Apple ecosystem, reaching 27.9k stars. Its unified memory and dynamic graph design make it highly efficient for training and deploying models on Apple silicon, attracting researchers and developers.
uses: ML researchers on Apple platforms seeking rapid experimentation.
Developers training or fine-tuning LLMs (e.g., LLaMA) on Mac.
Engineers needing high-performance compute on Apple silicon GPUs.
Users familiar with NumPy/PyTorch wanting seamless migration to Apple devices.

zh.tag: C++ 轻量级即时模式 GUI 库
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个为 C++ 设计的无冗余图形用户界面库。它输出优化的顶点缓冲区，可在启用 3D 管线的应用中随时渲染，速度快、可移植、与渲染器无关且无外部依赖。它旨在实现快速迭代，赋能程序员创建内容创作工具和可视化/调试工具，而非面向终端用户的常规 UI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Dear ImGui 的完整源代码、示例（如示例应用）、文档（README、Wiki 链接）、构建配置（如 GitHub Actions）以及测试引擎（imgui_test_engine）。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持多种渲染后端（如 OpenGL、DirectX、Vulkan）和平台（如 GLFW、SDL）。
zh.hot: 拥有 75,690 颗星，是 C++ GUI 领域的标杆项目，被广泛应用于游戏开发、工具开发和可视化领域。今日新增 20 星，持续保持热度。
uses: 游戏开发中的调试工具和编辑器界面
内容创作工具（如关卡编辑器、动画工具）
可视化工具（如数据监控、性能分析）
需要快速迭代 UI 的嵌入式应用或原型

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++. It outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered anytime in a 3D-pipeline-enabled application; it is fast, portable, renderer agnostic, and self-contained. It is designed to enable fast iterations and empower programmers to create content creation tools and visualization/debug tools, rather than UI for end users.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Dear ImGui, examples (such as example apps), documentation (README, Wiki links), build configurations (like GitHub Actions), and the test engine (imgui_test_engine).
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies, supporting multiple rendering backends (e.g., OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan) and platforms (e.g., GLFW, SDL).
en.hot: With 75,690 stars, it is a benchmark project in the C++ GUI space, widely used in game development, tooling, and visualization. It gained 20 stars today, maintaining its popularity.
uses: Debug tools and editor UIs in game development
Content creation tools (e.g., level editors, animation tools)
Visualization tools (e.g., data monitoring, performance profiling)
Embedded applications or prototypes requiring rapid UI iteration

zh.tag: 机器人学教育与研究的高生产力 Python 框架
zh.what: Robotics Toolbox for Python 是一个用于机器人学研究和教育的 Python 库，提供机器人运动学、动力学、轨迹生成等核心功能。它旨在简化机器人算法的实现，让用户专注于研究而非底层细节。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 包，包括机器人模型（如 DH 参数、URDF）、运动学与动力学算法、可视化工具，以及 JupyterLite 在线演示和详细文档。
zh.stack: 基于 NumPy、SciPy、Matplotlib 和 spatialmath-python，支持 Python 3，使用 C++ 扩展优化性能。
zh.hot: 今日新增 65 星，总星数 3368，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（C++）第 6 名。作为机器人学经典工具箱的 Python 版本，它因易用性和教学价值而广受欢迎。
uses: 机器人学课程教学，帮助学生直观理解运动学与动力学概念
科研人员快速原型验证机器人算法
机器人爱好者学习与实验，利用 JupyterLite 在线体验

en.tag: A high-productivity Python framework for robotics research and education
en.what: Robotics Toolbox for Python is a Python library for robotics research and education, providing core functionalities like kinematics, dynamics, and trajectory generation. It aims to simplify the implementation of robotics algorithms, allowing users to focus on research rather than low-level details.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python package including robot models (e.g., DH parameters, URDF), kinematics and dynamics algorithms, visualization tools, plus JupyterLite online demos and comprehensive documentation.
en.stack: Built on NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, and spatialmath-python, supports Python 3, with C++ extensions for performance.
en.hot: Gained 65 stars today, total 3368, ranked #6 on GitHub Trending (C++) daily. As the Python version of a classic robotics toolbox, it's popular for its ease of use and educational value.
uses: Teaching robotics courses, helping students intuitively understand kinematics and dynamics concepts
Researchers quickly prototyping and validating robotics algorithms
Robotics enthusiasts learning and experimenting, with JupyterLite for online experience

zh.tag: 跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器，C++ 编写
zh.what: shadPS4 是一个早期的 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，用 C++ 编写。它目前处于早期开发阶段，但已经可以运行《血源诅咒》《黑暗之魂重制版》等游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心代码，不包含 GUI；用户需下载 QtLauncher 作为前端。提供游戏兼容性列表和快速入门指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Qt 用于 GUI（QtLauncher），支持多种平台。
zh.hot: 作为 PS4 模拟器，它能在 PC 上运行《血源诅咒》等独占大作，吸引了大量玩家和开发者，Star 数已超 3.2 万。
uses: 想在 PC 上体验 PS4 独占游戏的玩家
对主机模拟器开发感兴趣的开发者
测试和贡献游戏兼容性的社区成员

en.tag: Cross-platform PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++
en.what: shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator for Windows, Linux, and macOS, written in C++. It is in early development but can already run games like Bloodborne and Dark Souls Remastered.
en.content: The repository contains the emulator core without a GUI; users need to download QtLauncher as the frontend. It provides a game compatibility list and quickstart guide.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with Qt for the GUI (QtLauncher), supporting multiple platforms.
en.hot: As a PS4 emulator, it can run exclusive titles like Bloodborne on PC, attracting many gamers and developers, with over 32k stars.
uses: Gamers who want to play PS4 exclusives on PC
Developers interested in console emulator development
Community members testing and contributing to game compatibility

zh.tag: 可高度定制的桌面音乐播放器
zh.what: fooyin 是一款可定制的桌面音乐播放器，支持多种音频格式，提供灵活的播放、曲库管理和播放列表功能。其界面可从空白画布自由排列，或采用预设布局，并支持插件扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的播放器源代码，包括核心播放引擎、库管理、播放列表、插件系统、FooScript 脚本引擎，以及多种预设界面布局（如简单、浏览器、黑曜石、画廊等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 框架（用于 GUI），并集成多种音频解码库（如 FFmpeg）和插件接口。
zh.hot: 因其高度可定制性和丰富的功能（如脚本支持、插件系统）而受到关注，在 GitHub 上获得 2204 颗星，今日新增 10 颗，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 8 名。
uses: 音频发烧友：追求无损播放和位完美输出，支持多种格式。
定制爱好者：喜欢通过脚本和插件打造个性化播放器界面和功能。
开发者：希望学习或扩展一个基于 Qt 的 C++ 音乐播放器项目。

en.tag: A highly customizable desktop music player
en.what: fooyin is a customizable desktop music player that supports a wide range of audio formats, offering flexible playback, library management, and playlists. Its interface can be rearranged from a blank canvas or adapted from preset layouts, and it supports plugin extensibility.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the player, including the core playback engine, library management, playlists, plugin system, FooScript scripting engine, and various preset layouts (e.g., Simple, Browser, Obsidian, Gallery).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on the Qt framework for GUI and integrates various audio decoding libraries (e.g., FFmpeg) and plugin interfaces.
en.hot: It gains attention for its high customizability and rich features (like scripting and plugins), earning 2,204 stars on GitHub with 10 new stars today, ranking 8th on the C++ trending list.
uses: Audiophiles: seeking lossless and bit-perfect playback with support for many formats.
Customization enthusiasts: enjoy scripting and plugins to create a personalized player.
Developers: interested in learning or extending a Qt-based C++ music player project.

zh.tag: llama.cpp 高性能分支，新增 SOTA 量化与 CPU 加速
zh.what: 这是一个基于 llama.cpp 的分支，专注于提升 CPU 推理性能，并引入多种最新的量化类型。它率先实现了 MLA、张量并行、MTP 等特性，部分功能后来被上游采纳。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 推理引擎、量化工具和构建脚本，支持 CPU（AVX2/NEON）和 CUDA 后端。提供详细的构建指南和注意事项，强调对特定硬件和模型的支持限制。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 CMake，依赖 GGML 库，支持 AVX2/AVX-512/NEON 指令集和 CUDA（Turing 及以上）。
zh.hot: 虽然今日新增星标不多，但累计 3054 星，说明其作为高性能 llama.cpp 分支在社区中持续受到关注，尤其吸引追求极致 CPU 推理性能的开发者。
uses: 在 CPU 上运行 LLM 推理并追求最佳性能的开发者
需要最新量化格式（如 k-quants）以减小模型体积的用户
希望提前体验 llama.cpp 新特性（如 MLA、张量并行）的爱好者
研究混合 CPU/GPU 推理优化的研究人员

en.tag: llama.cpp fork with SOTA quants and better CPU performance
en.what: A fork of llama.cpp focused on better CPU inference performance and additional state-of-the-art quantization types. It pioneered features like MLA, tensor parallelism, and MTP, some of which were later adopted upstream.
en.content: The repo contains a full C++ inference engine, quantization tools, and build scripts, supporting CPU (AVX2/NEON) and CUDA backends. It includes detailed build instructions and caveats about hardware and model compatibility.
en.stack: Built on C++ and CMake, leveraging the GGML library, with support for AVX2/AVX-512/NEON instruction sets and CUDA (Turing and newer).
en.hot: Despite modest daily stars, the 3,054 total stars reflect sustained community interest as a high-performance llama.cpp fork, especially among developers seeking maximum CPU inference performance.
uses: Developers running LLM inference on CPU with maximum performance
Users needing latest quantization formats (e.g., k-quants) to reduce model size
Enthusiasts wanting early access to new llama.cpp features like MLA and tensor parallelism
Researchers studying hybrid CPU/GPU inference optimization

zh.tag: ESP32 多频段无线攻防工具，带触屏 UI
zh.what: ESP32-DIV 是一个基于 ESP32-S3 的开源多频段无线工具包，集成了 Wi-Fi、BLE、2.4GHz、Sub-GHz、红外、RFID/NFC 和 GPS 功能。它提供紧凑的手持设备形态，并配备触屏界面，用于无线流量分析、信号测试和 RF 工具构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的固件源码、硬件设计文件（如 PCB 原理图）、Web 刷机工具（浏览器直接刷写）以及详细的 Wiki 文档，涵盖从 Wi-Fi 去认证攻击到 Sub-GHz 信号重放等功能的教程。
zh.stack: 基于 ESP32-S3 微控制器，使用 C++ 编写固件，依赖 Arduino 框架或 ESP-IDF。支持触屏显示、SD 卡存储、多种无线模块（如 CC1101 用于 Sub-GHz）。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 3768 星，并进入 C++ 日榜前十，因其将多种无线攻击/防御功能集成于一个便携设备，且提供浏览器刷写和详尽 Wiki，吸引了安全研究者和硬件爱好者。
uses: 安全研究人员：用于无线协议分析、渗透测试和漏洞研究（需合法授权）
硬件爱好者：学习 ESP32 开发、射频电路设计和嵌入式 UI 编程
教育用途：在课堂或实验室演示无线通信原理和安全概念

en.tag: ESP32-based multi-band wireless offensive/defensive toolkit with touchscreen UI
en.what: ESP32-DIV is an open-source multi-band wireless toolkit built on the ESP32-S3, covering Wi-Fi, BLE, 2.4GHz, Sub-GHz, IR, RFID/NFC, and GPS. It comes in a compact handheld form factor with a touchscreen UI for wireless traffic analysis, signal resilience testing, and RF tool building.
en.content: The repository includes full firmware source code, hardware design files (e.g., PCB schematics), a web-based flasher (flash directly from browser), and extensive Wiki documentation with tutorials covering features from Wi-Fi deauthentication attacks to Sub-GHz signal replay.
en.stack: Based on the ESP32-S3 microcontroller, firmware written in C++ using Arduino framework or ESP-IDF. Supports touchscreen display, SD card storage, and various wireless modules (e.g., CC1101 for Sub-GHz).
en.hot: With 3768 stars and a spot in the C++ daily trending top 10, this project attracts security researchers and hardware enthusiasts by packing multiple wireless offensive/defensive features into a portable device, plus browser flashing and detailed Wiki.
uses: Security researchers: for wireless protocol analysis, penetration testing, and vulnerability research (with proper authorization)
Hardware enthusiasts: to learn ESP32 development, RF circuit design, and embedded UI programming
Educational use: to demonstrate wireless communication principles and security concepts in classrooms or labs

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 BitTorrent 客户端，功能全面
zh.what: qBittorrent 是一个用 C++/Qt 编写的 BitTorrent 客户端，基于 libtorrent 库，旨在成为其他 BT 客户端的优秀替代品。它快速、稳定，支持 Unicode，并提供丰富的功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端源代码、安装说明、许可证文件、PGP 公钥以及 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 libtorrent 库，并集成 DB-IP 的 IP 到国家数据库。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源 BT 客户端，qBittorrent 拥有近 4 万星标，今日新增 26 星，持续受到用户青睐，因其无广告、开源且功能强大。
uses: 需要稳定、无广告的 BT 下载工具的个人用户
希望深度定制或集成 BT 功能的开发者
寻求跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux）下载解决方案的用户

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform BitTorrent client with full features
en.what: qBittorrent is a BitTorrent client written in C++/Qt, using the libtorrent library, aiming to be a good alternative to other BitTorrent clients. It is fast, stable, supports Unicode, and offers many features.
en.content: The repository contains the full client source code, installation instructions, license files, PGP public keys, and CI configuration.
en.stack: Primarily uses C++ and Qt framework, depends on libtorrent library, and integrates DB-IP's IP-to-Country database.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source BT client, qBittorrent has nearly 40k stars, with 26 added today, consistently favored by users for being ad-free, open-source, and feature-rich.
uses: Individual users needing a stable, ad-free BT download tool
Developers looking to customize or integrate BT functionality
Users seeking cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) download solutions

zh.tag: 开源金融终端，集行情、研究、经济数据于一体
zh.what: FinceptTerminal 是一款现代金融应用，提供高级市场分析、投资研究工具和经济数据，旨在通过用户友好的交互界面支持数据驱动的决策。它分为企业版（闭源，41个模块）和免费版（AGPL-3.0，每月更新），本仓库为免费版。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面终端应用，基于 C++20 和 Qt6，集成 Python 3.11+ 脚本，提供模块化界面（如市场分析、研究工具、经济数据），并附有构建文档和许可证说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++20 和 Qt6 构建 GUI，Python 3.11+ 用于脚本和扩展，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并可能使用金融数据 API。
zh.hot: 3万+星标，因其免费开源、功能对标商业金融终端（如 Bloomberg），且提供企业版对比，吸引金融开发者与量化爱好者。
uses: 金融学习者：通过免费版学习市场分析工具和金融数据可视化
量化研究员：利用 Python 脚本扩展自定义策略和数据获取
开源爱好者：参与 C++/Qt 项目开发，贡献功能模块
小型投资团队：低成本获取专业级终端功能

en.tag: Open-source finance terminal for market analytics, research, and economic data
en.what: FinceptTerminal is a modern finance application offering advanced market analytics, investment research, and economic data tools, designed for interactive exploration and data-driven decision-making. It has an enterprise edition (closed-source, 41 modules) and a free AGPL-3.0 edition (monthly releases); this repo is the free edition.
en.content: The repo contains a full desktop terminal application built with C++20 and Qt6, integrating Python 3.11+ scripting, with modular UI for market analytics, research, and economic data, plus build docs and license info.
en.stack: Built with C++20 and Qt6 for the GUI, Python 3.11+ for scripting, CMake for build, and likely financial data APIs.
en.hot: 30k+ stars, popular for being a free open-source alternative to commercial terminals like Bloomberg, with enterprise comparison, attracting finance devs and quant enthusiasts.
uses: Finance learners: use free edition to study market analytics and data visualization
Quant researchers: extend with Python scripts for custom strategies and data
Open-source enthusiasts: contribute to C++/Qt development
Small investment teams: get professional terminal features at low cost

zh.tag: 为 Wayland 打造的一体化桌面外壳
zh.what: Noctalia 是一个原生 Wayland 桌面外壳，旨在提供精致、可配置的 Linux 桌面体验，无需拼接多个独立工具。它集成了任务栏、启动器、通知、锁屏、壁纸、控制中心等功能，形成一个统一的桌面环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面外壳实现，包括多显示器任务栏、桌面小部件、剪贴板历史、OSD、托盘集成等。项目处于 v5 Beta 阶段，核心功能和架构已趋于稳定。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 构建，直接使用 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES，不依赖 Qt 或 GTK。UI、渲染、配置和 IPC 模型统一设计。
zh.hot: 凭借近万星标和日增 22 星的热度，它满足了用户对统一、可定制 Wayland 桌面体验的需求，避免了碎片化工具链的复杂性。
uses: Wayland 用户希望获得开箱即用的完整桌面环境
喜欢深度定制桌面外观和行为的 Linux 爱好者
开发者希望探索基于 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES 的现代桌面实现

en.tag: An all-in-one desktop shell for Wayland
en.what: Noctalia is a native Wayland desktop shell that provides a polished, configurable Linux desktop without stitching together separate tools. It integrates bars, launcher, notifications, lock screen, wallpaper, control center, and more into a cohesive shell.
en.content: The repository contains a full desktop shell implementation, including multi-monitor bars, desktop widgets, clipboard history, OSDs, tray integration, and more. The project is in v5 Beta, with core features and architecture stabilizing.
en.stack: Built with C++, directly on Wayland and OpenGL ES, with no Qt or GTK dependency. UI, rendering, configuration, and IPC are designed cohesively.
en.hot: With nearly 10k stars and 22 new stars today, it addresses the demand for a unified, customizable Wayland desktop experience, avoiding the complexity of fragmented toolchains.
uses: Wayland users who want a complete desktop environment out of the box
Linux enthusiasts who enjoy deep customization of desktop appearance and behavior
Developers interested in exploring modern desktop implementations based on Wayland and OpenGL ES

zh.tag: 开源ESP32无线渗透测试工具，支持扫描、干扰、欺骗
zh.what: nRFBox 是一个基于 ESP32 的开源硬件工具，用于扫描、干扰、欺骗和掌控 2.4GHz 频段的 BLE、Wi-Fi 等无线信号。它集成了多种攻击和测试功能，如 Wi-Fi 解除认证攻击、BLE 欺骗、信号干扰等，适合安全研究和渗透测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的固件源码、原理图、PCB 设计文件以及详细的 Wiki 文档，涵盖从 Wi-Fi 解除认证攻击到 Sub-GHz 信号重放的所有功能说明。
zh.stack: 基于 ESP32 平台，使用 C++ 编写，依赖 nRF24L01 等无线模块，支持 Arduino 或 ESP-IDF 开发环境。
zh.hot: 因其强大的无线攻击功能和高可定制性，在安全研究社区广受关注，当前 Star 数近 2000，今日新增 8 个，位列 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 14 名。
uses: 安全研究人员：用于测试无线网络安全性，验证漏洞
渗透测试人员：在授权范围内进行无线攻击模拟
硬件爱好者：学习 ESP32 和无线通信技术
教育用途：演示无线协议漏洞和防御方法

en.tag: Open-source ESP32 tool for scanning, jamming, spoofing BLE/Wi-Fi/2.4GHz
en.what: nRFBox is an open-source ESP32-based tool for scanning, jamming, spoofing, and mastering BLE, Wi-Fi, and 2.4GHz networks. It integrates various attack and testing features like Wi-Fi deauthentication, BLE spoofing, and signal jamming, suitable for security research and penetration testing.
en.content: The repository contains complete firmware source code, schematics, PCB design files, and detailed Wiki documentation covering all features from Wi-Fi deauthentication to Sub-GHz signal replay.
en.stack: Built on ESP32 platform, written in C++, relies on wireless modules like nRF24L01, supports Arduino or ESP-IDF development environments.
en.hot: It gains attention in the security research community for its powerful wireless attack capabilities and high customizability, with nearly 2000 stars, 8 new today, ranking 14th on GitHub Trending C++ daily.
uses: Security researchers: test wireless network security and validate vulnerabilities
Penetration testers: simulate wireless attacks within authorized scope
Hardware enthusiasts: learn ESP32 and wireless communication technologies
Educational purposes: demonstrate wireless protocol vulnerabilities and defenses

zh.tag: ESP32 驱动的可寻址 LED 固件，功能丰富
zh.what: WLED 是一款专为 ESP32 微控制器设计的固件，用于通过 WiFi 控制 WS2812B 等多种数字 RGB LED 灯带、矩阵和面板。它提供了 200 多种内置特效、50 多个调色板、音频反应功能，并支持分段控制和预设，让用户轻松打造炫酷的灯光效果。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的固件源代码、文档（wiki）、移动应用（WLED-App）以及社区资源，如论坛和 Discord 服务器。代码结构清晰，支持多种 LED 类型和输出方式，并提供 Web 界面进行配置和控制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 ESP32 平台，依赖 Arduino 框架或 ESP-IDF。支持多种 LED 驱动协议（如 WS2812B、APA102 等），并利用 WiFi 进行网络通信。
zh.hot: WLED 是 DIY 智能照明领域的明星项目，拥有 18.5k 星标，社区活跃。其功能丰富且易于使用，吸引了大量爱好者、创客和智能家居用户，持续在 GitHub 趋势榜上占有一席之地。
uses: DIY 爱好者：自制 LED 灯带、氛围灯、音乐可视化等创意项目
智能家居用户：将 LED 灯集成到家庭自动化系统，通过 WiFi 控制
创客与艺术家：用于艺术装置、舞台灯光、交互式展示等

en.tag: Feature-rich firmware for ESP32 to control addressable LEDs
en.what: WLED is a firmware for ESP32 microcontrollers to control addressable LEDs like WS2812B over WiFi. It offers 200+ built-in effects, 50+ color palettes, audio reactivity, and supports segments and presets for creating stunning light displays.
en.content: The repository contains the complete firmware source code, documentation (wiki), mobile app (WLED-App), and community resources like forums and Discord. The code supports various LED types and output methods, with a web interface for configuration and control.
en.stack: Written in C++, based on ESP32 platform, using Arduino framework or ESP-IDF. Supports multiple LED driver protocols (e.g., WS2812B, APA102) and uses WiFi for network communication.
en.hot: WLED is a star project in DIY smart lighting with 18.5k stars and an active community. Its feature-rich and easy-to-use nature attracts hobbyists, makers, and smart home users, keeping it on GitHub Trending.
uses: DIY enthusiasts: for custom LED strips, ambient lighting, music visualization projects
Smart home users: integrate LED lights into home automation via WiFi
Makers and artists: for art installations, stage lighting, interactive displays

zh.tag: 极致美观的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器
zh.what: Hyprland 是一个独立、高度可定制、动态平铺的 Wayland 合成器，注重外观而不牺牲功能。它提供最新的 Wayland 特性、丰富的视觉效果（渐变边框、模糊、动画、阴影等）、强大的插件系统、内置插件管理器、撕裂支持（提升游戏性能）等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hyprland 合成器的完整源代码、文档链接、安装指南、配置示例和画廊展示。代码库以 C++ 编写，易于扩展和阅读。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，不依赖 wlroots、libweston、kwin 或 mutter，完全独立实现。依赖 Wayland 协议和相关库。
zh.hot: 凭借出色的视觉效果和高度可定制性，Hyprland 在 Linux 桌面用户中广受欢迎，Star 数达 36,817，今日新增 24，持续活跃开发。
uses: Linux 桌面用户 —— 追求美观、高效、可定制的平铺窗口管理体验
Wayland 爱好者 —— 希望体验最新 Wayland 特性的用户
开发者 —— 对合成器实现感兴趣，或希望为其开发插件的开发者

en.tag: A highly customizable dynamic tiling Wayland compositor with stunning visuals
en.what: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks. It offers the latest Wayland features, extensive eye candy (gradient borders, blur, animations, shadows), a powerful plugin system, built-in plugin manager, tearing support for better gaming performance, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Hyprland compositor, documentation links, installation guides, configuration examples, and a gallery. The codebase is written in C++ and is designed to be easily expandable and readable.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, Hyprland is fully independent and does not rely on wlroots, libweston, kwin, or mutter. It depends on Wayland protocols and related libraries.
en.hot: With its stunning visuals and high customizability, Hyprland has gained immense popularity among Linux desktop users, amassing 36,817 stars (24 new today) and maintaining active development.
uses: Linux desktop users — seeking a beautiful, efficient, and customizable tiling window management experience
Wayland enthusiasts — users wanting to experience the latest Wayland features
Developers — interested in compositor implementation or developing plugins for Hyprland

zh.tag: 跨平台 PSP 模拟器，无需 BIOS 即可畅玩
zh.what: PPSSPP 是一款用 C++ 编写的高性能 PSP 模拟器，支持 Android、Windows、Mac、Linux 和 iOS。它采用 HLE 模拟方式，无需 BIOS 文件即可运行游戏，默认设置兼顾兼容性和速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码、构建脚本、文档和维基链接，以及用于问题跟踪和社区反馈的页面。最新版本 1.20.4 带来了大量 UX 改进、纹理放大优化、渲染修复和多人游戏功能增强。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenGL/Direct3D/Vulkan 等图形 API，并利用平台原生接口实现跨平台支持。
zh.hot: 作为老牌 PSP 模拟器，PPSSPP 拥有庞大的用户基础和持续更新，近期因新增多人游戏功能和大量 UX 改进而再次受到关注，星标数稳步增长。
uses: 想在 PC 或手机上重温 PSP 经典游戏的玩家
需要跨平台模拟器进行游戏测试或开发的开发者
对模拟器技术或 HLE 实现感兴趣的学习者

en.tag: Fast and portable PSP emulator for multiple platforms, no BIOS required
en.what: PPSSPP is a high-performance PSP emulator written in C++, supporting Android, Windows, Mac, Linux, and iOS. It uses HLE emulation and requires no BIOS file, with default settings balancing compatibility and speed.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build instructions, documentation and wiki links, along with issue tracking and community feedback pages. The latest release 1.20.4 brings numerous UX improvements, texture upscaling optimizations, rendering fixes, and multiplayer enhancements.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on graphics APIs like OpenGL/Direct3D/Vulkan and uses platform-native interfaces for cross-platform support.
en.hot: As a long-standing PSP emulator, PPSSPP has a large user base and continuous updates. It recently gained attention due to new multiplayer features and extensive UX improvements, with steady star growth.
uses: Gamers who want to revisit classic PSP titles on PC or mobile
Developers needing a cross-platform emulator for testing or development
Learners interested in emulator technology or HLE implementation

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 RGB 灯效控制，统一管理所有外设
zh.what: OpenRGB 是一个开源工具，用于控制各种 RGB 硬件设备的灯光效果，无需依赖厂商专用软件。它支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，提供统一的界面来管理不同品牌的设备。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、文档、截图和构建配置。主要功能包括设置颜色和效果模式、保存/加载配置文件、通过 SDK 控制、命令行界面、多实例同步等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 框架进行图形界面，支持多种平台。通过逆向工程协议与硬件通信。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多，但累计 4326 星表明其持续受欢迎。它解决了 RGB 生态碎片化问题，提供跨平台统一控制，深受 DIY 玩家和 Linux 用户喜爱。
uses: DIY 装机爱好者：统一控制不同品牌的 RGB 设备，避免安装多个厂商软件
Linux 用户：在 Linux 系统上获得完整的 RGB 控制功能
开发者：利用 SDK 或命令行集成 RGB 控制到自定义应用或脚本
追求简洁的用户：替代厂商臃肿软件，减少后台资源占用

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform RGB lighting control, unify all devices
en.what: OpenRGB is an open-source tool for controlling RGB lighting on various hardware devices without relying on manufacturer-specific software. It supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, providing a unified interface to manage devices from different brands.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, documentation, screenshots, and build configurations. Key features include setting colors and effects, saving/loading profiles, SDK control, CLI, multi-instance sync, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, uses Qt framework for GUI, supports multiple platforms. Communicates with hardware via reverse-engineered protocols.
en.hot: Despite modest daily stars, the cumulative 4326 stars indicate sustained popularity. It solves RGB ecosystem fragmentation with cross-platform unified control, appealing to DIY enthusiasts and Linux users.
uses: DIY PC builders: unify RGB control across brands, avoiding multiple vendor apps
Linux users: full RGB control on Linux systems
Developers: integrate RGB control via SDK or CLI into custom apps/scripts
Minimalists: replace bloated vendor software, reduce background resource usage

zh.tag: ESP32 红队渗透测试固件
zh.what: Bruce 是一个为 ESP32 设备设计的固件，集成了多种攻击性安全工具，用于快速便携的红队操作。它支持多种硬件平台，如 M5Stack、LILYGO 等，并提供了丰富的功能，包括 WiFi 攻击、RFID 读取等。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、预编译二进制文件、官方开发板 RF REAPER 的硬件设计文件，以及详细的文档和 Wiki。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，主要面向 ESP32-S3 等芯片，依赖 esptool.py 进行烧录，支持 Web Flasher 和 M5Burner 等工具。
zh.hot: 因其强大的攻击性安全功能和对多种硬件的兼容性而受到关注，star 数已达 6482，在 GitHub Trending 上排名靠前。
uses: 红队安全测试人员，用于快速部署渗透测试工具
硬件爱好者，探索 ESP32 的无线攻击能力
安全研究人员，学习 WiFi、RFID 等攻击技术

en.tag: ESP32 firmware for offensive-security red team operations
en.what: Bruce is a versatile ESP32 firmware packed with offensive-security tools, designed for fast and portable red team operations. It supports multiple hardware platforms like M5Stack and LILYGO, and offers features such as WiFi attacks, RFID reading, and more.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, precompiled binaries, hardware design files for the official RF REAPER devkit, and comprehensive documentation and wiki.
en.stack: Developed in C++, targeting ESP32-S3 and similar chips, flashed via esptool.py, with support for Web Flasher and M5Burner.
en.hot: It's popular for its powerful offensive-security features and compatibility with various hardware, with 6482 stars and a high ranking on GitHub Trending.
uses: Red team security testers for rapid deployment of penetration testing tools
Hardware enthusiasts exploring ESP32 wireless attack capabilities
Security researchers learning WiFi, RFID, and other attack techniques

zh.tag: 高效完整的 C++ BitTorrent 实现库
zh.what: libtorrent 是一个开源的 C++ 库，实现了 BitTorrent 协议及其大多数流行扩展，适合真实世界部署。它可配置以适应服务器和嵌入式设备，主要目标是高效且易于使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含库的源代码、文档（如构建说明和 Python 绑定文档）、示例代码以及 CI 配置（Windows、macOS、Linux、Python）。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 实现，依赖 Boost 库（用于构建），支持 Python 绑定，使用 Boost.Build 构建系统。
zh.hot: 作为成熟的 BitTorrent 库，拥有 6000+ 星标，持续维护并支持多平台，在 GitHub 趋势榜上保持热度。
uses: 开发 BitTorrent 客户端或种子下载工具
在服务器或嵌入式设备中集成 P2P 文件分发功能
研究 BitTorrent 协议实现或进行学术研究
需要高性能、可扩展的 P2P 传输解决方案的开发者

en.tag: Efficient, feature-complete C++ BitTorrent library
en.what: libtorrent is an open-source C++ library implementing the BitTorrent protocol and most popular extensions, suitable for real-world deployment. It is configurable to fit both servers and embedded devices, with main goals of efficiency and ease of use.
en.content: The repository contains the library's source code, documentation (build instructions, Python binding docs), examples, and CI configurations (Windows, macOS, Linux, Python).
en.stack: Implemented in C++, depends on Boost libraries for building, supports Python bindings, uses Boost.Build as the build system.
en.hot: As a mature BitTorrent library with 6000+ stars, it remains popular due to continuous maintenance, multi-platform support, and its presence on the trending list.
uses: Developing BitTorrent clients or torrent download tools
Integrating P2P file distribution in servers or embedded devices
Studying BitTorrent protocol implementations or academic research
Developers needing high-performance, scalable P2P transfer solutions

zh.tag: Sunshine 分支，按客户端原生分辨率低延迟串流
zh.what: Apollo 是一个自托管的桌面串流服务器，专为 Artemis（Moonlight Noir）客户端设计。它提供低延迟、客户端原生分辨率、云游戏服务器能力，支持 AMD、Intel 和 Nvidia GPU 硬件编码，也支持软件编码。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Apollo 的完整源代码、构建配置、文档和 Wiki 链接。主要功能包括内置虚拟显示器（支持 HDR）、客户端权限管理、剪贴板同步、连接/断开命令以及仅输入模式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Sunshine 项目。虚拟显示器使用 SudoVDA，支持 Windows 平台（Linux 支持计划中）。
zh.hot: 作为 Sunshine 的活跃分支，Apollo 提供了更简单的原生分辨率串流体验，吸引了大量用户。尽管今日新增星标不多，但总星标已超 1 万，说明其稳定受欢迎。
uses: 游戏玩家：在本地网络或云端以客户端原生分辨率低延迟串流游戏。
云游戏服务商：利用其服务器能力提供多 GPU 硬件编码的云游戏服务。
远程工作者：通过虚拟显示器和权限管理安全地远程访问桌面。
技术爱好者：喜欢自定义和扩展 Sunshine 生态的用户。

en.tag: Sunshine fork for low-latency streaming at client native resolution
en.what: Apollo is a self-hosted desktop stream host for Artemis (Moonlight Noir), offering low latency, native client resolution, and cloud gaming server capabilities with support for AMD, Intel, and Nvidia GPUs for hardware encoding, as well as software encoding.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, build configuration, documentation, and Wiki links for Apollo. Key features include built-in virtual display with HDR support, client permission management, clipboard sync, connection/disconnection commands, and input-only mode.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, based on the Sunshine project. It uses SudoVDA for virtual display, with Windows support currently (Linux planned).
en.hot: As an active fork of Sunshine, Apollo offers a simpler native-resolution streaming experience, attracting many users. Despite modest daily stars, its total stars exceed 10k, indicating sustained popularity.
uses: Gamers: stream games at native client resolution with low latency over LAN or cloud.
Cloud gaming providers: leverage server capabilities for multi-GPU hardware encoding.
Remote workers: securely access desktops remotely with virtual display and permission management.
Tech enthusiasts: users who enjoy customizing and extending the Sunshine ecosystem.

zh.tag: 用配置文件控制ESP32等芯片的智能家居固件系统
zh.what: ESPHome 是一个通过简单而强大的配置文件来控制 ESP32、ESP8266、BK72xx、RP2040 等微控制器的系统，并能通过家庭自动化系统进行远程控制。它让硬件编程变得像写配置文件一样简单，适合快速搭建智能家居设备。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ESPHome 的核心代码，包括配置解析、编译、上传、API 服务器等，以及文档和示例配置。主要用 C++ 编写，但配置使用 YAML。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，依赖 Arduino 框架或 ESP-IDF，支持多种微控制器平台，与 Home Assistant 等系统集成。
zh.hot: 虽然今日新增 star 不多，但累计 11551 星，长期稳定在 GitHub 趋势榜，因其在智能家居 DIY 社区中非常受欢迎，是开源硬件与软件结合的代表项目。
uses: 智能家居爱好者：快速制作自定义传感器、开关、灯光等设备
嵌入式开发者：用配置文件代替传统固件开发，提高效率
Home Assistant 用户：无缝集成，实现自动化控制

en.tag: Control ESP32/ESP8266 etc. via simple config files for home automation
en.what: ESPHome is a system to control microcontrollers like ESP32, ESP8266, BK72xx, RP2040 via simple yet powerful configuration files, and control them remotely through home automation systems. It simplifies hardware programming to writing config files, ideal for rapid smart home device development.
en.content: The repo contains the core ESPHome code, including config parsing, compilation, uploading, API server, plus docs and example configs. Written mainly in C++, configured via YAML.
en.stack: Built on C++, uses Arduino framework or ESP-IDF, supports multiple MCU platforms, integrates with Home Assistant and other systems.
en.hot: Despite modest daily stars, it has 11.5k stars and consistently appears on trending lists, popular in DIY smart home community as a bridge between open-source hardware and software.
uses: Smart home enthusiasts: quickly build custom sensors, switches, lights
Embedded developers: replace traditional firmware dev with config files for efficiency
Home Assistant users: seamless integration for automation

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 打造 29 种编辑级图表，纯 HTML+SVG
zh.what: 这是一个 Claude Code 技能（skill），能生成 29 种编辑级质量的图表，如架构图、流程图、时序图等。所有图表均为自包含的 HTML+SVG，无外部依赖，可直接在浏览器打开。它还能将 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源文件重绘为指定格式、尺寸和细节级别。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能文件、文档和截图，展示了 27 种视觉类型（README 提到 29 种，可能版本更新）的三种静态变体：极简浅色、极简深色和完整编辑风格。每种类型都有对应的 HTML 模板，无需构建步骤。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript、无外部图片依赖。作为 Claude Code 技能，也兼容 Codex 和 Pi。
zh.hot: 今日新增 2855 星，总星数破万，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了 AI 生成图表千篇一律的痛点，提供编辑级设计，让图表不再像“Mermaid 垃圾”。
uses: 内容创作者和博主：快速生成与网站风格一致的图表，提升文章专业度。
