en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.16, supports agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, and uses TencentDB as the storage backend.
en.hot: Gained 1,057 stars today, reaching 16,543 total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily chart. Its 'team memory' concept addresses the pain point of AI agent collaboration, and one-click deployment quickly attracts developers.
uses: AI agent developers: add persistent memory to agents, reducing repetitive context input.
Team collaboration: share agent memory to improve knowledge reuse efficiency.
Solo developers: build a 'one-person company' agent team for automated workflows.
Researchers/enthusiasts: explore agent memory management and cross-framework integration.

zh.tag: Claude 官方技能库，赋能代理完成专业任务
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 发布的 Claude 技能（Agent Skills）公共仓库，包含多种技能示例，从创意设计到技术开发再到企业工作流。每个技能以独立文件夹形式存在，内含 SKILL.md 文件，指导 Claude 如何完成特定任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 skills 目录（创意与设计、开发与技术、企业与沟通、文档技能等示例）、spec 目录（Agent Skills 规范）和 template 目录（技能模板）。还包含了驱动 Claude 文档能力的 docx、pdf、pptx、xlsx 等复杂技能。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，技能以文件夹形式组织，使用 SKILL.md 描述指令和元数据。部分技能依赖 Claude 的 API 或 Claude Code 插件机制。
zh.hot: 凭借 16.9 万 star 和每周新增 2682 的热度，该仓库成为 AI 代理技能领域的标杆。它展示了 Claude 技能系统的强大能力，为开发者提供了丰富的参考和灵感。
uses: 开发者：学习如何为 Claude 创建自定义技能，提升代理在特定任务上的表现。
企业团队：参考企业级技能示例（如品牌、沟通）来标准化内部工作流。
创意工作者：探索艺术、音乐、设计等创意技能，激发 AI 辅助创作。
技术爱好者：研究文档处理技能（docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx）的实现，用于生产环境。

en.tag: Official Claude skills library to empower agents for specialized tasks
en.what: This is Anthropic's public repository for Agent Skills, containing a variety of skill examples from creative design to technical development to enterprise workflows. Each skill is a self-contained folder with a SKILL.md file that instructs Claude on how to perform specific tasks.
en.content: The repo includes a skills directory (examples for creative & design, development & technical, enterprise & communication, and document skills), a spec directory (Agent Skills specification), and a template directory. It also includes complex skills like docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx that power Claude's document capabilities.
en.stack: Primary language is Python. Skills are organized as folders with SKILL.md describing instructions and metadata. Some skills rely on Claude's API or Claude Code plugin mechanism.
en.hot: With 169k stars and 2,682 new stars this week, this repo is a benchmark in the AI agent skills space. It showcases the power of Claude's skills system and provides developers with rich references and inspiration.
uses: Developers: Learn how to create custom skills for Claude to enhance agent performance on specific tasks.
Enterprise teams: Reference enterprise skill examples (e.g., branding, communication) to standardize internal workflows.
Creative professionals: Explore creative skills in art, music, design to inspire AI-assisted creation.
Tech enthusiasts: Study document processing skills (docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx) for production use.

zh.tag: 首个DiT架构音视频统一生成模型官方推理与LoRA训练包
zh.what: LTX-2 是一个基于 DiT 的音频-视频生成基础模型，能在单一模型中实现同步音视频生成、高保真输出、多种性能模式和生产级 API。该仓库提供官方 Python 推理代码和 LoRA 训练器，方便开发者本地运行和微调模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的推理管线（ltx-pipelines）、LoRA 训练器、模型下载脚本、示例代码和优化文档，支持通过 uv 快速安装依赖。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Hugging Face Transformers、Diffusers 等，并可选 natten 加速视频 VAE 解码。
zh.hot: 作为首个 DiT 音视频统一模型，LTX-2 凭借开源权重和官方训练支持，在 GitHub 上迅速获得 8700+ 星标，日增 65 星，跻身趋势榜第 15 名。
uses: AI 研究人员：研究音视频生成模型架构与训练方法
内容创作者：快速生成带同步音频的高质量视频
开发者：集成 LTX-2 到应用或进行 LoRA 微调定制风格

en.tag: Official inference & LoRA trainer for LTX-2, the first DiT-based audio-video foundation model
en.what: LTX-2 is a DiT-based audio-video foundation model that unifies synchronized audio and video generation, high fidelity, multiple performance modes, and production-ready API access. This repo provides the official Python inference and LoRA trainer for local use and fine-tuning.
en.content: The repo includes full inference pipelines (ltx-pipelines), a LoRA trainer, model download scripts, examples, and optimization docs, with quick setup via uv.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Diffusers, with optional natten for accelerated video VAE decoding.
en.hot: As the first DiT-based unified audio-video model, LTX-2 quickly gained 8700+ stars with +65 today, ranking #15 on GitHub Trending, thanks to open weights and official training support.
uses: AI researchers: study audio-video generative model architecture and training
Content creators: quickly generate high-quality videos with synchronized audio
Developers: integrate LTX-2 into apps or fine-tune with LoRA for custom styles

zh.tag: 工业级可控零样本语音合成系统
zh.what: IndexTTS 是一个零样本文本转语音系统，能从单条参考音频克隆声音。最新版 IndexTTS-2.5 支持中英日西阿五种语言，具备细粒度情感、语速和发音控制，推理速度比 2.0 更快。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型动物园（IndexTTS-1.5/2/2.5）、演示页面、论文链接，以及 ModelScope 和 HuggingFace 上的模型权重与在线 Demo。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖深度学习框架（如 PyTorch）和音频处理库，支持多语言音素（拼音/CMU/假名）。
zh.hot: 凭借工业级可控性和高效零样本克隆能力，在 GitHub 周榜 Python 类排名第 9，一周新增 598 星，总星数超 2.3 万。多语言和细粒度控制吸引大量开发者和内容创作者。
uses: 语音合成研究者：对比实验和模型改进的基线
内容创作者：快速生成多语言配音和有声内容
开发者：集成到应用或服务中实现个性化语音助手

en.tag: Industrial-level controllable zero-shot TTS system
en.what: IndexTTS is a zero-shot text-to-speech system that clones a voice from a single reference audio clip. The latest IndexTTS-2.5 supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, and Arabic, with fine-grained emotion, speed, and pronunciation control, and faster inference than v2.
en.content: The repo includes a model zoo (IndexTTS-1.5/2/2.5), demo pages, paper links, and model weights on ModelScope and HuggingFace with online demos.
en.stack: Python-based, relies on deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and audio processing libraries, supports multilingual phonemes (Pinyin/CMU/Kana).
en.hot: With industrial-grade controllability and efficient zero-shot cloning, it ranks #9 on GitHub Trending (Python) with +598 stars this week, totaling over 23k. Multilingual support and fine-grained control attract developers and creators.
uses: TTS researchers: baseline for experiments and improvements
Content creators: quickly generate multilingual voiceovers
Developers: integrate into apps for personalized voice assistants

zh.tag: 开源 OSINT 自动化工具，用于威胁情报与攻击面测绘
zh.what: SpiderFoot 是一个开源情报（OSINT）自动化工具，集成大量数据源并利用多种分析方法，帮助用户收集、分析数据并导航。它提供基于 Web 的界面和命令行两种使用方式，支持攻击面监控和威胁情报收集。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SpiderFoot 的完整源代码，包括 200 多个模块、Web 界面、CLI、YAML 配置的相关性引擎（含 37 个预定义规则）、CSV/JSON/GEXF 导出、SQLite 后端、Dockerfile 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.7+ 编写，依赖包括 SQLite、YAML、Docker，并集成 TOR、DNSTwist、Whatweb、Nmap 和 CMSeeK 等外部工具。
zh.hot: SpiderFoot 拥有 20k+ 星标，今日新增 74 星，因其在网络安全领域的重要性和长期活跃开发（自 2012 年）而广受欢迎，成为 OSINT 和攻击面管理的首选工具。
uses: 安全分析师：用于威胁情报收集和攻击面测绘。
渗透测试人员：在授权评估中快速侦察目标信息。
DevOps/安全团队：持续监控外部资产暴露面。
研究人员：探索 OSINT 数据源和分析方法。

en.tag: Open-source OSINT automation for threat intelligence and attack surface mapping
en.what: SpiderFoot is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) automation tool that integrates with numerous data sources and employs various analysis methods to help users collect, analyze, and navigate data. It offers both a web-based interface and command-line usage, supporting attack surface monitoring and threat intelligence gathering.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of SpiderFoot, including 200+ modules, web UI, CLI, YAML-configurable correlation engine with 37 pre-defined rules, CSV/JSON/GEXF export, SQLite backend, Dockerfile, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python 3.7+, with dependencies including SQLite, YAML, Docker, and integrations with external tools like TOR, DNSTwist, Whatweb, Nmap, and CMSeeK.
en.hot: With 20k+ stars and 74 new stars today, SpiderFoot's popularity stems from its critical role in cybersecurity and its active development since 2012, making it a go-to tool for OSINT and attack surface management.
uses: Security analysts: for threat intelligence gathering and attack surface mapping.
Penetration testers: for rapid reconnaissance during authorized assessments.
DevOps/security teams: for continuous monitoring of external asset exposure.
Researchers: to explore OSINT data sources and analysis methods.

zh.tag: 让 AI 编码代理遵循规范开发流程的开源工具包
zh.what: Spec Kit 是一个开源工具包，旨在帮助开发团队在编写代码之前先定义规范，然后让 AI 编码代理根据这些规范直接生成实现。它提供了一套即用型的规范驱动流程，也可自定义扩展，支持整个组织协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Specify CLI 命令行工具、文档、示例规范、扩展与预设（presets）、基于角色的捆绑包（bundles），以及社区贡献的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖 uv 进行包管理，可通过 PyPI 或 Git 安装。
zh.hot: 凭借 12.8 万星标和日增 1160 星的热度，它抓住了 AI 编码代理时代对结构化开发流程的需求，由 GitHub 官方出品，可信度高。
uses: 开发团队：希望用 AI 代理提高编码效率，同时保持代码质量与一致性
技术负责人：需要为团队制定标准化开发流程，并确保 AI 工具遵循规范
AI 工具开发者：希望集成或扩展规范驱动开发流程的开发者

en.tag: Open-source toolkit for spec-driven development with any AI coding agent
en.what: Spec Kit is an open-source toolkit that helps teams define specifications before writing code, then lets AI coding agents generate implementations directly from those specs. It provides a ready-to-use spec-driven process, is extensible, and supports organization-wide collaboration.
en.content: The repository includes the Specify CLI tool, documentation, example specs, extensions and presets, role-based bundles, and community-contributed integrations.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, uses uv for package management, installable via PyPI or Git.
en.hot: With 128k stars and +1,160 stars today, it taps into the need for structured development processes in the AI coding agent era, backed by GitHub official, boosting credibility.
uses: Development teams: want to use AI agents for coding efficiency while maintaining quality and consistency
Tech leads: need to establish standardized development processes and ensure AI tools follow specs
AI tool developers: those looking to integrate or extend spec-driven development workflows

zh.tag: 模块化节点式 AI 创作引擎，支持图像/视频/3D/音频生成
zh.what: ComfyUI 是一个功能强大且模块化的 AI 内容创作引擎，提供图形化节点界面，让用户能够精细控制每个模型、参数和输出。它支持最新的开源模型，并通过 API 节点接入顶级闭源模型，可用于生成图像、视频、3D 模型和音频等。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 ComfyUI 源代码，包括前端界面、后端 API、节点图编辑器、示例工作流、文档和安装脚本。项目结构清晰，支持桌面应用、便携版和云端部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型格式。前端可能涉及 JavaScript/TypeScript，但核心后端为 Python。
zh.hot: ComfyUI 凭借其强大的模块化节点界面和广泛的模型支持，成为 AI 创作者的首选工具。本周新增 1505 星，总星数达 124k，持续位居 GitHub 趋势榜，社区活跃，生态丰富。
uses: AI 艺术家和设计师：通过可视化节点工作流生成高质量图像、视频和 3D 内容。
开发者：利用 API 集成 ComfyUI 到生产管线，构建 AI 应用。
研究人员：快速实验最新模型，定制和优化生成流程。
教育者：在教学中演示 AI 生成原理和模型工作流程。

en.tag: Modular node-based AI engine for image, video, 3D, audio generation
en.what: ComfyUI is a powerful and modular AI content creation engine with a graph/nodes interface, giving users fine-grained control over every model, parameter, and output. It natively supports the latest open-source models and provides API nodes for top closed-source models, enabling generation of images, videos, 3D models, audio, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of ComfyUI, including the frontend UI, backend API, node graph editor, example workflows, documentation, and installation scripts. The project is well-structured, supporting desktop app, portable install, and cloud deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, leveraging PyTorch and other deep learning frameworks, supporting various model formats. The frontend may involve JavaScript/TypeScript, but the core backend is Python.
en.hot: ComfyUI has become the go-to tool for AI creators due to its powerful modular node interface and broad model support. With 1,505 stars added this week and a total of 124k stars, it consistently ranks on GitHub Trending, backed by an active community and rich ecosystem.
uses: AI artists and designers: create high-quality images, videos, and 3D content via visual node workflows.
Developers: integrate ComfyUI into production pipelines via API to build AI applications.
Researchers: quickly experiment with latest models, customize and optimize generation pipelines.
Educators: demonstrate AI generation principles and model workflows in teaching.

zh.tag: 项目式编程教程大全，按语言分类
zh.what: 这是一个精选的编程教程列表，旨在帮助开发者从零开始构建完整的应用程序。教程按编程语言分类，涵盖多种技术和语言，适合通过实践学习。

进阶开发者：学习新语言或技术栈
教育者：作为教学案例参考
自学者：寻找系统性的项目练习

en.tag: Curated project-based tutorials by language
en.what: A curated list of programming tutorials for building applications from scratch, organized by language, covering multiple technologies and languages.
en.content: Contains tutorial links for 20+ languages like C/C++, Python, JavaScript, each with specific project tutorials such as building interpreters, OS, games, etc.
en.stack: Plain Markdown repo, no specific tech stack, relies on community contributions.

Advanced devs: learn new languages/stacks
Educators: reference for teaching cases
Self-learners: find systematic project exercises

zh.tag: AI 代理团队的企业级编排平台
zh.what: Paperclip 是一个开源应用，用于管理工作场景中的 AI 代理团队。它允许用户自带代理，分配目标，并在一个仪表盘中跟踪工作进度和成本。它像任务管理器，但底层包含组织架构、预算、治理、目标对齐和代理协调。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Node.js 服务器和 React UI，用于编排 AI 代理团队。提供快速入门指南、文档、Discord 社区链接，并支持与 OpenClaw、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 Bash 等集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 和 React 构建。依赖包括各种 AI 代理提供商（如 Claude、Codex）和工具（如 Bash）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理在工作场景中的普及，Paperclip 提供了管理代理团队的企业级解决方案，填补了市场空白。其 76k+ 的 star 数表明社区高度关注，今日新增 198 星，位列日榜第五。
uses: 企业团队：需要协调多个 AI 代理完成业务目标的管理者。
开发者：希望为代理分配任务并监控其表现的工程师。
AI 爱好者：探索如何将 AI 代理应用于实际业务流程的实践者。

en.tag: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents
en.what: Paperclip is an open-source app for managing AI agents at work. It lets you bring your own agents, assign goals, and track work and costs from one dashboard. It looks like a task manager but underneath handles org charts, budgets, governance, goal alignment, and agent coordination.
en.content: The repo contains a Node.js server and React UI for orchestrating teams of AI agents. It includes a quickstart guide, docs, Discord community link, and integrations with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Bash.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, primarily using Node.js and React. It integrates with various AI agent providers (e.g., Claude, Codex) and tools like Bash.
en.hot: As AI agents become common in the workplace, Paperclip offers an enterprise-grade solution for managing agent teams, filling a market gap. Its 76k+ stars show high community interest, with 198 new stars today, ranking 5th on the daily trending list.
uses: Enterprise teams: managers needing to coordinate multiple AI agents to achieve business goals.
Developers: engineers who want to assign tasks to agents and monitor their performance.
AI enthusiasts: practitioners exploring how to apply AI agents to real-world business processes.

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Vite+ (enhanced Vite), depends on each agent's CLI tool (Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, total 14459, ranked #18 on TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for a unified multi-agent management UI, attracting many developers interested in AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want to switch between multiple AI coding assistants in one interface
Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果

en.stack: Built on TypeScript with npm-based monorepo tooling and lifecycle scripts. Supports major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and offers containerization via Docker or Gondolin micro-VM.
en.hot: It gained 2,741 stars this week, landing at #17 on GitHub's TypeScript Weekly Trending with over 72.2k total stars. The combination of a unified LLM API and a self-extensible coding agent has drawn strong developer interest.
uses: Developers building multi-model AI agents — unified API reduces integration overhead
CLI users preferring terminal-native experiences — built-in TUI with diff rendering

en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, leveraging browser automation tools (e.g., Playwright) and CLI tools, likely integrating LLM APIs for intelligent analysis.

zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Zed 编辑器源代码，涵盖编辑器核心、协作功能、UI 组件、以及针对各平台的构建脚本和文档。还包含贡献指南、许可证信息以及第三方依赖的许可证管理工具。

zh.hot: 凭借其卓越的性能和多人协作特性，Zed 在开发者中广受好评，目前拥有 88k+ 星标，今日新增 81，持续位列 Rust 趋势榜前列。
uses: 追求极致响应速度和流畅编辑体验的开发者
需要实时多人协作编码的团队
对 Rust 或编辑器开发感兴趣的开源贡献者
希望使用现代、高性能编辑器的程序员

en.tag: High-performance multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter
en.what: Zed is a high-performance multiplayer code editor written in Rust, available on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It emphasizes lightning-fast responsiveness and seamless real-time collaboration, aiming to let developers 'code at the speed of thought'.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the Zed editor, including the editor core, collaboration features, UI components, and build scripts and documentation for each platform. It also includes contribution guidelines, license information, and tools for managing third-party dependency licenses.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Tree-sitter for syntax parsing, using cargo-about for open-source license compliance, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With its outstanding performance and multiplayer collaboration features, Zed has gained wide acclaim among developers, currently holding 88k+ stars, with 81 added today, consistently ranking high on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers seeking ultimate responsiveness and smooth editing experience
Teams needing real-time collaborative coding
Open-source contributors interested in Rust or editor development
Programmers wanting a modern, high-performance editor

zh.tag: 零配置终端 IDE，VS Code 体验搬进终端
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能全面的终端文本编辑器，无需任何配置即可使用。它提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，让用户无需学习曲线即可上手。
zh.content: 仓库包含编辑器源代码、文档、安装脚本和演示 GIF。核心功能包括命令面板、模糊查找、多光标编辑、主题定制、LSP 支持、多任务编排器等。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库和 LSP 客户端等。
zh.hot: 凭借零配置、易用性和高性能（可处理多 GB 文件）在开发者中迅速流行，star 数已超 8 千。
uses: 喜欢在终端工作但希望有现代编辑器体验的开发者
需要快速编辑大文件或进行多任务处理的用户
寻求轻量级 IDE 替代品的程序员

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE with VS Code-like UX
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor that works with zero configuration. It offers familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features, requiring no learning curve.
en.content: The repository contains the editor's source code, documentation, installation scripts, and demo GIFs. Key features include command palette, fuzzy finder, multi-cursor editing, themes, LSP support, and an orchestrator for multitasking.
en.stack: Written in Rust, with dependencies on terminal UI libraries and LSP client.
en.hot: Gaining popularity due to its zero-config, ease of use, and high performance (handles multi-GB files), with over 8k stars.
uses: Developers who work in the terminal but want a modern editor experience
Users needing to edit large files quickly or multitask
Programmers seeking a lightweight IDE alternative

zh.tag: 缠论量化交易工具，Rust 核心加速
zh.what: czsc 是一个基于缠中说禅技术分析理论的量化交易工具库，提供分型、笔、中枢等核心算法的自动识别，并实现了信号-事件-交易的完整量化逻辑体系。它支持股票、期货等市场，内置 220+ 信号函数，可用于策略研究与自动交易。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包 czsc，采用 Rust + Python 混合架构：Rust 实现核心算法（通过 PyO3 暴露），Python 端提供交易门面、数据连接器、策略框架、可视化工具等。底层 Rust workspace 包含 9 个 crate。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python（≥3.10）和 Rust，使用 PyO3 绑定；依赖包括 pandas、numpy、plotly、lightweight-charts 等，支持多种数据源（天勤、Tushare、CCXT）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 50 stars，总星数 5816，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust 榜第 6）。缠论在中文量化圈有高热度，而 Rust 重写核心算法大幅提升性能，吸引大量用户关注。
uses: 量化研究员：利用缠论信号构建策略并回测
交易爱好者：学习缠论并实现自动化交易
开发者：基于 Rust 核心扩展自定义信号函数
数据科学家：结合多数据源进行市场分析

en.tag: Chan Theory quant trading toolkit with Rust core acceleration
en.what: czsc is a quantitative trading toolkit based on Chan Theory (缠中说禅), providing automatic recognition of fractals, strokes, and pivots, along with a complete signal-event-trade logic system. It supports stocks, futures, and other markets, with 220+ built-in signal functions for strategy research and automated trading.
en.content: The repo contains the Python package czsc with a Rust+Python hybrid architecture: core algorithms in Rust (exposed via PyO3), and Python-facing modules for trading API, data connectors, strategy framework, and visualization. The underlying Rust workspace has 9 crates.
en.stack: Main languages are Python (≥3.10) and Rust, with PyO3 bindings; dependencies include pandas, numpy, plotly, lightweight-charts, and supports data sources like Tushare, CCXT, and local cache.
en.hot: Gained 50 stars today, total 5816, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending (Rust). Chan Theory is highly popular in Chinese quant circles, and the Rust rewrite of core algorithms significantly boosts performance, attracting attention.
uses: Quant researchers: build and backtest strategies using Chan signals
Trading enthusiasts: learn Chan Theory and automate trading
Developers: extend custom signal functions on the Rust core
Data scientists: analyze markets with multiple data sources

zh.tag: 终端里的开源编码代理，自带模型自由组合
zh.what: CodeWhale 是一个开源的终端编码代理，允许用户自带模型，支持多种模型和提供商，优先开放模型。它能够读取代码、编辑文件、运行命令并自我检查，直到任务完成或需要用户介入。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具、TUI 界面、无头模式（exec）、Web 客户端，以及多语言 README 和文档。支持通过 npm、Cargo、Docker 等方式安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，通过 npm 和 crates.io 分发，支持多种模型提供商 API。
zh.hot: Star 数超 4 万，今日新增 45，因其独特的“按角色选模型”设计而受到关注，允许不同任务使用不同模型，灵活性和社区驱动特性吸引大量用户。
uses: 开发者日常编码辅助，直接在终端中运行，支持多模型切换。
需要在 CI/CD 中自动化代码修复和测试的团队。
喜欢定制化 AI 工作流的高级用户，可自定义角色和规则。
从 deepseek-tui 迁移的用户，配置和会话可无缝衔接。

en.tag: Open-source coding agent in your terminal, bring your own model and mix roles freely
en.what: CodeWhale is an open-source coding agent for the terminal that lets you bring your own model, supporting a wide range of models and providers with open models first. It reads your code, edits files, runs commands, and checks its own work until the job is done or it needs you.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust CLI tool, TUI, headless mode (exec), web client, and multilingual READMEs and docs. Install via npm, Cargo, Docker, etc.
en.stack: Written in Rust, distributed via npm and crates.io, integrates with various model provider APIs.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 45 new today, it's hot for its unique 'pick a model per role' design, allowing different models for different tasks, and its community-driven, flexible approach.
uses: Developers seeking a terminal-based coding assistant with multi-model support.
Teams automating code fixes and tests in CI/CD pipelines.
Power users who want to customize AI workflows with custom roles and rules.
Users migrating from deepseek-tui, with seamless config and session transfer.

zh.tag: 零知识跨链桥，去信任高安全，兼容 Cosmos 与 EVM
zh.what: Union 是一个基于零知识证明的跨链桥协议，旨在实现去信任、抗审查和极高安全性的资产转移与通用消息传递。它不依赖可信第三方、预言机或多签，而是通过共识验证和 IBC 协议实现跨链互操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：节点实现 uniond、零知识证明器 galoisd、跨生态中继器 voyager、CosmWasm 和 EVM 智能合约、轻客户端、节点管理工具 unionvisor、水龙头、前端应用和 TypeScript SDK。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，也涉及 Go、Solidity、TypeScript 等；依赖 CometBLS、Gnark、CosmWasm、Svelte、Astro 等。
zh.hot: 凭借零知识证明实现的高安全性和去信任特性，在 DeFi 领域备受关注，尽管本周新增 star 不多，但总星数已超 7.3 万，位列 Rust 周榜前列。
uses: DeFi 开发者：构建跨链资产转移和消息传递应用
Cosmos 生态项目：通过 IBC 与 EVM 链互操作
安全敏感场景：需要去信任桥接的机构或协议

en.tag: Trust-minimized ZK bridging protocol for Cosmos & EVM, high security
en.what: Union is a zero-knowledge based bridging protocol designed for trust-minimized, censorship-resistant, and highly secure asset transfers and general message passing. It relies on consensus verification and IBC, without trusted third parties, oracles, or multisig.
en.content: The repo contains multiple components: uniond node, galoisd prover, voyager relayer, CosmWasm and EVM contracts, light clients, unionvisor, faucet, frontend apps, and TypeScript SDK.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with Go, Solidity, TypeScript; uses CometBLS, Gnark, CosmWasm, Svelte, Astro.
en.hot: Its high security and trust-minimized design via ZK proofs attract DeFi attention; despite modest weekly stars, total stars exceed 73k, ranking high in Rust weekly.
uses: DeFi developers building cross-chain asset transfers and messaging
Cosmos ecosystem projects needing EVM interoperability via IBC
Security-sensitive use cases requiring trust-minimized bridging

zh.tag: 用 Rust 构建的开源 CAD 应用，支持 DWG/DXF 与 GPU 渲染
zh.what: OpenCAD Studio (OCS) 是一个用 Rust 编写的 CAD 应用，用于 2D 制图和 3D 建模。它原生读写 DWG 和 DXF 文件，并提供 GPU 加速渲染，还推出了可在浏览器中运行的 Web 版本。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CAD 功能集：2D 绘图命令（LINE、CIRCLE、HATCH 等）、3D 建模（EXTRUDE、REVOLVE、LOFT 等）、标注与尺寸、图纸空间布局，以及 DWG/DXF/STL/STEP/OBJ/PDF 等文件格式支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPU 加速渲染（可能通过 wgpu 或类似库），并支持编译为 WebAssembly 以提供 Web 版本。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 194 星，总星数达 577，登上 Rust 语言日榜第 2。其亮点在于用 Rust 实现专业级 CAD 功能，且提供 Web 版，吸引开发者关注。
uses: CAD 爱好者或专业人士，希望使用开源、跨平台的 2D/3D 设计工具
Rust 开发者，对图形编程、CAD 内核或 WebAssembly 感兴趣
需要处理 DWG/DXF 文件的工程师或设计师，寻找免费替代方案
教育场景，用于学习 CAD 概念或 Rust 在复杂应用中的实践

en.tag: An open-source CAD application built with Rust, supporting DWG/DXF and GPU-accelerated rendering
en.what: OpenCAD Studio (OCS) is a CAD application written in Rust for 2D drafting and 3D modeling. It natively reads and writes DWG and DXF files, offers GPU-accelerated rendering, and also has a web version that runs in the browser.
en.content: The repository includes a full-featured CAD suite: 2D drafting commands (LINE, CIRCLE, HATCH, etc.), 3D modeling (EXTRUDE, REVOLVE, LOFT, etc.), annotations and dimensions, paper space layouts, and support for file formats like DWG/DXF/STL/STEP/OBJ/PDF.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, leveraging GPU-accelerated rendering (likely via wgpu or similar), and compiles to WebAssembly for the web version.
en.hot: It's gaining rapid traction on GitHub, with 194 stars added today and a total of 577, ranking #2 on the Rust daily trending list. Its appeal lies in delivering professional CAD features in Rust with a web version, drawing developer attention.
uses: CAD enthusiasts or professionals seeking an open-source, cross-platform 2D/3D design tool
Rust developers interested in graphics programming, CAD kernels, or WebAssembly
Engineers or designers who need to work with DWG/DXF files and want a free alternative
Educational use, to learn CAD concepts or Rust in complex applications

zh.tag: Git 仓库密钥扫描与泄露检测工具
zh.what: Gitleaks 是一个用于检测 Git 仓库、文件或标准输入中是否存在密码、API 密钥、令牌等敏感信息的工具。它通过正则表达式和熵分析来识别潜在的泄露，并输出详细的报告，包括文件、行号、提交等信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，支持通过 Homebrew、Docker、Go 或二进制安装，并可集成到 pre-commit 钩子或 GitHub Action 中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖正则表达式库和熵计算，支持多种平台和容器化部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 215 星，总星数达 28786，位列 GitHub 周榜（Go）第一。其功能完善且维护者宣布转向新项目，引发关注。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中自动扫描代码泄露
安全团队审计历史提交中的敏感信息
个人开发者本地检查仓库泄露风险

en.tag: Scan git repos for secrets, passwords, API keys, and tokens
en.what: Gitleaks is a tool for detecting secrets like passwords, API keys, and tokens in git repos, files, and stdin. It uses regex and entropy analysis to identify potential leaks and outputs detailed reports including file, line, commit, and more.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI tool, installable via Homebrew, Docker, Go, or binaries, and can be integrated into pre-commit hooks or GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging regex and entropy calculation, with support for multiple platforms and containerized deployment.
en.hot: Gained 215 stars this week, total 28,786, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its feature-complete status and maintainer's shift to a new project drew attention.
uses: Developers scanning for leaks in CI/CD pipelines
Security teams auditing historical commits for sensitive data
Individual developers checking repos locally for exposure

zh.tag: 开源 RAG 引擎，融合 Agent 能力，为 LLM 构建上下文层
zh.what: RAGFlow 是一个领先的开源检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，将前沿的 RAG 技术与 Agent 能力相结合，为大型语言模型（LLM）提供高质量的上下文层。它支持深度文档理解、基于模板的文本切片、可配置的 Agent 工作流，以及基于引用的可追溯回答，确保输出的准确性和可验证性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 RAGFlow 系统，包括后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 界面、Agent 工作流编排、文档解析与索引模块，以及 Docker 部署配置。提供多语言 README、云服务入口和详细文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发后端，前端基于 Web 技术；依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，集成多种 LLM 和向量数据库，支持深度文档理解与 RAG 流程。
zh.hot: RAGFlow 凭借其将 RAG 与 Agent 结合的创新理念，以及强大的文档处理能力和可追溯回答，在 GitHub 上获得 87k+ 星标，今日新增 85 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 20 名，持续受到开发者社区的高度关注。
uses: 企业知识库构建：利用 RAGFlow 搭建内部文档问答系统，提升信息检索效率。
AI 应用开发者：集成 RAGFlow 作为 LLM 应用的上下文层，增强回答准确性和可追溯性。
研究机构：用于学术文献的深度解析和知识抽取，辅助研究分析。
开源爱好者：学习 RAG 与 Agent 结合的架构设计，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: Open-source RAG engine fusing RAG with Agent capabilities for LLM context layer
en.what: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs. It supports deep document understanding, template-based chunking, configurable Agent workflows, and citation-based traceable answers, ensuring accuracy and verifiability.
en.content: The repository contains the full RAGFlow system, including backend services (written in Go), frontend web UI, Agent workflow orchestration, document parsing and indexing modules, and Docker deployment configurations. It provides multi-language READMEs, cloud service entry, and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Backend primarily developed in Go, frontend based on web technologies; relies on Docker for containerized deployment, integrates multiple LLMs and vector databases, supporting deep document understanding and RAG pipelines.
en.hot: RAGFlow has gained 87k+ stars on GitHub due to its innovative fusion of RAG with Agent capabilities, powerful document processing, and traceable answers. With 85 new stars today, it ranks #20 on the Go trending list, maintaining high attention from the developer community.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Build internal document Q&A systems to improve information retrieval efficiency.
AI app developers: Integrate RAGFlow as a context layer for LLM applications, enhancing answer accuracy and traceability.
Research institutions: Use for deep parsing and knowledge extraction of academic literature to aid research analysis.
Open-source enthusiasts: Learn the architecture of combining RAG with Agent and contribute to the community.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 原生作业排队与准入管理
zh.what: Kueue 是一组 API 和控制器，用于在 Kubernetes 上实现作业级排队。它决定作业何时被准入（开始创建 Pod）以及何时停止（删除活跃 Pod），支持基于优先级的多种排队策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kueue 的控制器、API 定义、文档站点以及示例。核心概念包括 ClusterQueue、LocalQueue 和 Workload，提供公平共享、抢占、资源 flavor 互换等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 Kubernetes 的 controller-runtime 构建，与集群自动缩放器集成，支持 Prometheus 指标。
zh.hot: 随着 Kubernetes 上 AI/ML 工作负载（如 Kubeflow、Ray）的增多，对作业排队的需求上升。Kueue 作为 CNCF 沙箱项目，提供原生解决方案，今日新增 22 星，总星数 2827，持续受到关注。
uses: 平台团队：为多租户 Kubernetes 集群提供统一的作业排队和资源配额管理。
AI/ML 工程师：运行 Kubeflow、Ray 等训练作业，需要优先级和抢占控制。
SRE/运维：通过公平共享和队列策略优化集群资源利用率。

en.tag: Kubernetes-native job queueing and admission control
en.what: Kueue is a set of APIs and controllers for job-level queueing on Kubernetes. It decides when a job should be admitted (pods can be created) and when it should stop (active pods deleted), supporting priority-based queueing strategies.
en.content: The repo contains the Kueue controller, API definitions, documentation site, and examples. Core concepts include ClusterQueue, LocalQueue, and Workload, with features like fair sharing, preemption, and flavor fungibility.
en.stack: Developed in Go, built on Kubernetes controller-runtime, integrates with cluster-autoscaler, and supports Prometheus metrics.
en.hot: With the rise of AI/ML workloads on Kubernetes (e.g., Kubeflow, Ray), demand for job queueing grows. As a CNCF sandbox project, Kueue offers a native solution; gaining 22 stars today (total 2827) reflects sustained interest.
uses: Platform teams: provide unified job queueing and resource quota management for multi-tenant K8s clusters.
AI/ML engineers: run training jobs like Kubeflow or Ray with priority and preemption control.
SRE/ops: optimize cluster resource utilization via fair sharing and queue strategies.

zh.tag: 把AI编码代理当队友分配任务的协作工作台
zh.what: Multica 是一个开源工作台，让你像给队友派活一样把 issue 分配给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 20 种编码代理。代理会自动接单、在可控运行时中工作、实时评论并交回审查，所有上下文和决策都关联到同一 issue。支持自托管，无锁定。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Go 后端、Web 前端（看板界面）、文档（README、自托管指南、愿景）、以及用于集成 20 种代理 CLI 的运行时适配器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 构建后端，前端为 Web 应用，支持多种代理 CLI 的集成，自托管部署。
zh.hot: 44.5k stars 且单日新增 274，登上 Go 趋势榜第二，因为解决了多代理协作中上下文丢失和重复解释的痛点，将代理真正纳入团队流程。
uses: 开发者团队：统一管理多个编码代理，减少切换和重复沟通成本
技术负责人：将代理分配为团队成员，通过看板跟踪进度和审查结果
自托管用户：对数据隐私有要求，希望完全掌控代理运行环境

en.tag: Assign issues to AI coding agents like teammates in an open-source workspace
en.what: Multica is an open-source workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 20 others, just as you would to a teammate. Agents pick up issues, work in a runtime you control, comment as they go, and hand back for review, keeping context and decisions tied to the issue. Self-hostable with no lock-in.
en.content: The repo contains the core Go backend, a web frontend (board UI), documentation (README, self-hosting guide, vision), and runtime adapters for integrating 20 agent CLIs.
en.stack: Built primarily with Go for the backend, with a web frontend, and integrations for multiple agent CLIs; supports self-hosting.
en.hot: With 44.5k stars and +274 today, ranking #2 on Go trending, it solves the pain of context loss and repeated explanations when managing multiple agents, integrating them into team workflows.
uses: Dev teams: manage multiple coding agents in one place, reducing context switching and repeated explanations
Tech leads: assign agents as team members, track progress and review via board
Self-hosters: need data privacy and full control over agent runtimes

zh.tag: 内网穿透神器，快速反向代理
zh.what: frp 是一个高性能反向代理应用，用于将位于 NAT 或防火墙后面的本地服务器暴露到互联网。它支持 TCP、UDP、HTTP、HTTPS 协议，并可通过域名将请求转发到内部服务，还提供 P2P 连接模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 frp 的完整源代码、文档（中英文）、配置示例、架构说明以及用于构建和测试的脚本。主要组件包括 frps（服务端）和 frpc（客户端），支持多种代理类型和高级功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖标准库和少量第三方库（如 yaml.v2、v2ray 等），支持跨平台编译，可运行于 Linux、Windows、macOS 等系统。

zh.tag: 开源智能代码审查，基准测试第一
zh.what: PR-AF 是一个基于 AgentField 构建的开源智能代码审查工具，在 Martian Code-Review-Bench 上排名第一。它将每个 PR 转化为任务特定的审查计划，生成专注的审查代理，以代码证据为基础，挑战结果，从而从更便宜的模型中提取更多有用的审查情报。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心审查引擎、CLI 工具、Docker 部署支持、基准测试脚本和文档。支持通过 CLI、curl、CI 或 API 触发审查，并流式输出进度和结果。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，基于 AgentField 框架，支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek、GLM-5.2、Opus 类），可通过 Docker 自托管。
zh.hot: 在 Code-Review-Bench 上超越所有商业工具，成为开源第一，且审查成本比闭源工具低约 10 倍。本周新增 78 星，登上 GitHub 周榜。
uses: 开源项目维护者：希望用低成本获得高质量代码审查，提升代码质量。
CI/CD 集成：将 PR-AF 作为自动化审查步骤，在合并前捕获 bug。
AI 研究者：研究智能体代码审查的基准和方法。
企业团队：需要自托管、模型灵活的代码审查方案。

en.tag: Open-source agentic code review, #1 on Code-Review-Bench
en.what: PR-AF is an open-source agentic code review tool built on AgentField, ranking #1 on Martian Code-Review-Bench. It turns each PR into a task-specific review plan, spawns focused reviewer agents, grounds findings in code evidence, and challenges results to extract more useful review intelligence from cheaper models.
en.content: The repository includes the core review engine, CLI tool, Docker deployment support, benchmark scripts, and documentation. Reviews can be triggered via CLI, curl, CI, or API, with live progress streaming and result output.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, built on the AgentField framework, supports multiple models (e.g., DeepSeek, GLM-5.2, Opus-class), and can be self-hosted via Docker.
en.hot: It tops the Code-Review-Bench among all tools, becoming #1 open-source, with review costs about 10x cheaper than closed-source tools. Gained 78 stars this week, hitting the GitHub weekly trending list.
uses: Open-source maintainers: want high-quality code review at low cost to improve code quality.
CI/CD integration: use PR-AF as an automated review step to catch bugs before merge.
AI researchers: study benchmarks and methods for agentic code review.
Enterprise teams: need self-hosted, model-flexible code review solutions.

zh.tag: 原生集成AI代理的Windows终端
zh.what: Intelligent Terminal是Windows Terminal的实验性分支，原生集成了AI代理功能。它支持任何符合Agent Client Protocol (ACP)的代理CLI，如GitHub Copilot CLI，使用户能在命令行中直接与AI交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端应用源码，基于Windows Terminal，新增了代理状态栏、代理面板、代理管理、错误检测和命令面板等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++开发，依赖Windows Terminal的代码库，并遵循ACP协议与代理CLI通信。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，将AI代理直接集成到终端，吸引了大量开发者关注，今日新增26星，登上GitHub Trending C++日榜第三。
uses: 开发者：在命令行中直接使用AI代理辅助编码，如代码生成、错误排查。
Windows用户：喜欢Windows Terminal但希望集成AI功能的用户。
AI爱好者：希望体验ACP协议和AI代理集成的新兴技术。

en.tag: Windows Terminal fork with native AI agent integration
en.what: Intelligent Terminal is an experimental fork of Windows Terminal with native agent integration. It works with any Agent Client Protocol (ACP)-compatible agent CLI, such as GitHub Copilot CLI, enabling direct AI interaction within the command line.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the terminal application, based on Windows Terminal, with added features like agent status bar, agent pane, agent management, error detection, and command palette.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, building upon the Windows Terminal codebase, and communicates with agent CLIs via the ACP protocol.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it integrates AI agents directly into the terminal, attracting significant developer attention with 26 stars today, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending for C++.
uses: Developers: Use AI agents directly in the command line for coding assistance, such as code generation and error debugging.
Windows users: Those who like Windows Terminal but want integrated AI features.
AI enthusiasts: Those interested in experiencing ACP protocol and emerging AI agent integration.

zh.tag: 真正独立的现代网页浏览器，基于全新引擎
zh.what: Ladybird 是一个真正独立的网页浏览器，采用基于 Web 标准的新颖引擎，旨在构建完整、可用的现代浏览器。它目前处于预 alpha 阶段，仅适合开发者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器的主要源代码，采用多进程架构，包括 UI 主进程、多个 WebContent 渲染进程、ImageDecoder 进程和 RequestServer 进程。核心库组件继承自 SerenityOS，如 LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SerenityOS 的多个库（LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等），支持 Linux、macOS、Windows（WSL2）等平台。
zh.hot: 作为真正独立的浏览器项目，Ladybird 在开发者中引起广泛关注，star 数已达 64,842，今日新增 42，位列 C++ 日榜第一。
uses: 对浏览器引擎感兴趣的开发者，可以学习其架构和实现。
希望参与开源浏览器项目贡献的开发者。
关注 Web 标准和技术前沿的技术爱好者。

en.tag: A truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine
en.what: Ladybird is a truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine, aiming to build a complete, usable browser for the modern web. It is currently in pre-alpha state and only suitable for developers.
en.content: The repository contains the main source code of the browser, using a multi-process architecture with a main UI process, several WebContent renderer processes, an ImageDecoder process, and a RequestServer process. Core library components are inherited from SerenityOS, such as LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on several SerenityOS libraries (LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.), supporting Linux, macOS, Windows (with WSL2), and other *NIXes.
en.hot: As a truly independent browser project, Ladybird has gained significant attention among developers, with 64,842 stars and 42 new stars today, ranking first on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers interested in browser engines, to learn its architecture and implementation.
Developers who want to contribute to an open-source browser project.
Tech enthusiasts following web standards and cutting-edge technology.

zh.tag: 1-bit LLM 官方推理框架，CPU 上高效运行
zh.what: BitNet 是微软推出的 1-bit 大语言模型推理框架，旨在让超低比特量化模型在 CPU 上高效运行。它支持 BitNet b1.58 等三元模型，并提供优化的内核和工具链，实现接近全精度模型的性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎（C++ 实现）、CPU 和 GPU 内核、模型转换工具、示例代码，以及针对嵌入模型的 I2_S 量化支持。还发布了 BitNet-embedding 系列模型和 VibeASR.cpp 等衍生项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 OpenMP 等并行库，支持 x86 (AVX2) 和 ARM (NEON) 指令集，并提供 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: BitNet 代表了 LLM 推理的极低比特量化方向，能大幅降低内存和计算需求，在 CPU 上实现高效推理。近 4 万星标表明社区对边缘部署和成本优化的强烈兴趣。
uses: 在无 GPU 的服务器或边缘设备上部署 LLM，降低硬件成本
需要低延迟、高吞吐的 CPU 推理场景，如实时语音识别（VibeASR）
研究低比特量化技术和模型压缩的开发者
构建嵌入模型应用，利用 BitNet-embedding 加速检索

en.tag: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, efficient on CPU
en.what: BitNet is Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, enabling efficient CPU deployment of ternary models like BitNet b1.58. It provides optimized kernels and tooling to achieve near-full-precision performance.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference engine (C++), CPU and GPU kernels, model conversion tools, examples, and I2_S quantization support for embedding models. It also hosts BitNet-embedding models and VibeASR.cpp.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with OpenMP for parallelism, supporting x86 (AVX2) and ARM (NEON), and offering Python bindings.
en.hot: BitNet represents the extreme low-bit quantization direction for LLM inference, drastically reducing memory and compute needs while enabling efficient CPU inference. Its ~40k stars reflect strong community interest in edge deployment and cost optimization.
uses: Deploy LLMs on CPU-only servers or edge devices to cut hardware costs
Low-latency, high-throughput CPU inference scenarios like real-time ASR (VibeASR)
Developers researching low-bit quantization and model compression
Build embedding-based applications with accelerated retrieval via BitNet-embedding

zh.tag: 基于机器学习的视频超分辨率与补帧工具
zh.what: Video2X 是一个利用机器学习模型对视频进行超分辨率放大和帧插值的框架。它通过调用 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN 等算法提升视频画质，并支持补帧使播放更流畅。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C/C++ 重写代码，提供 Windows 和 Linux 的跨平台支持，带有 GUI 和安装程序，以及命令行工具。支持多种超分辨率和补帧模型，如 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN、Real-CUGAN 和 RIFE。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C/C++ 编写，依赖 ncnn 和 Vulkan 进行 GPU 加速，支持自定义 GLSL 着色器。需要支持 AVX2 的 CPU 和支持 Vulkan 的 GPU。
zh.hot: 6.0 版本完全重写，性能大幅提升，跨平台支持更好，输出质量显著改善，吸引了大量用户。目前 star 数已超过 2 万，今日新增 31，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。
uses: 动漫爱好者：提升动漫视频分辨率和流畅度
视频创作者：修复老旧视频或低清素材
技术爱好者：探索机器学习在视频处理中的应用

en.tag: ML-based video upscaling and frame interpolation framework
en.what: Video2X is a framework that uses machine learning models to upscale videos and interpolate frames. It enhances video quality with algorithms like Anime4K and Real-ESRGAN, and supports frame interpolation for smoother playback.
en.content: The repository contains a complete C/C++ rewrite with cross-platform support for Windows and Linux, including a GUI, installer, and command-line tools. It supports various upscaling and interpolation models like Anime4K, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, and RIFE.
en.stack: Written primarily in C/C++, it leverages ncnn and Vulkan for GPU acceleration, and supports custom GLSL shaders. Requires AVX2-capable CPU and Vulkan-capable GPU.
en.hot: The 6.0 rewrite brought significant performance improvements, better cross-platform support, and enhanced output quality, attracting many users. With over 20k stars and 31 new stars today, it ranks #3 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Anime fans: upscale and smooth anime videos
Video creators: restore old or low-res footage
Tech enthusiasts: explore ML in video processing

zh.tag: 面向移动端与穿戴设备的混合边缘-云 AI 推理引擎
zh.what: Cactus 是一个专为移动设备、穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人设计的 AI 推理引擎，支持文本、语音和视觉任务。它采用混合边缘-云架构，在设备端运行量化模型，必要时可无缝切换至云端模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含四个核心组件：Cactus Engine（提供 OpenAI 兼容 API）、Cactus Graph（零拷贝计算图）、Cactus Kernels（针对 Apple、Samsung、Pixel 等设备的 CPU/GPU 内核）、Cactus Quants（基于旋转的量化技术）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持跨平台（包括 Mac、移动设备等）。集成了量化、内核优化和推理运行时，并提供 Python 绑定（可能）。
zh.hot: 凭借 5738 颗星和今日新增 22 颗星，Cactus 因填补了移动端高效 AI 推理的空白而受到关注，其混合边缘-云架构和独特的旋转量化技术吸引了开发者。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在 iOS/Android 应用中集成本地 AI 能力，如聊天、语音识别。
硬件厂商：为智能家居、机器人等设备提供低延迟、低功耗的 AI 推理方案。
边缘计算研究者：探索混合边缘-云推理和新型量化技术的实践。

en.tag: Hybrid edge-cloud AI engine for mobile, wearables, and robots
en.what: Cactus is an AI inference engine designed for mobile devices, wearables, smart home, and robots, supporting text, speech, and vision tasks. It uses a hybrid edge-cloud architecture, running quantized models on-device with seamless cloud handoff when needed.
en.content: The repo contains four core components: Cactus Engine (OpenAI-compatible APIs), Cactus Graph (zero-copy computation graph), Cactus Kernels (CPU/GPU kernels for Apple, Samsung, Pixel, etc.), and Cactus Quants (custom rotation-based quantization).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, cross-platform (including Mac and mobile). Integrates quantization, kernel optimization, and inference runtime, with possible Python bindings.
en.hot: With 5,738 stars and 22 new stars today, Cactus gains attention for filling the gap in efficient on-device AI inference, attracting developers with its hybrid edge-cloud architecture and unique rotation-based quantization.
uses: Mobile app developers: integrate on-device AI capabilities like chat and speech recognition into iOS/Android apps.
Hardware vendors: provide low-latency, low-power AI inference for smart home and robotics devices.
Edge computing researchers: explore hybrid edge-cloud inference and novel quantization techniques in practice.

zh.tag: 开源四足机器人宠物框架，STEM 与 AI 教育
zh.what: OpenCat 是一个基于 Arduino 和树莓派的开源四足机器人框架，由 Petoi 开发，用于构建和编程四足机器人宠物，如 Bittle 机器狗和 Nybble 机器猫。它处理步态协调、舵机控制和 IMU 集成等复杂部分，让开发者专注于上层应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架源代码、文档、示例和硬件支持文件，涵盖步态算法、舵机控制、IMU 集成等核心模块，并支持 Bittle 和 Nybble 等硬件平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，基于 Arduino 和树莓派生态，依赖舵机控制库和 IMU 传感器库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 104 星，总星数达 5179，位列 GitHub 周榜 C++ 第 8。其开源四足机器人框架在 STEM 教育和 AI 应用领域持续受到关注，且新硬件 Quaddle 的预告也带来了热度。
uses: STEM 教育与编程学习：适合学生和爱好者动手实践机器人技术
AI 与机器人研究：用于步态研究、强化学习和 sim2real 实验
DIY 机器人套件开发：开发者可基于框架定制自己的四足机器人
物联网与 AI 应用：作为边缘计算平台集成传感器和 AI 功能

en.tag: Open-source quadruped robot pet framework for STEM, coding & AI education
en.what: OpenCat is an open-source Arduino and Raspberry Pi-based framework for building and programming quadruped robots, developed by Petoi. It powers mini robot kits like Bittle the robot dog and Nybble the robot cat, handling gait coordination, servo control, and IMU integration so developers can focus on their own applications.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework source code, documentation, examples, and hardware support files, covering core modules like gait algorithms, servo control, and IMU integration, with support for platforms like Bittle and Nybble.
en.stack: Primarily C++, built on the Arduino and Raspberry Pi ecosystem, with dependencies on servo control and IMU sensor libraries.
en.hot: Gained 104 stars this week, reaching 5,179 total, ranking #8 on GitHub's C++ weekly trending. Its open-source quadruped robot framework remains popular in STEM education and AI applications, boosted by the upcoming Quaddle hardware announcement.
uses: STEM education and coding: hands-on robotics for students and hobbyists
AI and robotics research: gait research, reinforcement learning, and sim2real
DIY robot kit development: customize your own quadruped based on the framework
IoT and AI applications: edge computing platform with sensors and AI features

zh.tag: 在 AMD Ryzen AI NPU 上分钟级运行大模型的轻量运行时
zh.what: FastFlowLM 是一个专为 AMD Ryzen AI NPU 深度优化的 LLM 运行时，支持视觉、音频、嵌入和 MoE 模型。无需 GPU，功耗降低 10 倍以上，支持最长 256k 上下文，安装包仅 17 MB，20 秒内即可完成安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Windows 安装程序（flm-setup.msi）、Linux 入门指南、文档、基准测试和模型列表，以及 CLI 工具（如 flm run 和 flm pull）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 AMD NPU 驱动（>=32.0.203.304）和 HuggingFace 下载优化模型内核。
zh.hot: 本周新增 58 星，登上 C++ 周榜第 9，因其填补了 AMD NPU 上运行 LLM 的空白，提供类似 Ollama 的体验但专为 NPU 优化，吸引开发者和 AI 爱好者。
uses: AMD Ryzen AI 笔记本用户：无需 GPU 即可本地运行大模型，功耗更低
开发者：快速测试和部署 LLM 应用，支持 CLI 和多种模型
AI 爱好者：探索 NPU 加速的本地 AI 推理，支持视觉和音频模型

en.tag: Run LLMs on AMD Ryzen AI NPUs in minutes with an ultra-lightweight, NPU-first runtime
en.what: FastFlowLM is an NPU-first runtime built exclusively for AMD Ryzen AI, supporting vision, audio, embedding, and MoE models. It requires no GPU, is over 10x more power-efficient, supports context lengths up to 256k tokens, and installs in under 20 seconds with a 17 MB footprint.
en.content: The repo includes a Windows installer (flm-setup.msi), Linux getting-started guide, docs, benchmarks, model list, and CLI tools (e.g., flm run and flm pull).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on AMD NPU drivers (>=32.0.203.304) and downloads optimized model kernels from HuggingFace.
en.hot: With 58 stars added this week and ranking #9 on the C++ weekly trending, it fills the gap for running LLMs on AMD NPUs, offering an Ollama-like experience optimized for NPUs, attracting developers and AI enthusiasts.
uses: AMD Ryzen AI laptop users: run LLMs locally without a GPU, with lower power consumption
Developers: quickly test and deploy LLM apps via CLI with multiple model support
AI enthusiasts: explore NPU-accelerated local inference, including vision and audio models

zh.tag: 最便宜的 Flipper Zero 开源 DIY 复刻版
zh.what: FlopperZiro 是一个基于 Arduino 生态的开源多工具，灵感来自 Flipper Zero，但成本更低且完全 DIY。它面向电子爱好者、研究人员和极客，用于探索硬件协议和无线通信，支持 BadUSB、RFID/NFC、红外和 Sub-1 GHz 射频等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的硬件组件列表（如 STM32 微控制器、433MHz 收发模块、PN532 NFC 模块等）、功能说明、3D 打印外壳文件链接，以及通过 Arduino IDE 编程的固件代码。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 Arduino IDE，依赖 STM32-L432KC 微控制器及多种外设模块（如 SSD1306 OLED、MicroSD 卡、TP4056 电池管理等）。
zh.hot: 以极低成本复刻热门 Flipper Zero 的概念吸引了大量关注，本周新增 97 颗星，总星数达 2043，登上 GitHub 周榜 C++ 第 10 名。
uses: 电子爱好者：动手 DIY 一个多功能硬件工具，学习嵌入式开发
安全研究人员：测试 BadUSB、RFID/NFC 和射频信号捕获与重放
极客玩家：以低成本体验 Flipper Zero 的核心功能，并自由定制

en.tag: Cheapest open-source DIY Flipper Zero clone
en.what: FlopperZiro is an open-source, DIY, and cost-effective multi-tool inspired by the Flipper Zero, built on the Arduino ecosystem. It is designed for electronics enthusiasts, researchers, and hobbyists to explore hardware protocols and wireless communication, featuring BadUSB, RFID/NFC, IR, and Sub-1 GHz RF capabilities.
en.content: The repository includes a full hardware component list (e.g., STM32 MCU, 433MHz transceiver modules, PN532 NFC module), feature descriptions, a link to 3D-printed enclosure files, and firmware code programmable via Arduino IDE.
en.stack: Built with C++ and Arduino IDE, relying on STM32-L432KC MCU and various peripheral modules (e.g., SSD1306 OLED, MicroSD card, TP4056 battery management).
en.hot: The concept of cloning the popular Flipper Zero at minimal cost has attracted significant attention, gaining 97 stars this week and reaching 2043 total, ranking #10 on GitHub's weekly C++ trending.
uses: Electronics enthusiasts: build a multi-tool DIY project and learn embedded development
Security researchers: test BadUSB, RFID/NFC, and RF signal capture/replay
Tech hobbyists: experience core Flipper Zero features at low cost with full customization

zh.tag: Intel Arc Pro GPU 上的 GenAI 推理与多模态生成加速方案
zh.what: LLM Scaler 是 Intel 推出的 GenAI 解决方案，用于在 Intel Arc Pro B60/B70 GPU 上运行文本、图像、视频等生成模型。它基于 vLLM、ComfyUI、SGLang Diffusion、Xinference 等标准框架，确保最新 GenAI 模型在 Arc Pro GPU 上获得最佳性能。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含 Docker 镜像发布说明和更新日志，涵盖 vllm 和 omni 两个系列，支持多种模型（如 Qwen3.6、gemma-4、Muse-Glimmer-30B）和功能（如多模态、量化、LoRA 等）。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 Python，依赖 vLLM、ComfyUI、SGLang Diffusion、Xinference 等框架，以及 PyTorch 和 Intel Arc Pro GPU 的 XPU 栈。
zh.hot: 虽然 star 数不高（480），但作为 Intel 官方在 Arc Pro GPU 上的 GenAI 加速方案，更新频繁，吸引了关注 Intel 硬件 AI 生态的开发者。
uses: 在 Intel Arc Pro B60/B70 GPU 上部署 LLM 推理服务的开发者
使用 ComfyUI 进行图像/视频生成并需要优化的工作流用户
希望利用 Intel GPU 进行多模态模型实验的研究人员

en.tag: GenAI inference & multi-modal generation acceleration on Intel Arc Pro GPUs
en.what: LLM Scaler is an Intel GenAI solution for running text, image, video generation models on Intel Arc Pro B60/B70 GPUs. It leverages standard frameworks like vLLM, ComfyUI, SGLang Diffusion, Xinference to ensure best performance for state-of-the-art GenAI models on Arc Pro GPUs.
en.content: The repo mainly contains Docker image release notes and changelogs, covering vllm and omni series, supporting various models (e.g., Qwen3.6, gemma-4, Muse-Glimmer-30B) and features (multi-modal, quantization, LoRA, etc.).
en.stack: Based on C++ and Python, relies on frameworks like vLLM, ComfyUI, SGLang Diffusion, Xinference, as well as PyTorch and Intel Arc Pro GPU's XPU stack.
en.hot: Despite modest stars (480), it's Intel's official GenAI acceleration solution for Arc Pro GPUs, with frequent updates, attracting developers interested in Intel's AI hardware ecosystem.
uses: Developers deploying LLM inference on Intel Arc Pro B60/B70 GPUs
ComfyUI users needing optimized image/video generation workflows
Researchers experimenting with multi-modal models on Intel GPUs

zh.tag: 开源统一XDR与SIEM安全平台，保护端点与云负载

zh.tag: GPU 多卡通信原语库，高性能集合通信
zh.what: NCCL 是一个独立的 GPU 通信库，实现了 all-reduce、all-gather、reduce、broadcast、reduce-scatter 以及任意 send/receive 通信模式。它针对 PCIe、NVLink、NVswitch 以及 InfiniBand 或 TCP/IP 网络进行了优化，支持单节点或多节点任意数量的 GPU，可用于单进程或多进程（如 MPI）应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NCCL 库的源代码、构建脚本（支持 Debian/RPM/txz 包和 Python wheel）、测试工具（通过单独的 nccl-tests 仓库）以及文档。主要目录包括 src/（核心实现）、makefiles/（构建配置）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CUDA 工具链，支持多种 GPU 架构（通过 NVCC_GENCODE 配置）。构建系统基于 Makefile，可生成多种格式的安装包。

uses: 深度学习工程师：在多 GPU 或多节点环境下训练大规模模型，需要高效集合通信。
HPC 开发者：构建高性能计算应用，利用 GPU 集群进行并行计算。

en.tag: Optimized primitives for collective multi-GPU communication

It is optimized for high bandwidth on platforms using PCIe, NVLink, NVswitch, and networking via InfiniBand or TCP/IP, supporting any number of GPUs in a single node or across multiple nodes, and usable in single- or multi-process (e.g., MPI) applications.
en.content: The repository contains the NCCL library source code, build scripts (for Debian/RPM/txz packages and Python wheel), tests (maintained separately in nccl-tests), and documentation. Key directories include src/ (core implementation), makefiles/ (build configuration), etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on CUDA toolkit, supports multiple GPU architectures (configurable via NVCC_GENCODE). Build system is Makefile-based, producing various package formats.
en.hot: NCCL is NVIDIA's official high-performance GPU communication library, a critical component for distributed deep learning training, relied upon by major frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow. zh.hot: 本月新增 1031 星，总星数 3728，因其切中开发者痛点：AI 编码术语混乱且常被故意复杂化，该词典以清晰解释迅速走红。

en.tag: AI coding jargon explained in plain English
en.what: A dictionary that translates AI coding jargon into plain English for developers. It covers topics like models, context, tools, and failure modes, helping developers quickly grasp core concepts.
en.content: The repo contains Markdown entries organized into sections like 'The Model', 'Sessions & Context', and 'Tools & Environment', each with concise definitions. It also includes generation scripts and a website for online reading.

Engineers who need to explain AI concepts to non-technical colleagues
Self-learners who want a systematic introduction to AI coding fundamentals
Developers following AI tooling trends like MCP and agents

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室，集克隆、合成与听写于一体
zh.what: Voicebox 是一款本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室，集语音克隆、文本转语音与实时语音输入于一体。它能够在本地运行 7 种 TTS 引擎，支持 23 种语言的语音合成，并通过全局热键向任意文本框听写。此外，它还能为 MCP 兼容的 AI 智能体赋予自定义语音，实现完整的语音输入输出闭环。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 TypeScript 的桌面应用源码、7 套 TTS 引擎的本地集成、语音克隆与听写核心模块，以及配套落地页与文档站点。
zh.stack: 主技术栈为 TypeScript，构建跨平台桌面应用；依赖本地运行的 LLM 进行语音文本优化，并集成 7 种 TTS 引擎与语音克隆模型实现完整语音 I/O。
zh.hot: 在 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow 等云端方案之外，Voicebox 以完全本地运行和隐私保护击中用户痛点，月增 12,138 Star 达 42,229 颗，跻身 TypeScript 月榜第 8。它一次性覆盖语音克隆、合成与听写全链路，降低了创作者与开发者对闭源语音服务的依赖。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 快速克隆音色并生成多语言旁白，无需依赖云端付费 API。
隐私敏感用户 —— 语音数据完全本地处理，适合对数据安全有较高要求的个人与企业。
AI 开发者 —— 为 MCP 智能体快速接入自定义语音，构建具备语音交互能力的本地应用。
效率办公人群 —— 通过全局热键向任意文本框实时语音输入，替代传统键盘录入。

en.tag: Local-first open-source AI voice studio for cloning, synthesis and dictation
en.what: Voicebox is a local-first, open-source AI voice studio that combines voice cloning, text-to-speech, and real-time dictation in one app. It runs seven TTS engines locally for speech synthesis across 23 languages, and lets you dictate into any text field via a global hotkey. It also gives MCP-aware AI agents a custom voice, closing the full voice I/O loop on your machine.
en.content: The repository contains the TypeScript-based desktop application source, integrations for seven local TTS engines, voice-cloning and dictation modules, plus a landing site and documentation.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript as a cross-platform desktop app; it relies on a bundled local LLM for speech refinement and integrates seven TTS engines plus voice-cloning models for complete on-device voice I/O.
en.hot: Hitting a pain point against cloud incumbents like ElevenLabs and WisprFlow, Voicebox offers fully local, privacy-preserving voice I/O; it gained 12,138 stars this month to reach 42,229, ranking 8th on the TypeScript monthly trending list. Its all-in-one coverage of cloning, synthesis, and dictation lowers reliance on proprietary voice services for creators and developers.
uses: Content creators — quickly clone voices and generate multilingual narrations without cloud APIs.
Privacy-conscious users — process all voice data locally for individuals and enterprises with strict data-security needs.
AI developers — give MCP-compatible agents custom voices to build locally running voice-interactive applications.
Productivity-focused users — dictate into any text field via a global hotkey as a keyboard alternative.

zh.tag: MCP 官方 TypeScript SDK，构建服务器与客户端
zh.what: 这是 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方 TypeScript SDK，用于标准化地为 LLM 提供上下文。它支持在 Node.js、Bun 和 Deno 上运行，并提供了构建 MCP 服务器和客户端的库。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 monorepo，包含多个包：@modelcontextprotocol/server（服务器库）、@modelcontextprotocol/client（客户端库）、可选中间件包（Express、Fastify、Hono 等）以及可运行的示例。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 TypeScript，支持 Node.js、Bun、Deno 运行时。使用 Standard Schema 定义工具和提示词模式，并包含 Streamable HTTP、stdio 传输和 OAuth 辅助功能。
zh.hot: 作为 MCP 官方 SDK，v2 版本刚随 2026-07-28 规范发布，star 数达 1.3 万，月增 342，位列 TypeScript 趋势榜第 20，是 AI 工具链的关键基础设施。
uses: 开发者构建 MCP 服务器，为 AI 应用提供工具、资源和提示词
开发者构建 MCP 客户端，连接 AI 模型与外部工具
框架集成者使用中间件包将 MCP 接入 Express、Fastify 等
学习 MCP 规范与实现，参考示例代码快速上手

en.tag: Official MCP TypeScript SDK for building servers and clients
en.what: This is the official TypeScript SDK for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which standardizes how applications provide context to LLMs. It runs on Node.js, Bun, and Deno, and provides libraries for building MCP servers and clients.
en.content: The repository is a monorepo with split packages: @modelcontextprotocol/server for server libraries, @modelcontextprotocol/client for client libraries, optional middleware packages for Express/Fastify/Hono/Node HTTP, and runnable examples.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, supporting Node.js, Bun, and Deno runtimes. Uses Standard Schema for tool and prompt schemas, and includes Streamable HTTP, stdio transports, and OAuth helpers.
en.hot: As the official MCP SDK, v2 was just released with the 2026-07-28 spec, amassing 13k stars (+342 this month) and ranking #20 on TypeScript trending, making it critical infrastructure for AI tooling.
uses: Developers building MCP servers to provide tools, resources, and prompts to AI apps
Developers building MCP clients to connect AI models with external tools
Framework integrators using middleware packages to plug MCP into Express, Fastify, etc.
Learners studying MCP spec and implementation, using examples to get started quickly

zh.tag: 桌面级全能办公 AI 代理，支持数据分析、PPT、文档、视频与网页研究
zh.what: LobsterAI 是网易有道开源的桌面级 AI 代理，能在真实工作环境中操作本地文件、终端、浏览器等，完成数据分析、PPT、文档、视频和网页研究等任务。它基于 OpenClaw 构建，支持通过微信、飞书、钉钉和 Telegram 远程下达指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、OpenClaw 运行时、Cowork 会话层、多 Agent 工作流、专家套件（Expert Kits）以及 IM 绑定等模块，并提供 macOS 和 Windows 安装包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Electron 40 和 React 18 构建桌面应用，底层集成 OpenClaw 作为代理执行引擎。
zh.hot: 作为国内大厂首个开源的桌面级 Agent，上线即获 5905 星，月增 362 星，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（TypeScript）第 21 名，引发广泛关注。
uses: 办公人员：用自然语言完成数据分析、制作 PPT、整理文档等日常任务
开发者：基于 OpenClaw 扩展自定义 Agent 和自动化工作流
团队协作：通过 IM 工具远程指挥桌面代理，实现移动办公

en.tag: Desktop-grade AI agent for real work: data analysis, slides, docs, video & web research
en.what: LobsterAI is an open-source desktop-grade AI agent by NetEase Youdao that operates in your real working environment—local files, terminal, browser—to complete tasks like data analysis, slides, docs, video, and web research. Built on OpenClaw, it accepts remote commands via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, and Telegram.
en.content: The repo includes the desktop app (Electron + React), OpenClaw runtime, Cowork session layer, multi-agent workflows, Expert Kits, and IM bindings, with installers for macOS and Windows.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built with Electron 40 and React 18 for the desktop app, with OpenClaw as the underlying agent execution engine.
en.hot: As the first open-source desktop-grade Agent from a major Chinese tech company, it quickly gained 5,905 stars (362 this month), ranking #21 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) monthly, sparking wide interest.
uses: Office workers: accomplish data analysis, slide creation, document drafting via natural language
Developers: extend custom agents and automation workflows on OpenClaw
Teams: remotely command the desktop agent via IM tools for mobile work

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

企业 IT 团队 —— 标准化 Power Platform 开发流程

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器
zh.what: drawDB 是一个在浏览器中运行的免费数据库实体关系图（ERD）编辑器，用户无需注册即可快速绘制数据库图表、导入导出 SQL 脚本、生成迁移脚本并自定义编辑器。它旨在简化数据库设计流程，让开发者可以直观地可视化和操作数据库结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 drawDB 前端应用源码，包括 React 组件、状态管理、样式和构建配置。还提供了本地开发、生产构建和 Docker 部署的脚本，以及可选的分享功能（需要配套的 drawdb-server）。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 React 构建，使用 npm 进行依赖管理和构建，支持 Docker 容器化部署。主要依赖包括 React 生态、状态管理库（如 Redux 或 MobX）以及代码编辑器组件（如 Monaco）。
zh.hot: drawDB 因其免费、无需注册、直接在浏览器中使用的便捷性而广受欢迎，star 数已达 38k+，今日新增 48 个，在 GitHub 趋势榜 JavaScript 类别中排名第 10。它解决了数据库设计中的常见痛点，提供了简洁直观的界面和强大的 SQL 生成功能。
uses: 数据库开发者：快速可视化数据库结构，生成 SQL 脚本和迁移文件。
软件架构师：在项目初期设计 ER 图，便于团队协作和沟通。
教育场景：用于教学演示数据库设计概念，无需安装复杂软件。
全栈开发者：在开发过程中快速原型化数据库模型，并导出为 SQL 语句。

en.tag: Free, simple, intuitive online database ER diagram editor and SQL generator
en.what: drawDB is a free, browser-based database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that lets users quickly build diagrams, import/export SQL scripts, generate migrations, and customize the editor without creating an account. It simplifies database design by providing an intuitive visual interface for structuring and manipulating database schemas.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the drawDB frontend application, including React components, state management, styles, and build configuration. It provides scripts for local development, production build, and Docker deployment, along with optional sharing features that require a companion drawdb-server.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript and React, using npm for dependency management and build, with Docker support for containerized deployment. Key dependencies include React ecosystem, state management libraries (e.g., Redux or MobX), and code editor components (e.g., Monaco).
en.hot: drawDB has gained popularity for being free, requiring no sign-up, and working directly in the browser, amassing 38k+ stars with 48 new stars today, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending for JavaScript. It addresses common pain points in database design with a clean, intuitive interface and powerful SQL generation capabilities.
uses: Database developers: quickly visualize database schemas and generate SQL scripts and migrations.
Software architects: design ER diagrams in early project phases for team collaboration and communication.
Educational settings: demonstrate database design concepts without installing complex software.
Full-stack developers: prototype database models quickly during development and export to SQL statements.

en.tag: A simple, open-source bilingual translation extension & userscript
en.what: KISS Translator is a simple, open-source bilingual translation tool available as a browser extension and userscript. It supports webpage bilingual translation, selection translation, input box translation, YouTube subtitle translation, and more, with compatibility for multiple translation services.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for the extension and userscript, supporting browsers like Chrome/Edge/Firefox and mobile browsers like Kiwi and Orion. It also includes related projects such as the data sync service kiss-worker and community rule subscription kiss-rules.
en.stack: Developed in JavaScript, leveraging browser extension APIs and userscript APIs. Supports various translation services including Google, Microsoft, OpenAI, DeepL, etc., with streaming and AI context memory.
en.hot: Gained 742 stars this month, reaching 12,008 total, and appeared on the GitHub Trending monthly list. Its simplicity and powerful features attract many users, especially those valuing privacy and customization.
uses: Web readers needing efficient bilingual reading, for side-by-side translation of foreign pages
Users who watch YouTube videos and need subtitle translation
Advanced users who want to customize translation services and rules, including AI translation
Privacy-conscious users who prefer self-hosted data sync

zh.tag: 基于 WebSocket 的 WhatsApp Web 非官方 TypeScript API
zh.what: Baileys 是一个基于 WebSocket 的 TypeScript 库，用于与 WhatsApp Web API 交互。它允许开发者以编程方式发送和接收消息、管理会话等，无需官方 API。

zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript/JavaScript，依赖 WebSocket 连接，通过 npm 分发。
zh.hot: 本月新增 603 星，总星数超 1 万，因其为开发者提供了强大的 WhatsApp 自动化能力，且持续维护更新。

en.tag: Unofficial TypeScript API for WhatsApp Web via WebSockets
en.what: Baileys is a WebSockets-based TypeScript library for interacting with the WhatsApp Web API. It allows developers to programmatically send/receive messages, manage sessions, and more without the official API.
en.content: The repository contains the library's source code, documentation (including migration guide and new wiki site), examples, and community support links.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript/JavaScript, relies on WebSocket connections, distributed via npm.
en.hot: Gained 603 stars this month, total over 10k, due to its powerful WhatsApp automation capabilities and active maintenance.

zh.tag: 前端模块打包器，将众多模块打包成静态资源
zh.what: webpack 是一个模块打包器，主要用途是将 JavaScript 文件打包以便在浏览器中使用，同时也能转换、打包或封装几乎任何资源或资产。它通过加载器支持 CommonJS、AMD、ES6 模块、CSS、图片、JSON、CoffeeScript、LESS 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 webpack 的核心源码、文档（如安装指南、概念介绍、贡献指南）、项目治理文件（TSC、核心协作者、赞助商列表）以及社区资源链接（Discord、讨论区）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 环境，通过 npm 或 yarn 安装，支持广泛的加载器和插件生态。
zh.hot: webpack 是前端构建工具的事实标准，拥有 65,970 颗星，月增 254 颗，长期稳居 GitHub 趋势榜，因其强大的模块打包能力和丰富的插件生态而持续受到开发者青睐。
uses: 前端开发者：用于打包 JavaScript 应用，优化加载性能
工程化团队：通过配置加载器和插件，实现资源模块化与自动化构建
学习模块打包原理：阅读源码或文档，理解打包流程与代码分割

en.tag: A module bundler that packs many modules into a few bundled assets
en.what: Webpack is a module bundler whose main purpose is to bundle JavaScript files for usage in a browser, yet it is also capable of transforming, bundling, or packaging just about any resource or asset. Through loaders, it supports CommonJS, AMD, ES6 modules, CSS, Images, JSON, CoffeeScript, LESS, and more.
en.content: The repository contains webpack's core source code, documentation (installation, introduction, concepts, contributing), project governance files (TSC, core collaborators, sponsors), and community links (Discord, discussions).
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, requires Node.js, installed via npm or yarn, and supports a wide ecosystem of loaders and plugins.
en.hot: Webpack is the de facto standard for frontend build tooling, with 65,970 stars and 254 new stars this month, consistently ranking on GitHub Trending due to its powerful bundling capabilities and rich plugin ecosystem.
uses: Frontend developers: to bundle JavaScript applications and optimize loading performance
Engineering teams: to modularize assets and automate builds via loaders and plugins
Learners: to understand bundling principles and code splitting by reading source or docs

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的高性能 Minecraft 服务端
zh.what: Pumpkin 是一个完全用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 服务器，旨在提供极致的性能和可定制性。它支持最新的 Java 和 Bedrock 版本，同时保持原版游戏机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器核心实现，包括世界加载、区块生成、玩家管理、实体 AI、红石、插件系统等模块，目前处于积极开发中。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Rust，利用多线程和零成本抽象实现高性能；依赖 tokio 异步运行时和自定义网络协议实现。
zh.hot: Rust 语言的高性能和安全性吸引了大量 Minecraft 社区关注，今日新增 108 星，总星数 8415，位列 GitHub 日榜第 18 名。
uses: Minecraft 服务器管理员 —— 希望部署高性能、低资源占用的服务端
Rust 开发者 —— 学习 Rust 在游戏服务器领域的实践
Minecraft 模组/插件开发者 —— 基于其插件系统进行扩展

en.tag: A fast, efficient Minecraft server built entirely in Rust
en.what: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, designed for maximum performance and customizability. It supports the latest Java and Bedrock editions while adhering to vanilla game mechanics.
en.content: The repository contains a full server core implementation, including world loading, chunk generation, player management, entity AI, redstone, plugin system, etc., currently under heavy development.
en.stack: Tech stack is Rust, leveraging multi-threading and zero-cost abstractions for high performance; relies on tokio async runtime and custom network protocol implementation.
en.hot: The high performance and safety of Rust attract massive attention from the Minecraft community, with 108 stars added today and 8415 total, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Minecraft server admins — seeking high-performance, low-resource server software
Rust developers — learning Rust in game server development
Minecraft mod/plugin developers — extending functionality via its plugin system

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: 轻量级 Bitwarden 自托管服务器
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 的第三方轻量级服务器实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方客户端。它允许用户在低资源环境下自托管密码管理器，替代官方资源密集型的服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码，支持 Docker、Podman 等多种部署方式，提供 Web Vault、API 和后台管理功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 语言，使用 Rocket 框架，依赖 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 数据库，支持 Docker 容器化部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 64,210 星标，是自托管密码管理领域的标杆项目。其轻量、安全且完全兼容官方客户端的特性，吸引了大量追求隐私和资源优化的用户。
uses: 个人用户 —— 在低配 VPS 或 NAS 上自托管密码管理器
小型团队 —— 无需付费订阅即可使用 Bitwarden 功能
隐私爱好者 —— 完全掌控密码数据，避免云服务依赖

en.tag: Lightweight self-hosted Bitwarden server
en.what: Vaultwarden is an alternative lightweight server implementation of Bitwarden, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It enables self-hosted password management on low-resource environments, replacing the official resource-heavy service.
en.content: The repository contains the complete server-side code, supports deployment via Docker, Podman, and others, and provides Web Vault, API, and admin features.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Rocket framework, supports SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL databases, and offers Docker containerization.
en.hot: With 64,210 stars, it's a benchmark in self-hosted password management. Its lightweight, secure, and fully compatible nature attracts users seeking privacy and resource efficiency.
uses: Individual users — self-host password manager on low-end VPS or NAS
Small teams — use Bitwarden features without paid subscription
Privacy enthusiasts — full control over password data, avoiding cloud dependency

zh.tag: Rust 全栈跨平台 UI 框架，一套代码覆盖 Web、桌面与移动端
zh.what: Dioxus 是一个基于 Rust 的全栈应用框架，开发者只需维护一套代码库即可构建 Web、桌面和移动应用。它提供了类似 React 的组件化开发体验，并内置基于 Signals 的状态管理、热重载与零配置启动能力。通过 Server Functions 还能直接在同一代码库中编写后端逻辑，实现真正的全栈开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 UI 库、跨平台渲染器（Web/桌面/移动端）、CLI 打包工具以及 Server Functions 全栈运行时。此外还提供了丰富的官方示例、文档站点和多语言 README，方便开发者快速上手。
zh.stack: 完全基于 Rust 生态，核心使用自研的 Virtual DOM 与 Signals 响应式系统，编译目标涵盖 WebAssembly、桌面端（基于 Winit/Tao）及移动端原生渲染。
zh.hot: 凭借 36.8K Star 的热度和本周 Rust 趋势榜第 18 名的成绩，Dioxus 吸引了大量希望用 Rust 替代 JavaScript 技术栈的开发者。其“一套代码、多端运行”的全栈能力，加上对热重载和零配置体验的重视，精准击中了 Rust 社区对高性能跨平台 UI 方案的强烈需求。
uses: Rust 开发者 —— 希望用单一代码库同时覆盖前端页面与桌面/移动原生应用的项目。
全栈工程师 —— 想在前端组件中直接调用 Server Functions，减少前后端语言切换成本的团队。
跨平台应用团队 —— 需要高性能、内存安全且拒绝 Electron 厚重方案的产品组。

en.tag: Rust fullstack cross-platform UI framework for web, desktop, and mobile
en.what: Dioxus is a Rust-based fullstack framework that lets developers build for the web, desktop, and mobile from a single codebase. It offers a React-like component model with zero-config setup, integrated hot-reloading, and signals-based state management. Server Functions enable backend logic to live alongside the UI, streamlining fullstack development in Rust.
en.content: The repo contains the core UI library, cross-platform renderers for web, desktop, and mobile, a CLI bundler, and a fullstack runtime for Server Functions. It also ships with extensive examples, documentation, and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built entirely on Rust, featuring a custom Virtual DOM and signals-based reactivity, compiling to WebAssembly, desktop (via Winit/Tao), and mobile native targets.
en.hot: With 36.8K stars and ranking 18th on this week's GitHub Rust Trending, Dioxus is drawing developers eager to replace JavaScript stacks with Rust. Its promise of a single codebase spanning web, desktop, and mobile—backed by hot-reload and zero-config DX—directly addresses the Rust community's demand for high-performance cross-platform UI solutions.
uses: Rust developers —— teams wanting a single codebase for web, desktop, and mobile apps without sacrificing performance.
Fullstack engineers —— those looking to colocate Server Functions with UI components to cut language-switching overhead.
Cross-platform product teams —— groups that need memory-safe, high-performance alternatives to heavy Electron-style solutions.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files.
