Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: 官方 Rust MCP SDK，异步运行时实现
zh.what: 这是 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方 Rust SDK，提供核心协议实现和过程宏工具。它支持最新的 MCP 2026-07-28 规范，并兼容旧版本，帮助开发者构建 MCP 客户端和服务端。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个 crate：rmcp（核心协议实现）和 rmcp-macros（用于生成工具实现的过程宏）。提供丰富的功能，如工具、资源、提示、采样、订阅、缓存、HTTP 传输等，并附带示例和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 tokio 异步运行时，依赖 serde 进行序列化，使用 schemars 生成 JSON Schema（2020-12 版本）。
zh.hot: 作为 MCP 官方 SDK，随着 MCP 生态爆发而受到关注，本月新增 183 星，进入 GitHub Trending Rust 月榜。
uses: Rust 开发者构建 MCP 客户端或服务端，集成 AI 工具
需要实现 MCP 协议的工具开发者，利用宏简化开发
研究 MCP 规范或想了解最新协议特性的学习者

en.tag: Official Rust SDK for Model Context Protocol with async runtime
en.what: This is the official Rust SDK for the Model Context Protocol, providing core protocol implementation and procedural macros. It supports the latest MCP 2026-07-28 spec while remaining compatible with older versions, helping developers build MCP clients and servers.
en.content: The repository contains two crates: rmcp (core protocol implementation) and rmcp-macros (procedural macros for tool implementations). It offers extensive features like tools, resources, prompts, sampling, subscriptions, caching, HTTP transports, plus examples and docs.
en.stack: Built on Rust with tokio async runtime, uses serde for serialization, and schemars for JSON Schema generation (2020-12).
en.hot: As the official MCP SDK, it gains attention with the MCP ecosystem boom, adding 183 stars this month and entering the GitHub Trending Rust monthly list.
uses: Rust developers building MCP clients or servers to integrate AI tools
Tool developers needing to implement MCP protocol, using macros to simplify development
Learners studying MCP spec or exploring latest protocol features

zh.tag: 比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的 S3 兼容对象存储
zh.what: RustFS 是一个基于 Rust 构建的高性能分布式对象存储系统，兼容 S3 API。它针对小对象（如 4KB）进行了极致优化，性能可达 MinIO 的 2.3 倍，同时支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等平台无缝迁移和共存。
zh.content: 仓库包含 RustFS 核心存储引擎、S3 API 网关、CLI 工具、Docker 部署配置以及完整的文档和示例。项目采用模块化架构，支持分布式部署和水平扩展。
zh.stack: 主要编程语言为 Rust，依赖 Tokio 异步运行时、S3 兼容库（如 aws-sdk-s3）、以及 RocksDB 或自研存储引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的性能优势和 Rust 的内存安全特性，RustFS 在 GitHub 上获得 30k+ Stars，并登上 Trending 周榜。其 S3 兼容性降低了迁移成本，吸引了大量数据湖和 AI 场景用户。
uses: 数据湖与 AI 训练场景 —— 需要高性能小对象存储的机器学习平台
替代 MinIO/Ceph —— 追求更高吞吐和更低延迟的 S3 兼容存储
边缘计算与 IoT —— 轻量级分布式存储部署在资源受限环境
云原生基础设施 —— 作为 Kubernetes 的持久化存储后端

en.tag: 2.3x faster than MinIO for small objects, S3-compatible object storage
en.what: RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust, compatible with S3 API. It is extremely optimized for small objects (e.g., 4KB), achieving 2.3x the performance of MinIO, while supporting seamless migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms like MinIO and Ceph.
en.content: The repository contains the core storage engine, S3 API gateway, CLI tools, Docker deployment configs, and comprehensive documentation with examples. The project uses a modular architecture supporting distributed deployment and horizontal scaling.
en.stack: Primarily built in Rust, relying on Tokio async runtime, S3-compatible libraries (e.g., aws-sdk-s3), and RocksDB or custom storage engine.
en.hot: With 2.3x performance advantage over MinIO and Rust's memory safety, RustFS has gained 30k+ stars on GitHub and made it to the Trending weekly list. Its S3 compatibility reduces migration costs, attracting users in data lake and AI scenarios.
uses: Data lakes & AI training — high-performance small object storage for ML platforms
MinIO/Ceph replacement — S3-compatible storage with higher throughput and lower latency
Edge computing & IoT — lightweight distributed storage for resource-constrained environments
Cloud-native infrastructure — persistent storage backend for Kubernetes

zh.tag: 为并行 AI 代理工作流打造的 Git worktree 管理 CLI
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个用于 Git worktree 管理的命令行工具，专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计。它帮助开发者高效管理多个工作树，使 AI 代理能够并行处理不同任务，同时保持代码库的整洁和同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具、文档站点（docs/）以及用于测试和 CI 的配置。核心功能围绕 worktree 的创建、切换、清理和同步，提供直观的命令行接口。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Git 命令行，支持 MIT 或 Apache-2.0 双许可证。项目通过 GitHub Actions 进行 CI，并使用 codecov 跟踪代码覆盖率。
zh.hot: 自年初发布以来，Worktrunk 迅速成为最流行的 Git worktree 管理器，本月新增 600 星，总星数达 6374，位列 Rust 月榜第 9。其精准定位 AI 代理并行开发场景，解决了多代理协作中的分支管理痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要并行运行多个 AI 代理进行代码生成或审查，同时保持仓库整洁。
团队协作：多个开发者或代理同时处理不同功能，需要隔离的工作树。
CI/CD 工程师：在自动化流程中需要快速创建和销毁临时工作树。
Git 高级用户：希望更高效地管理多个工作树，减少分支切换开销。

en.tag: A CLI for Git worktree management, built for parallel AI agent workflows
en.what: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows. It helps developers efficiently manage multiple worktrees, enabling AI agents to work on different tasks in parallel while keeping the repository clean and synchronized.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, documentation site (docs/), and configuration for testing and CI. Core features revolve around creating, switching, cleaning, and syncing worktrees, with an intuitive command-line interface.
en.stack: Written in Rust, relies on Git CLI, dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0. CI is handled via GitHub Actions, with code coverage tracked by Codecov.
en.hot: Since its release earlier this year, Worktrunk has quickly become the most popular Git worktree manager, gaining 600 stars this month to reach 6,374 total, ranking #9 on the Rust monthly trending list. Its precise focus on parallel AI agent development addresses the pain point of branch management in multi-agent collaboration.
uses: AI agent developers: need to run multiple AI agents in parallel for code generation or review while keeping the repo clean.
Team collaboration: multiple developers or agents working on different features simultaneously need isolated worktrees.
CI/CD engineers: need to quickly create and destroy temporary worktrees in automated pipelines.
Advanced Git users: want to manage multiple worktrees more efficiently, reducing branch switching overhead.

zh.tag: 硬件加速 GPU 终端模拟器，跨桌面与浏览器
zh.what: Rio 是一个用 Rust 编写的现代终端模拟器，利用 GPU 加速渲染，提供流畅的终端体验。它旨在跨平台运行，支持桌面端和浏览器端，并具有丰富的自定义选项。
zh.content: 仓库包含终端模拟器的完整源代码、文档（位于 rioterm.com）、安装指南、配置说明和变更日志。还提供了多种平台（如 macOS、Linux、Steam Deck）的演示截图和打包状态。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 GPU 加速技术（如 wgpu）实现渲染。支持跨平台，包括桌面和浏览器（WebAssembly）。
zh.hot: 凭借 GPU 加速带来的高性能和跨平台（桌面+浏览器）特性，在开发者中迅速流行。本月新增 366 星，总星数达 7372，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（Rust）第 12 名。
uses: 追求高性能和流畅体验的终端用户
需要在浏览器中运行终端的 Web 开发者
喜欢自定义和现代 UI 的开发者
希望跨平台一致体验的开发者

en.tag: Hardware-accelerated GPU terminal emulator for desktop and browser
en.what: Rio is a modern terminal emulator written in Rust, leveraging GPU acceleration for smooth rendering. It aims to run everywhere, supporting desktop and browser platforms, with extensive customization options.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the terminal emulator, documentation (at rioterm.com), installation guides, configuration instructions, and changelog. It also includes demo screenshots for various platforms (macOS, Linux, Steam Deck) and packaging status.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging GPU acceleration (e.g., wgpu) for rendering. Cross-platform support including desktop and browser (WebAssembly).
en.hot: Its GPU-accelerated performance and cross-platform (desktop + browser) capabilities have made it popular among developers. With 366 stars added this month, reaching 7372 total, it ranked #12 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly.
uses: Terminal users seeking high performance and smooth experience
Web developers needing a terminal in the browser
Developers who enjoy customization and modern UI
Developers wanting a consistent cross-platform experience

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: Rust 全栈 Web 框架，开箱即用
zh.what: Topcoat 是一个模块化的 Rust 全栈框架，旨在简化 Web 应用开发。它支持服务端渲染和客户端交互，无需单独的 API 层或 WASM 打包。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架源码、示例代码、文档和路线图。核心特性包括服务端渲染、客户端响应式表达式、组件和分片（shard）机制。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Tokio 异步运行时，使用自定义的 view! 宏进行模板渲染，并支持将表达式编译为 JavaScript。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4491 星，因其作为 Tokio 官方推出的全栈框架，解决了 Rust Web 开发中的痛点，备受关注。
uses: Rust 开发者想要构建全栈 Web 应用，避免前后端分离的复杂性
需要服务端渲染和客户端交互无缝结合的场景
希望减少样板代码，提高开发效率的团队

en.tag: Batteries-included full-stack Rust web framework
en.what: Topcoat is a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack web apps. It prioritizes simplicity and productivity, enabling server-side rendering and client-side reactivity without boilerplate.
en.content: The repository contains framework source code, examples, documentation, and a roadmap. Key features include server-side rendering, client-side reactive expressions, components, and shards.
en.stack: Built on Rust and the Tokio async runtime, with a custom view! macro for templating and expression compilation to JavaScript.
en.hot: Gained 4491 stars this month, as Tokio's official full-stack framework addressing Rust web development pain points, attracting significant attention.
uses: Rust developers building full-stack web apps without frontend-backend separation
Scenarios needing seamless server-side rendering and client-side interactivity
Teams aiming to reduce boilerplate and boost productivity

zh.tag: 终端里的代码审查工具，支持 vim 键位与多平台导出
zh.what: tuicr 是一款运行在终端中的代码审查工具，提供 GitHub 风格的连续 diff 视图，支持 vim 键位操作。它允许用户在终端内浏览所有变更文件，添加行级、范围级或文件级评论，并跟踪审查进度。审查结果可以导出到 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket 或剪贴板。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、安装脚本、演示 GIF 和文档。核心是一个 TUI 应用，支持多种安装方式（curl、brew、cargo 等），并提供命令如 tuicr、tuicr pr、tuicr mr 等。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 git 集成。支持 git、jj 和 mercurial 版本控制系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1652 星，总星数 2776，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。开发者对终端内高效代码审查的需求强烈，vim 键位和跨平台导出功能吸引了许多用户。
uses: 喜欢 vim 键位的开发者，希望在终端内完成代码审查。
需要审查 GitHub PR、GitLab MR 或 Bitbucket PR 的团队。
希望将审查结果导出到剪贴板或 CI 管道的用户。
使用 jj 或 mercurial 的开发者，寻找跨 VCS 的审查工具。

en.tag: A code review TUI with vim keybindings, export to GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket
en.what: tuicr is a terminal-based code review tool offering a GitHub-style continuous diff view with vim keybindings. It lets users scroll through all changed files, add line/range/file-level comments, and track review progress. Reviews can be exported to GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or clipboard.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, install scripts, demo GIF, and docs. Core is a TUI app with multiple install methods (curl, brew, cargo, etc.) and commands like tuicr, tuicr pr, tuicr mr.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging TUI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and git integration. Supports git, jj, and mercurial VCS.
en.hot: Gained 1652 stars this month, total 2776, trending on GitHub. Strong demand for efficient terminal-based code review; vim keybindings and multi-platform export attract users.
uses: Developers who prefer vim keybindings and want to review code in the terminal.
Teams reviewing GitHub PRs, GitLab MRs, or Bitbucket PRs.
Users wanting to export reviews to clipboard or CI pipelines.
Developers using jj or mercurial seeking a cross-VCS review tool.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的可扩展 SQL 查询引擎
zh.what: Apache DataFusion 是一个用 Rust 实现的内存查询引擎，支持 SQL 和 DataFrame API，用于构建分析型数据系统。它提供查询优化、执行和分布式处理能力，可嵌入到其他应用中。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心查询引擎（解析、逻辑/物理计划、优化器、执行器）、DataFrame API、SQL 接口，以及用于扩展的示例和文档。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，依赖 Arrow 列式内存格式，支持 Parquet、CSV、JSON 等数据源，并可通过 DataFusion 的扩展点集成自定义函数和存储后端。
zh.hot: 作为 Apache 顶级项目，DataFusion 凭借高性能和可嵌入性成为 Rust 数据生态的核心组件，本月新增 162 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 13，持续吸引数据基础设施开发者关注。
uses: 数据平台开发者：构建查询引擎或分布式 SQL 层
嵌入式分析应用：在 Rust 应用中集成 SQL 查询能力
数据科学家：利用 DataFrame API 进行交互式分析
数据库内核研究者：学习查询优化与执行实现

en.tag: Extensible SQL query engine built in Rust
en.what: Apache DataFusion is an in-memory query engine implemented in Rust, supporting SQL and DataFrame APIs for building analytical data systems. It provides query optimization, execution, and distributed processing capabilities, and can be embedded into other applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core query engine (parsing, logical/physical planning, optimizer, execution), DataFrame API, SQL interface, along with examples and documentation for extension.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on Arrow columnar memory format, supports data sources like Parquet, CSV, JSON, and can integrate custom functions and storage backends via DataFusion's extension points.
en.hot: As an Apache top-level project, DataFusion's high performance and embeddability make it a core component of the Rust data ecosystem. With 162 new stars this month and ranking 13th on the Rust trending list, it continues to attract data infrastructure developers.
uses: Data platform developers: building query engines or distributed SQL layers
Embedded analytics apps: integrating SQL query capabilities into Rust applications
Data scientists: using DataFrame API for interactive analysis
Database kernel researchers: learning query optimization and execution implementations

zh.tag: 一站式媒体下载与学习管理桌面应用
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款开源桌面应用，支持从 1800+ 网站下载视频、音频、课程和电子书，并内置 PDF/EPUB 阅读器、专注模式、带时间戳的笔记和间隔重复功能。无需命令行，无需 Python，开箱即用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，基于 Tauri + Rust + Svelte 构建，提供媒体下载、播放、阅读、笔记和插件系统。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Tauri（桌面框架）、Rust（后端）、Svelte（前端）、yt-dlp（媒体下载）、SQLite（本地存储）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 357 星，总星数 7277，位列 Rust 日榜第 10。其“一站式下载+学习”的定位精准解决了用户在多平台间切换的痛点，且完全免费开源。
uses: 在线课程学习者 —— 一键下载 Udemy、YouTube 等平台的课程视频和资料
媒体收藏爱好者 —— 从 1800+ 站点下载视频、音乐和电子书
高效学习者 —— 利用内置阅读器、笔记和间隔重复功能进行主动学习

en.tag: All-in-one desktop app for downloading, organizing and studying media
en.what: OmniGet is an open-source desktop app that downloads videos, audio, courses, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites, with built-in PDF/EPUB reader, focus mode, timestamped notes, and spaced repetition. No command line, no Python, just download and run.
en.content: The repo contains the full desktop app source code built with Tauri + Rust + Svelte, featuring media downloading, playback, reading, note-taking, and a plugin system.
en.stack: Tech stack: Tauri (desktop framework), Rust (backend), Svelte (frontend), yt-dlp (media downloading), SQLite (local storage).
en.hot: Gained 357 stars today, total 7277, ranked #10 in Rust daily trending. Its 'all-in-one download + study' positioning solves the pain of switching between platforms, and it's completely free and open-source.
uses: Online course learners — one-click download courses from Udemy, YouTube, and more
Media collectors — download videos, music, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites
Active learners — use built-in reader, notes, and spaced repetition for effective study

zh.tag: 跨平台安全文件传输工具，支持端到端加密与断点续传
zh.what: croc 是一款命令行工具，可在任意两台计算机之间简单、安全地传输文件与文件夹。它基于 PAKE 协议实现端到端加密，无需配置本地服务器或端口转发，通过中继即可完成跨平台传输。支持断点续传、多文件传输、IPv6-first 及代理（如 Tor）等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、CLI 主程序、中继服务器实现，以及多平台安装脚本和 CI 配置。README 提供了详细的安装指南（涵盖 Homebrew、Scoop、Nix 等主流包管理器）和动态演示 GIF。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 PAKE 算法实现密钥交换，通过自定义中继协议传输数据，支持 IPv6/IPv4 双栈及 SOCKS5 代理（如 Tor）。
zh.hot: 凭借「开箱即用、安全无痛」的跨设备传输体验，croc 在开发者社区积累了 35.6K Star，本周再增 167 星并冲入 GitHub Go 周榜第 20 名。它填补了传统 scp/rsync 配置繁琐与即时传输工具缺乏加密之间的空白。
uses: 开发运维人员 —— 在不同服务器或本地与远程之间快速安全地传输配置文件与日志
跨平台协作团队 —— 在 Windows、macOS、Linux 同事之间即开即用地分享大文件或项目目录
隐私敏感用户 —— 借助端到端加密和 Tor 代理，在不信任网络中安全收发文件
命令行爱好者 —— 替代 scp/rsync，无需配置 SSH 或端口转发即可点对点传输

en.tag: Secure CLI tool for effortless cross-platform file transfers with encryption
en.what: croc is a CLI tool that lets any two computers simply and securely transfer files and folders. It uses PAKE for end-to-end encryption and works through a relay, eliminating the need for local servers or port forwarding. It supports resumable transfers, multiple files, IPv6-first with IPv4 fallback, and proxies like Tor.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go source code, CLI entry point, relay server implementation, and cross-platform install scripts with CI configs. The README includes detailed installation guides for Homebrew, Scoop, Nix, and more, plus a demo GIF.
en.stack: Written in Go, it uses PAKE for key exchange, a custom relay protocol for data transfer, and supports IPv6/IPv4 dual-stack with SOCKS5 proxy support (e.g., Tor).
en.hot: With an out-of-the-box, pain-free cross-device transfer experience, croc has earned 35.6K stars, gaining 167 this week and hitting #20 on GitHub's Go Trending chart. It fills the gap between tedious scp/rsync setup and instant tools that lack encryption.
uses: DevOps/Developers —— quickly and securely transfer configs and logs between servers or local and remote machines
Cross-platform teams —— instantly share large files or project folders across Windows, macOS, and Linux colleagues
Privacy-conscious users —— send files securely over untrusted networks using end-to-end encryption and Tor proxy support
CLI power users —— replace scp/rsync without needing SSH setup or port forwarding for ad-hoc transfers

zh.tag: 阿里巴巴开源的企业级AI代码审查CLI工具
zh.what: OpenCodeReview 是一款基于 AI 的代码审查 CLI 工具，起源于阿里巴巴集团内部，经过两年大规模验证，为数万开发者服务并发现数百万代码缺陷。它读取 Git diff，通过具备工具调用能力的 Agent 将变更文件发送给可配置的 LLM，生成精确到行的结构化审查评论。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具源码、内置精细调优的规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入等）、支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口，以及多语言文档和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 和 LLM API（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 作为阿里巴巴内部大规模验证的代码审查工具开源，结合确定性流水线和 LLM Agent 的混合架构，精准行级评论和内置规则集吸引了大量开发者，今日新增 162 星，总星数 10964。
uses: 开发团队 —— 集成到 CI/CD 流水线，自动审查代码提交，提升代码质量
个人开发者 —— 在本地运行审查，快速发现潜在缺陷和安全漏洞
开源维护者 —— 用于管理 PR 审查，减少人工负担

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review CLI with deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent
en.what: OpenCodeReview is an AI-powered code review CLI tool originating from Alibaba Group's internal system, serving tens of thousands of developers and identifying millions of code defects over two years. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates line-level structured review comments.
en.content: The repo contains Go CLI source code, built-in fine-tuned rulesets (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), support for OpenAI & Anthropic compatible APIs, and multi-language documentation and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, depends on Git and LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic compatible), supports agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
en.hot: Open-sourced from Alibaba's battle-tested internal tool, its hybrid architecture of deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, and built-in rulesets have attracted many developers, gaining 162 stars today and 10964 total.
uses: Development teams — integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated code review on commits, improving code quality
Individual developers — run locally for quick detection of potential defects and security vulnerabilities
Open source maintainers — manage PR reviews with reduced manual effort

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供持久化结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的分布式图式问题追踪器，提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 Markdown 计划，帮助代理处理长周期任务而不丢失上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Beads CLI 工具源码、安装脚本、文档以及多种代理集成（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。用户通过 `bd` 命令初始化项目、创建/关闭问题、同步远程代理。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，底层依赖 Dolt（分布式版本化数据库）实现图存储和同步。支持通过 npm 和 PyPI 安装 MCP 相关包。
zh.hot: GitHub 日增 95 星，总星数 25601，位列 Go 语言日榜第 11。AI 编码代理的持久记忆需求旺盛，Beads 以轻量 CLI 和分布式图方案解决痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者 —— 为代理提供持久化记忆和任务管理
使用 Codex CLI、Claude Code 等工具的开发者 —— 集成 Beads 以提升长周期任务处理能力
团队协作场景 —— 多代理通过 Dolt 同步工作状态和依赖图

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.
en.content: The repo contains the Beads CLI tool source code, installation scripts, documentation, and integrations for various agents (Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Users interact via `bd` commands to init projects, create/close issues, and sync with remote agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed versioned database) for graph storage and sync. Also provides npm and PyPI packages for MCP integration.
en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.
uses: AI coding agent developers — provide persistent memory and task management for agents
Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

zh.tag: 电话号OSINT信息收集框架
zh.what: PhoneInfoga 是一个用于扫描国际电话号码的信息收集框架，可获取国家、地区、运营商和线路类型等基本信息，并利用多种技术尝试查找 VoIP 提供商或识别机主。它通过可配置的扫描器集合工作，旨在辅助调查而非自动化一切。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心框架、命令行界面、Web 图形界面以及 REST API 文档，支持通过外部 API、电话簿和搜索引擎进行 OSINT 足迹收集，并检查信誉报告、社交媒体和一次性号码等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，提供 REST API 和 Go 模块供编程使用，支持 Docker 部署，并集成了 Swagger 文档。
zh.hot: 尽管项目已停止维护，但因其强大的 OSINT 功能和易用性，仍保持 17k+ 星标，今日新增 29 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 14 名，说明社区对其需求依然旺盛。
uses: 安全研究人员进行电话号码情报收集
调查记者验证电话号码相关信息
渗透测试人员辅助社会工程学攻击前侦察
普通用户查询陌生号码的基本信息

en.tag: OSINT framework for phone number reconnaissance
en.what: PhoneInfoga is an information gathering framework for scanning international phone numbers, providing basic details like country, area, carrier, and line type, and using various techniques to find VoIP providers or identify owners. It works with a collection of configurable scanners to assist investigations, not fully automate them.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based core framework, CLI, web GUI, and REST API docs, enabling OSINT footprinting via external APIs, phone books, and search engines, plus checks for reputation reports, social media, and disposable numbers.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, offering a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use, with Docker support and Swagger documentation.
en.hot: Despite being unmaintained, its powerful OSINT capabilities and ease of use keep it at 17k+ stars, with 29 new stars today, ranking #14 on Go trending, showing sustained community demand.
uses: Security researchers for phone number intelligence gathering
Investigative journalists verifying phone-related information
Penetration testers for pre-engagement reconnaissance
General users looking up basic info on unknown numbers

zh.tag: 多账户 Grok API 统一网关
zh.what: Grok2API 是一个多账户 API 网关，统一管理 Grok Build、Grok Web 和 Grok Console 的 API 访问。它通过负载均衡和自动切换，提供稳定、高效的 Grok API 代理服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端和 React 前端，提供 Docker 镜像支持 amd64/arm64 部署。后端实现多账户管理与 API 路由，前端提供 Web 管理界面。
zh.stack: Go 1.26 后端 + React 19 前端，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 551 星，总星数达 6563，位列 GitHub 周榜第 14。Grok API 需求旺盛，该工具简化了多账户管理，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 开发者 —— 统一管理多个 Grok 账户的 API 访问
AI 应用集成 —— 为自有应用提供稳定的 Grok API 代理
学习研究 —— 了解 API 网关与多账户负载均衡实现

en.tag: Multi-account API gateway for Grok services
en.what: Grok2API is a multi-account API gateway that unifies access to Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console APIs. It provides stable and efficient API proxying with load balancing and automatic account switching.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend and a React frontend, with Docker images for amd64/arm64. The backend handles multi-account management and API routing, while the frontend provides a web admin interface.
en.stack: Go 1.26 backend + React 19 frontend, Docker deployment supported.
en.hot: Gained 551 stars this week, total 6563, ranking #14 on GitHub weekly trending. High demand for Grok API access drives popularity as it simplifies multi-account management.
uses: Developers — centrally manage API access for multiple Grok accounts
AI app integration — provide stable Grok API proxy for own applications
Learning & research — study API gateway and multi-account load balancing

zh.tag: 高颜值现代化终端文件管理器
zh.what: superfile 是一个用 Go 编写的终端文件管理器，提供美观的界面和现代化的交互体验。它支持多平台（macOS、Linux、Windows），并具备插件和主题系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、安装脚本、网站资源（logo、demo 图片）、文档（README、教程）以及插件和主题示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 Bubble Tea 等终端 UI 库（推测），支持通过 Homebrew、Scoop、Winget 等包管理器安装。
zh.hot: 凭借高颜值和现代化设计，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本月新增 4000+ star，总 star 已超 2.2 万，跻身 Go 语言趋势榜前列。
uses: 喜欢定制终端环境的开发者，追求美观与效率并存
需要跨平台文件管理工具的用户，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows
对插件和主题扩展有需求的进阶用户

en.tag: A fancy and modern terminal file manager
en.what: superfile is a terminal file manager written in Go, offering a beautiful interface and modern interaction experience. It supports multiple platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows) and features a plugin and theme system.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, installation scripts, website assets (logo, demo images), documentation (README, tutorial), and examples of plugins and themes.
en.stack: Developed in Go, likely using terminal UI libraries like Bubble Tea. Installable via package managers such as Homebrew, Scoop, and Winget.
en.hot: Its fancy and modern design has made it popular on GitHub, gaining over 4,000 stars this month and reaching 22k+ total stars, ranking high in the Go trending list.
uses: Developers who love customizing terminal environments and seek both aesthetics and efficiency
Users needing a cross-platform file manager supporting macOS/Linux/Windows
Advanced users who require plugin and theme extensibility

zh.tag: 云原生应用代理，自动发现服务并动态配置路由
zh.what: Traefik 是一个现代 HTTP 反向代理和负载均衡器，旨在简化微服务的部署。它能够与 Docker、Kubernetes 等基础设施组件集成，自动且动态地配置自身，无需手动维护路由规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Traefik 的源代码、文档、示例配置以及 Web UI 资源。主要目录包括 docs（文档）、pkg（核心代码）、cmd（入口命令）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种后端集成库（如 Docker、Kubernetes、Consul 等），并支持 ACME 自动 HTTPS 证书。
zh.hot: 拥有 64k+ star，是云原生领域最受欢迎的反向代理之一。其自动服务发现和动态配置特性极大简化了微服务路由管理，因此持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 微服务架构中作为入口网关，自动路由到 Docker/Kubernetes 等服务
需要动态更新路由规则的场景，如频繁扩缩容或服务变更
希望简化 HTTPS 证书管理的开发者，利用内置 ACME 自动签发证书
边缘代理或 API 网关，支持多种协议和中间件

en.tag: Cloud-native application proxy with automatic service discovery and dynamic routing
en.what: Traefik is a modern HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer that simplifies microservices deployment. It integrates with infrastructure components like Docker and Kubernetes, automatically and dynamically configuring itself without manual route management.
en.content: The repository contains Traefik's source code, documentation, example configurations, and Web UI assets. Key directories include docs, pkg (core code), and cmd (entry commands).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with integrations for various backends (Docker, Kubernetes, Consul, etc.) and support for automatic HTTPS via ACME.
en.hot: With 64k+ stars, it's one of the most popular reverse proxies in cloud-native. Its automatic service discovery and dynamic configuration greatly simplify microservice routing, keeping it in the spotlight.
uses: As an ingress gateway in microservices, automatically routing to services in Docker/Kubernetes
Scenarios needing dynamic route updates, such as frequent scaling or service changes
Developers wanting simplified HTTPS management with built-in ACME auto-certificates
Edge proxy or API gateway supporting multiple protocols and middleware

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网与远程访问基础设施
zh.what: Tailscale 基于 WireGuard 协议构建安全的虚拟专用网络，让用户无需公网 IP 或端口转发即可将设备组成私有网络。它集成了身份验证和两因素认证（2FA），简化了团队和设备之间的安全远程访问与内网穿透。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含 tailscaled 守护进程与 tailscale 命令行工具的核心源码，覆盖 Linux、Windows、macOS 及 BSD 系统的网络栈与控制逻辑。移动端 App 的底层网络库亦来源于此，但各平台 GUI 包装代码位于其他独立仓库。
zh.stack: 项目以 Go 语言为主开发，要求使用最新版 Go 1.26 编译，并基于 WireGuard 协议实现加密通信。构建脚本 `build_dist.sh` 用于将版本信息嵌入二进制，支持多种 Linux 发行版及跨平台打包。
zh.hot: 凭借“零配置”即可在任意设备间建立加密组网的能力，Tailscale 已成为远程办公和云原生时代的核心网络工具，GitHub 累计获得 34k+ Stars，本周再以 583 新增 Star 登上 Go 语言 Trending 榜第 2 名。
uses: 远程办公团队 —— 无需公网 IP 即可安全访问公司内网与私有云资源
开发运维人员 —— 快速搭建跨云、跨地域的容器与服务器调试网络
个人技术爱好者 —— 将家庭 NAS、树莓派等设备组成加密私有网络
安全合规企业 —— 基于 SSO/2FA 的零信任网络替代传统 VPN 方案

en.tag: Zero-config WireGuard VPN for secure remote access and private networking
en.what: Tailscale builds secure virtual private networks on top of WireGuard, allowing devices to form a private mesh network without public IPs or port forwarding. It integrates identity-based authentication and two-factor authentication (2FA) to simplify secure remote access and intranet penetration for teams and devices.
en.content: The repository primarily contains the core source code for the `tailscaled` daemon and the `tailscale` CLI tool, covering the networking stack and control logic for Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD systems. It also serves as the underlying network library for mobile apps, while platform-specific GUI wrappers reside in separate repositories.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go and requiring the latest Go 1.26 release, it implements encrypted communication over the WireGuard protocol. The `build_dist.sh` script embeds version metadata into binaries, supporting packaging for multiple Linux distributions and cross-platform deployments.
en.hot: Its "zero-config" approach to encrypted mesh networking across any device has made it an essential tool for remote work and cloud-native environments. With over 34k total stars and 583 new stars this week, it ranks #2 on GitHub's Go Trending chart, reflecting strong community traction.
uses: Remote teams — Securely access corporate intranets and private cloud resources without public IPs
DevOps engineers — Quickly build debug networks across multi-cloud and multi-region servers and containers
Homelab enthusiasts — Encrypt and interconnect personal devices like NAS and Raspberry Pi into a private mesh
Security-focused enterprises — Replace legacy VPNs with zero-trust networking based on SSO and 2FA

zh.tag: Kubernetes 异构 GPU 共享与虚拟化调度中间件
zh.what: HAMi 是一个 Kubernetes 设备共享与调度中间件，允许在多个工作负载之间共享 GPU 和其他 AI 加速器，并隔离设备内存与计算资源。它无需修改应用代码即可实现设备感知的调度策略，帮助平台团队提高资源利用率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 HAMi 的完整实现，包括设备插件、调度器扩展、CRD 定义、命令行工具以及架构图、文档和示例。核心组件以 Go 编写，支持多种加速器厂商。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes 的 device plugin 和 scheduler extender 机制，支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Ascend 等多种 GPU 厂商。
zh.hot: HAMi 是 CNCF 孵化项目，本月新增 521 星，总星数 4351，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。它解决了 AI 基础设施中 GPU 资源利用率低和碎片化的痛点，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 平台团队：在 Kubernetes 集群中共享 GPU，提高资源利用率，降低硬件成本。
AI 基础设施工程师：为多租户环境实现设备隔离和 QoS 保证。
运维人员：统一管理异构加速器，简化调度和监控。
研究机构：在有限 GPU 资源下运行多个实验或训练任务。

en.tag: Kubernetes-native heterogeneous GPU sharing and virtualization middleware
en.what: HAMi is a Kubernetes device-sharing and scheduling middleware that enables sharing GPUs and other AI accelerators across workloads, isolating device memory and compute. It provides device-aware scheduling policies without modifying application code, helping platform teams improve resource utilization.
en.content: The repository contains the full implementation of HAMi, including device plugins, scheduler extensions, CRD definitions, CLI tools, architecture diagrams, documentation, and examples. Core components are written in Go and support multiple accelerator vendors.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes device plugin and scheduler extender mechanisms, supporting multiple GPU vendors such as NVIDIA, AMD, and Ascend.
en.hot: HAMi is a CNCF incubating project, gaining 521 stars this month (total 4351) and trending on GitHub. It addresses the pain point of low GPU utilization and fragmentation in AI infrastructure, attracting significant attention.
uses: Platform teams: share GPUs in Kubernetes clusters to improve utilization and reduce hardware costs.
AI infrastructure engineers: implement device isolation and QoS guarantees for multi-tenant environments.
Operators: manage heterogeneous accelerators uniformly, simplifying scheduling and monitoring.
Research institutions: run multiple experiments or training jobs with limited GPU resources.

zh.tag: 默认 HTTPS 的极速可扩展 Web 服务器
zh.what: Caddy 是一个快速、可扩展、跨平台的 Web 服务器，支持 HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3，并默认启用 TLS，自动为站点配置 HTTPS 证书。它旨在让 HTTPS 成为每个网站的默认配置，简化部署和运维。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Caddy 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置和构建脚本。核心是一个基于 Go 的模块化服务器，通过 Caddyfile 或 JSON 配置，支持丰富的插件和中间件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 CertMagic 库进行自动 HTTPS 证书管理，支持多种平台（Windows、macOS、Linux 等）。
zh.hot: Caddy 因其自动 HTTPS 和易用性而广受欢迎，本月新增近千 star，总 star 数超过 7.4 万，在 Go 语言趋势榜中名列前茅。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速部署静态网站或反向代理，无需手动配置证书
需要自动 HTTPS 和 HTTP/3 支持的生产环境 Web 服务器
作为微服务或容器化应用的反向代理和负载均衡器
学习和研究 Go 语言高性能服务器开发的参考项目

en.tag: Fast, extensible web server with automatic HTTPS by default
en.what: Caddy is a fast, extensible, multi-platform web server supporting HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, with TLS enabled by default and automatic HTTPS certificate management. It aims to make HTTPS the default for every site, simplifying deployment and operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, and build scripts for Caddy. The core is a modular Go-based server configured via Caddyfile or JSON, supporting a rich ecosystem of plugins and middleware.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the CertMagic library for automatic HTTPS certificate management, and supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: Caddy is popular for its automatic HTTPS and ease of use, gaining nearly a thousand stars this month and over 74k total, ranking high on the Go trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams quickly deploying static sites or reverse proxies without manual certificate setup
Production web servers requiring automatic HTTPS and HTTP/3 support
Reverse proxy and load balancer for microservices or containerized applications
Reference project for learning high-performance server development in Go

zh.tag: 一键追溯进程/端口/容器/文件来源的 CLI+TUI 工具
zh.what: witr 是一个命令行工具，用于回答“为什么这个在运行？”的问题。它能追溯进程、端口、容器或文件是由谁启动的，并展示完整的启动链，如 systemd → PM2 → node。支持 CLI 输出、机器可读 JSON 和交互式 TUI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 和 TUI 程序，提供安装脚本、文档和浏览器演示。核心功能是解析进程树、服务管理器、容器和文件系统，生成因果链。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖系统工具如 ps、lsof、ss、systemctl、docker 等来收集信息。支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 FreeBSD。
zh.hot: 解决了开发者常遇到的“这个进程/端口是谁启动的”痛点，提供直观的因果链展示，且支持多平台和多种包管理器，上线后迅速获得近 2 万星。
uses: 系统管理员排查异常进程或端口占用，快速定位源头。
开发者在容器或微服务环境中追踪服务启动链，便于调试。
安全分析师调查可疑进程或文件来源，辅助取证。
DevOps 工程师理解系统启动流程，优化服务管理。

en.tag: Trace any process, port, container, or file back to its origin with CLI+TUI
en.what: witr is a CLI tool that answers 'Why is this running?' by tracing any process, port, container, or file back to the exact chain that started it, such as systemd → PM2 → node. It offers CLI output, machine-readable JSON, and an interactive TUI.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI and TUI program, along with installation scripts, documentation, and a browser demo. It parses process trees, service managers, containers, and file systems to generate causal chains.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it leverages system utilities like ps, lsof, ss, systemctl, and docker to gather information. Supports Linux, macOS, Windows, and FreeBSD.
en.hot: It solves the common pain point of 'who started this process/port' with intuitive causal chain visualization, multi-platform support, and multiple package managers, quickly gaining nearly 20k stars.
uses: System admins investigating abnormal processes or port usage to quickly locate the source.
Developers tracing service startup chains in container or microservice environments for debugging.
Security analysts investigating suspicious processes or file origins for forensics.
DevOps engineers understanding system startup flows to optimize service management.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的安全组网与访问控制平台
zh.what: NetBird 是一个开源的零配置点对点组网平台，基于 WireGuard 创建加密的覆盖网络，自动连接设备，无需开放端口或配置复杂防火墙。它还提供集中的访问控制系统，支持 SSO、MFA 和细粒度访问策略，适用于组织或家庭网络。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NetBird 的核心组件，包括客户端、服务端、管理界面（dashboard）、公共 API 以及一个可选的 AI Agent Network（Beta）模块，用于对 AI 代理进行身份感知访问控制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 WireGuard 内核模块，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows、iOS 和 Android 等平台。
zh.hot: NetBird 在 GitHub 上拥有 28k+ 星标，因其简化了安全组网流程，并引入 AI Agent Network 等创新功能，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 希望替代传统 VPN 的团队，快速搭建安全的远程访问网络
需要细粒度访问控制和安全组网的个人开发者或家庭用户
对 AI 代理安全访问 LLM API 和私有资源感兴趣的技术团队

en.tag: Secure WireGuard-based overlay network with SSO, MFA and access controls
en.what: NetBird is an open-source, zero-config peer-to-peer networking platform that creates a WireGuard-based encrypted overlay network, automatically connecting devices without port forwarding or complex firewall rules. It also offers centralized access control with SSO, MFA, and granular policies, suitable for organizations or home networks.
en.content: The repository contains core components: client, server, admin web UI (dashboard), public API, and an optional AI Agent Network (Beta) module for identity-aware access control for AI agents.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging the WireGuard kernel module, with support for Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android.
en.hot: With 28k+ stars on GitHub, NetBird attracts developers by simplifying secure networking and introducing innovative features like the AI Agent Network.
uses: Teams looking to replace traditional VPNs with a secure remote access network
Individual developers or home users needing granular access control and secure networking
Technical teams interested in secure access for AI agents to LLM APIs and private resources

zh.tag: 零延迟多协议摄像头流媒体服务器
zh.what: go2rtc 是一个终极摄像头流媒体应用，支持数十种格式和协议，提供零延迟的流媒体输入、输出和转码。它既可以作为独立应用运行，也可以集成到其他项目中，如 Home Assistant。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心二进制、Docker 镜像、Home Assistant 插件，以及用于 Web 界面的前端资源。支持 RTSP、WebRTC、HLS 等协议，并可通过 FFmpeg 进行按需转码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Pion WebRTC 库、FFmpeg 进行转码，并支持多种流媒体协议。
zh.hot: 凭借零延迟、多协议支持和易于集成等特性，go2rtc 在智能家居和安防领域广受欢迎，本月新增 455 星，总星数达 13870。
uses: 智能家居用户：通过 Home Assistant 集成，实现摄像头流媒体管理。
开发者：作为库集成到自己的项目中，或使用其 API 构建自定义流媒体应用。
安防监控：需要低延迟、多协议摄像头流的场景。
直播推流：将摄像头流推送到 YouTube、Telegram 等平台。

en.tag: Zero-latency multi-protocol camera streaming server
en.what: go2rtc is an ultimate camera streaming application supporting dozens of formats and protocols, offering zero-latency streaming input, output, and transcoding. It can run as a standalone app or be integrated into other projects like Home Assistant.
en.content: The repository contains the core Go binary, Docker images, Home Assistant add-on, and frontend resources for the web UI. It supports protocols like RTSP, WebRTC, HLS, and can transcode on-the-fly via FFmpeg.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging the Pion WebRTC library, FFmpeg for transcoding, and supporting various streaming protocols.
en.hot: With zero-latency, multi-protocol support, and easy integration, go2rtc is popular in smart home and security domains, gaining 455 stars this month and reaching 13,870 total.
uses: Smart home users: integrate with Home Assistant for camera stream management.
Developers: embed as a library or use its API to build custom streaming apps.
Security surveillance: scenarios requiring low-latency, multi-protocol camera streams.
Live streaming: push camera feeds to platforms like YouTube and Telegram.

zh.tag: 自托管虚拟浏览器，WebRTC 实时协作
zh.what: Neko 是一个自托管的虚拟浏览器，运行在 Docker 中，通过 WebRTC 技术提供低延迟的浏览器访问。它允许用户在隔离环境中安全、私密地浏览网页和运行应用，并支持多人同时访问，适合团队协作、观看派对和远程演示。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Docker 镜像、配置示例、文档和 Web 客户端，支持自定义浏览器（如 Firefox、Chromium）和多种部署选项。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 WebRTC（如 Pion）、Docker 容器化，前端可能涉及 React 等 Web 技术。
zh.hot: Neko 因其自托管、隐私保护和多人协作能力而受到欢迎，22k+ 的 Star 数反映了其作为虚拟浏览器解决方案的广泛需求。
uses: 开发者：测试 Web 应用或进行远程调试
注重隐私的用户：安全、隔离的浏览环境
团队/组织：共享浏览器访问，协作项目
娱乐：举办观看派对或互动演示

en.tag: Self-hosted virtual browser with WebRTC for real-time collaboration
en.what: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser that runs in Docker and uses WebRTC to provide low-latency browser access. It allows users to securely and privately browse the web and run applications in an isolated environment, with support for multiple concurrent users, making it ideal for team collaboration, watch parties, and remote presentations.
en.content: The repository includes Docker images, configuration examples, documentation, and a web client, with support for custom browsers (e.g., Firefox, Chromium) and various deployment options.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging WebRTC (e.g., Pion) and Docker for containerization; the frontend may involve web technologies like React.
en.hot: Neko's popularity stems from its self-hosting, privacy, and multi-user collaboration features; the 22k+ stars reflect the broad demand for such a virtual browser solution.
uses: Developers: test web apps or remote debugging
Privacy-conscious users: secure, isolated browsing
Teams/organizations: shared browser access for collaboration
Entertainment: hosting watch parties or interactive presentations

zh.tag: 云存储的 rsync：跨平台文件同步与加密
zh.what: Rclone 是一个命令行程序，用于在不同云存储提供商之间同步文件和目录，支持 70+ 存储后端。它提供类似 rsync 的功能，包括加密、缓存、挂载等高级特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心同步引擎、命令行界面、以及针对每个存储后端的适配器。提供完整的文档、安装脚本和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 纯 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 标准库及少量第三方包（如 FUSE 挂载）。跨平台支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 及 NAS 设备。
zh.hot: 作为云存储同步的瑞士军刀，Rclone 已有 58K+ Stars，本周新增 307 Stars，持续受到数据备份和迁移用户的青睐。
uses: 数据备份与恢复 —— 将本地数据同步到云端或跨云备份
云迁移 —— 在不同云服务商之间迁移数据
媒体服务器 —— 挂载云存储为本地磁盘，用于 Plex 等
DevOps 自动化 —— 在 CI/CD 中同步构建产物到云存储

en.tag: rsync for cloud storage: sync and encrypt files across providers
en.what: Rclone is a command-line program to sync files and directories to and from various cloud storage providers, supporting 70+ backends. It offers rsync-like features including encryption, caching, and mounting.
en.content: The repository contains the core sync engine written in Go, a CLI, and adapters for each storage backend. It includes comprehensive documentation, installation scripts, and Docker images.
en.stack: Developed in pure Go, relying on Go standard library and a few third-party packages (e.g., FUSE for mounting). Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, Linux, and NAS devices.
en.hot: As the Swiss Army knife for cloud storage sync, Rclone has 58K+ Stars with 307 new this week, consistently favored by users for data backup and migration.
uses: Data backup and recovery — sync local data to cloud or cross-cloud backup
Cloud migration — migrate data between different cloud providers
Media server — mount cloud storage as local disk for Plex etc.
DevOps automation — sync build artifacts to cloud storage in CI/CD

zh.tag: 无守护进程的容器与 Pod 管理工具
zh.what: Podman 是一个用于管理 OCI 容器和 Pod 的工具，支持镜像、卷和容器组。它基于 libpod 库，提供完整的容器生命周期管理 API，可在 Linux、Mac 和 Windows 上运行（通过虚拟机）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Podman CLI 和 libpod 库的源代码，以及文档、CI 配置、发布脚本等。主要目录有 cmd、libpod、pkg 等，提供完整的构建和测试支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 OCI 运行时（如 runc）、conmon、cgroups 等 Linux 内核特性。支持多种镜像格式和容器运行时接口。
zh.hot: Podman 作为 Docker 的无守护进程替代方案，在开源社区中广受欢迎，月增 335 星，总星数达 3.2 万，反映了对安全、无 root 容器管理的持续需求。
uses: 系统管理员：需要无守护进程、无 root 权限运行容器的场景
开发人员：在本地开发环境中模拟生产容器编排
DevOps 工程师：集成到 CI/CD 流水线，利用 Podman 的 Docker 兼容命令
安全敏感环境：避免守护进程带来的安全风险

en.tag: Daemonless container and pod management tool
en.what: Podman is a tool for managing OCI containers and pods, including images, volumes, and groups of containers. It is based on the libpod library, offering APIs for container lifecycle management, and runs on Linux, Mac, and Windows via a VM.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for the Podman CLI and the libpod library, along with documentation, CI configuration, and release scripts. Key directories include cmd, libpod, and pkg, with full build and test support.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it depends on OCI runtimes (e.g., runc), conmon, cgroups, and other Linux kernel features. It supports multiple image formats and container runtime interfaces.
en.hot: As a daemonless alternative to Docker, Podman is widely popular in the open-source community, gaining 335 stars this month and reaching 32k total, reflecting sustained demand for secure, rootless container management.
uses: System administrators: scenarios requiring daemonless, rootless container execution
Developers: simulating production container orchestration in local dev environments
DevOps engineers: integrating into CI/CD pipelines with Docker-compatible commands
Security-sensitive environments: avoiding risks associated with a daemon

zh.tag: AList 的社区驱动分叉，抵御信任危机
zh.what: OpenList 是 AList 的一个分叉，旨在通过社区驱动和长期治理来维护开源项目的透明性和可持续性。它提供文件列表与分享功能，并强调对信任危机的防御。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、多语言 README（中英日韩等）、贡献指南、行为准则和 AGPL-3.0 许可证。项目以 Go 编写，提供构建状态、版本发布和下载统计等徽章。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Cloudflare 提供的慈善资源用于文档和 API 服务。项目遵循 AGPL-3.0 许可证，并采用 GitHub Actions 进行构建。
zh.hot: 作为 AList 的社区驱动分叉，OpenList 在信任危机背景下迅速获得关注，24k+ 星标表明用户对透明治理和开源可持续性的强烈需求。
uses: 对 AList 原有功能有需求但希望避免信任风险的用户
关注开源项目治理和可持续性的开发者
需要文件列表与分享功能的个人或团队
希望参与社区驱动项目贡献的贡献者

en.tag: Community-driven fork of AList to counter trust crisis
en.what: OpenList is a fork of AList, designed to maintain transparency and sustainability through community-driven governance. It offers file listing and sharing capabilities, with a focus on defending against trust-based attacks.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, multilingual READMEs (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, etc.), contributing guidelines, code of conduct, and AGPL-3.0 license. Written in Go, it includes badges for build status, releases, and downloads.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relying on Cloudflare's charitable resources for documentation and API services. The project follows the AGPL-3.0 license and uses GitHub Actions for builds.
en.hot: As a community-driven fork of AList, OpenList quickly gained traction amid trust concerns, with 24k+ stars reflecting strong demand for transparent governance and open-source sustainability.
uses: Users needing AList features but wary of trust issues
Developers interested in open-source governance and sustainability
Individuals or teams requiring file listing and sharing
Contributors seeking community-driven projects to join

zh.tag: Kubernetes 的包管理器，像 apt/yum 一样管理应用
zh.what: Helm 是用于管理 Kubernetes 应用程序的工具，通过 Charts 打包预配置的 Kubernetes 资源。它简化了 Kubernetes 应用的安装、升级和管理，类似于 Linux 中的包管理器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Helm 的源代码、文档、测试和示例 Charts。核心是 Go 编写的 CLI 工具，支持模板渲染、发布管理和仓库交互。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API 和模板引擎。支持多种安装方式，包括二进制、Homebrew、Chocolatey 等。
zh.hot: 作为 Kubernetes 生态的标配工具，拥有 3 万+ Star，本月新增 189，持续活跃。v4 稳定版发布，v3 维护至 2026 年，社区关注度高。
uses: Kubernetes 开发者：快速打包和部署应用
DevOps 工程师：管理复杂应用的生命周期
平台团队：标准化应用交付和配置管理

en.tag: The Kubernetes package manager, like apt/yum for K8s apps
en.what: Helm is a tool for managing Kubernetes applications by packaging pre-configured resources as Charts. It streamlines installing, upgrading, and managing K8s apps, akin to a package manager for Kubernetes.
en.content: The repo contains Helm's source code, docs, tests, and example charts. Core is a Go CLI for templating, release management, and repo interactions.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes API and templating. Supports multiple installation methods: binaries, Homebrew, Chocolatey, etc.
en.hot: As a standard tool in the K8s ecosystem, it has 30k+ stars, +189 this month, and remains active. v4 stable release and v3 support until 2026 keep community interest high.
uses: K8s developers: quickly package and deploy apps
DevOps engineers: manage complex app lifecycles
Platform teams: standardize app delivery and config management

zh.tag: 实时分析型列式数据库管理系统
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为实时生成分析数据报告而设计。它能够对海量数据进行极速查询，支持 SQL 接口，适用于在线分析处理（OLAP）场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ClickHouse 数据库的完整源代码、构建脚本、测试套件以及文档。提供 Linux、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的安装方式，并有丰富的社区资源如教程、文档、视频和 Slack 群组。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 LLVM、libcxx、zlib-ng 等底层库，支持多种编译器和平台。
zh.hot: ClickHouse 因其极致的查询性能和实时分析能力而广受欢迎，拥有 48k+ Stars，本周新增 159 Stars，在 C++ 周榜排名第 15。
uses: 数据工程师 —— 构建实时 OLAP 数据管道和仪表盘
DevOps/SRE —— 监控和可观测性数据存储与查询
数据分析师 —— 对海量数据进行交互式探索分析
产品经理 —— 了解用户行为分析场景下的技术选型

en.tag: Real-time analytics column-oriented database management system
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system designed for real-time generation of analytical data reports. It enables blazing-fast queries on massive datasets, supports SQL interface, and is suitable for online analytical processing (OLAP) scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, test suites, and documentation for the ClickHouse database. It provides installation methods for Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, and offers rich community resources such as tutorials, documentation, videos, and Slack groups.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies on LLVM, libcxx, zlib-ng, and other low-level libraries, supporting multiple compilers and platforms.
en.hot: ClickHouse is widely popular for its extreme query performance and real-time analytics capabilities, with over 48k Stars and 159 new stars this week, ranking 15th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Data engineers — building real-time OLAP data pipelines and dashboards
DevOps/SRE — storing and querying monitoring and observability data
Data analysts — interactive exploration and analysis of massive datasets
Product managers — understanding technical choices for user behavior analytics

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinUI 的源代码、文档、示例和 WinUI 3 Gallery 交互式演示，涵盖控件库、样式、工具和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，基于 Windows App SDK，支持 C#/.NET 和 C++ 开发，面向 x86、x64 和 ARM 架构。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方 UI 框架，WinUI 是 Windows 应用开发的核心，本月新增 140 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 5，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Windows 桌面应用开发者，希望使用现代 Fluent Design 构建应用
需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者
学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: Windows desktop app developers wanting modern Fluent Design
Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个广受欢迎的头文件优先 JSON 库，为 C++ 开发者提供直观、STL 风格的 API 来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它支持将 JSON 与 C++ 数据结构无缝互转，大幅降低了现代 C++ 项目中处理 JSON 的复杂度。
zh.content: 仓库以单头文件（json.hpp）为核心分发形态，同时包含完整的测试套件、基准测试、文档网站源码及多包管理器（Conan、vcpkg 等）支持配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11/14/17 标准库实现，无需外部依赖，仅依赖 STL 容器和模板元编程，支持通过 CMake 构建测试与示例。
zh.hot: 凭借超 5 万 Star 和今日新增 17 Star 登上 C++ 日榜第 10，它已成为 C++ 生态的事实标准 JSON 库。其“像 STL 一样直观”的 API 设计和单头文件即用的便捷性持续吸引开发者。
uses: C++ 后端/客户端开发者需要轻量、高性能 JSON 解析与序列化
嵌入式与游戏项目团队希望以单头文件引入依赖，简化构建流程
基础设施开发者在微服务、配置系统或协议网关中进行结构化数据交换

en.tag: Modern C++ JSON parsing and serialization library
en.what: A widely-adopted, header-only JSON library for C++ offering an intuitive, STL-like API to parse, generate, and manipulate JSON. It enables seamless mapping between JSON and C++ data structures, dramatically simplifying JSON handling in modern C++ projects.
en.content: The repository centers around a single-header distribution (json.hpp), complemented by comprehensive tests, benchmarks, documentation site sources, and package manager integrations like Conan and vcpkg.
en.stack: Built on C++11/14/17 with zero external dependencies, relying solely on STL containers and template metaprogramming; tests and examples are built via CMake.
en.hot: With over 50k stars and 17 new stars today, ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list, it has become the de facto standard JSON library in the C++ ecosystem. Its STL-intuitive API design and single-header convenience continue to attract developers.
uses: C++ backend and client developers needing lightweight, high-performance JSON parsing and serialization
Embedded and game teams looking to simplify builds with a single-header dependency
Infrastructure developers performing structured data exchange in microservices, config systems, or protocol gateways

zh.tag: 开源自动驾驶仪系统，支持多旋翼、固定翼、地面车辆与水下航行器
zh.what: ArduPilot 是一个功能丰富的开源自动驾驶仪系统，支持多种无人平台，包括飞机、直升机、多旋翼、地面车辆和水下航行器。它提供完整的飞行控制和任务规划功能，广泛应用于无人机、机器人研究和教育领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个飞行器固件（ArduPlane、ArduCopter、ArduRover、ArduSub）以及相关的库和工具，支持多种硬件平台，如Pixhawk系列。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ChibiOS/RTOS 等实时操作系统，并利用 MAVLink 协议进行通信。
zh.hot: 作为最成熟的开源自动驾驶仪之一，拥有庞大的社区和丰富的文档，持续活跃开发，今日新增 6 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 19 名。
uses: 无人机爱好者和开发者：用于构建和定制自己的飞行器
科研机构与高校：用于无人机、机器人相关研究与教学
商业应用：用于农业、测绘、物流等行业的无人机解决方案

en.tag: Open-source autopilot system supporting multirotor, fixed-wing, ground vehicles, and underwater vehicles
en.what: ArduPilot is a feature-rich open-source autopilot system supporting various unmanned platforms including planes, helicopters, multirotors, ground vehicles, and underwater vehicles. It provides full flight control and mission planning capabilities, widely used in drone, robotics research, and education.
en.content: The repository contains multiple vehicle firmware (ArduPlane, ArduCopter, ArduRover, ArduSub) along with associated libraries and tools, supporting various hardware platforms such as Pixhawk series.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on real-time operating systems like ChibiOS/RTOS, and uses the MAVLink protocol for communication.
en.hot: As one of the most mature open-source autopilots, it has a large community and extensive documentation, with continuous active development. It gained 6 stars today, ranking 19th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Drone enthusiasts and developers: to build and customize their own vehicles
Research institutions and universities: for research and teaching in drones and robotics
Commercial applications: for drone solutions in agriculture, surveying, logistics, etc.

zh.tag: 自建 VPN 的开源客户端，支持多协议与混淆
zh.what: Amnezia VPN 是一个开源 VPN 客户端，允许用户在自己的服务器上轻松部署 VPN 服务。它支持多种经典协议（如 OpenVPN、WireGuard、IKEv2）以及带流量混淆的协议（如 Cloak、Shadowsocks、AmneziaWG、XRay），并提供分流功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端和移动端的客户端代码，提供安装脚本、文档和界面资源。主要目录包括客户端应用、协议实现、以及用于服务器部署的 Docker 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，跨平台支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS。依赖 Qt 框架、OpenSSL、以及各 VPN 协议库（如 WireGuard、OpenVPN）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1606 星，总星数达 1.4 万+，因其自建 VPN 的易用性和强大的混淆功能而受到关注，尤其适合网络受限地区的用户。
uses: 需要自建 VPN 的个人用户，希望快速部署并连接自己的服务器。
在严格网络环境下需要绕过封锁的用户，利用混淆协议隐藏流量特征。
开发者和技术爱好者，希望定制或贡献 VPN 客户端代码。
企业或组织需要内部安全远程访问，可基于此客户端搭建专属 VPN。

en.tag: Open-source VPN client for self-hosted servers with multi-protocol & obfuscation
en.what: Amnezia VPN is an open-source VPN client that lets users easily deploy VPN servers on their own machines. It supports classic protocols like OpenVPN, WireGuard, IKEv2, and obfuscated protocols such as Cloak, Shadowsocks, AmneziaWG, and XRay, plus split tunneling.
en.content: The repo contains client code for desktop and mobile, with installation scripts, docs, and UI assets. Key directories include client apps, protocol implementations, and Docker configs for server deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, cross-platform for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Uses Qt framework, OpenSSL, and VPN protocol libraries like WireGuard and OpenVPN.
en.hot: Gained 1,606 stars this month, reaching 14k+ total, due to its ease of self-hosting VPN and robust obfuscation features, appealing to users in restricted regions.
uses: Individuals wanting to self-host VPN and quickly deploy on their own servers.
Users in censored networks needing to bypass blocks with obfuscation protocols.
Developers and tinkerers looking to customize or contribute to VPN client code.
Organizations requiring secure remote access, can build custom VPN on this client.

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: 以KVCache为中心的LLM服务分离式架构
zh.what: Mooncake是Moonshot AI为Kimi大模型服务打造的推理平台，采用以KVCache为中心的分离式架构，将预填充和解码阶段分离，并通过KVCache池化实现高效复用。该架构在真实负载下显著提升吞吐量和响应速度，降低推理成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心的Mooncake Transfer Engine（支持多种硬件如CUDA、NPU、MUSA），以及论文、幻灯片、测试轨迹和文档。提供Python包和Docker镜像，便于部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++实现高性能传输引擎，提供Python绑定（PyPI包），依赖CUDA等硬件加速，支持RDMA和EFA网络。
zh.hot: 作为Kimi背后的推理平台，Mooncake展示了真实生产环境的先进架构，吸引了大量关注。尽管今日新增star不多，但总star数已超6千，在C++日榜排名靠前，说明其技术影响力持续发酵。
uses: LLM推理服务提供商：希望借鉴生产级分离式架构来优化自身推理系统。
系统研究者：研究KVCache管理、预填充/解码分离等前沿技术。
高性能计算开发者：对RDMA、GPU传输优化感兴趣的工程师。
Moonshot AI生态用户：想了解Kimi底层技术或部署类似平台。

en.tag: KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture for LLM serving
en.what: Mooncake is the serving platform for Kimi, a leading LLM service by Moonshot AI. It uses a KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that separates prefill and decode phases, pooling KVCache for efficient reuse. Under real workloads, it boosts throughput and reduces latency and cost.
en.content: The repo contains the core Mooncake Transfer Engine (supporting CUDA, NPU, MUSA, etc.), along with the paper, slides, traces, and documentation. It offers Python packages and Docker images for easy deployment.
en.stack: Primarily C++ for the high-performance transfer engine, with Python bindings (PyPI packages). It relies on CUDA and other hardware acceleration, supporting RDMA and EFA networks.
en.hot: As the serving platform behind Kimi, Mooncake showcases a production-grade advanced architecture, drawing significant attention. Despite modest daily stars, its total stars exceed 6k and it ranks high on the C++ daily list, indicating sustained technical influence.
uses: LLM serving providers: to adopt a production-grade disaggregated architecture for their inference systems.
Systems researchers: to study KVCache management and prefill/decode separation.
HPC developers: interested in RDMA and GPU transfer optimizations.
Moonshot AI ecosystem users: to understand Kimi's underlying tech or deploy similar platforms.

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及构建和测试脚本。它提供了预编译的二进制文件，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript，依赖 Chromium 和 Node.js。通过 npm 安装，支持多种平台架构。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 12 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的桌面应用框架之一。今日新增 8 颗星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 开发者：希望用 Web 技术快速构建跨平台桌面应用的开发者
团队：需要为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供一致体验的产品团队
学习者：想学习桌面应用开发或了解 Chromium 和 Node.js 集成的学习者

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
uses: Developers: those who want to quickly build cross-platform desktop apps using web technologies
Teams: product teams needing consistent experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Learners: those interested in desktop app development or the integration of Chromium and Node.js

zh.tag: 低延迟语音 AI 工具包，构建实时语音代理
zh.what: Moonshine Voice 是一个开源 AI 工具包，用于构建实时语音代理和界面。它提供语音转文本、意图识别和文本转语音功能，所有处理均在设备端完成，确保低延迟和隐私保护。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、预训练模型、跨平台示例应用（iOS、Android、macOS、Windows、Raspberry Pi 等）以及微控制器部署支持。提供高级 API 用于转录、TTS、语音克隆、说话人识别和对话代理。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++，支持 Python、iOS、Android、macOS、Linux、Windows 等多平台。模型基于 PyTorch 训练，推理使用 ONNX Runtime 或自定义引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借极低延迟（优于 Whisper）和完全本地运行的特点，吸引了近万 Star，今日新增 282，适合隐私敏感和实时场景。
uses: 语音助手开发者 —— 快速集成低延迟 STT/TTS 到应用中
边缘设备开发者 —— 在 Raspberry Pi、微控制器上部署语音 AI
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、金融等需要本地处理的语音应用
多语言语音应用 —— 支持中英西日韩等多语种 STT 和 TTS

en.tag: Low-latency speech AI toolkit for building real-time voice agents
en.what: Moonshine Voice is an open-source AI toolkit for building real-time voice agents and interfaces. It offers speech-to-text, intent recognition, and text-to-speech, all running on-device for low latency and privacy.
en.content: The repo includes the core library, pre-trained models, cross-platform example apps (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Raspberry Pi, etc.), and microcontroller deployment support. High-level APIs for transcription, TTS, voice cloning, speaker diarization, and conversational agents.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with bindings for Python, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, Windows. Models trained with PyTorch, inference via ONNX Runtime or custom engine.
en.hot: With ultra-low latency (outperforming Whisper) and fully on-device processing, it has gained nearly 10K stars (+282 today), appealing to privacy-conscious and real-time applications.
uses: Voice assistant developers — integrate low-latency STT/TTS into apps
Edge device developers — deploy voice AI on Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers
Privacy-sensitive scenarios — medical, finance requiring on-device processing
Multilingual voice apps — STT/TTS supporting English, Chinese, Spanish, Japanese, etc.

zh.tag: ESP32 万能协议黑客工具，网页 CLI 控制
zh.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate 是一款开源固件，能将 ESP32 设备变成多协议开发与分析工具，灵感来自传奇的 Bus Pirate。它支持通过串口终端或网页 CLI 嗅探、发送、脚本化并交互各种数字协议（如 I2C、UART、1-Wire、SPI 等），还能与蓝牙、Wi-Fi、Sub-GHz 和 RFID 等无线电协议通信。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、文档、脚本和示例，以及一个集中式网站，提供安装、网页工具、硬件指南、配方和维基。固件支持多种模式，如 HiZ、I2C、SPI、UART、1-Wire、蓝牙、Wi-Fi、JTAG 等。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 编写，面向 ESP32 平台，利用其硬件外设和无线功能。依赖 Arduino 框架或 ESP-IDF，并通过 WebSocket 提供网页 CLI。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本月新增约 1188 颗星，总星数达 5478，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其多功能性和易用性吸引了硬件黑客和嵌入式开发者。
uses: 硬件黑客和安全研究人员，用于协议嗅探、逆向工程和设备调试。
嵌入式开发者和爱好者，用于快速原型设计和与各种传感器/芯片交互。
教育场景，用于学习数字协议和无线电通信。
DIY 项目，作为便携式多协议工具。

en.tag: ESP32 multi-protocol hacking tool with web CLI
en.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate is open-source firmware that turns your ESP32 device into a multi-protocol development and analysis tool, inspired by the legendary Bus Pirate. It supports sniffing, sending, scripting, and interacting with various digital protocols (I2C, UART, 1-Wire, SPI, etc.) via a serial terminal or web-based CLI, and also communicates with radio protocols like Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Sub-GHz, and RFID.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, documentation, scripts, and examples, along with a central website offering installation, web tools, hardware guides, recipes, and a wiki. The firmware supports numerous modes like HiZ, I2C, SPI, UART, 1-Wire, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, JTAG, and more.
en.stack: Written in C++ for the ESP32 platform, leveraging its hardware peripherals and wireless capabilities. It relies on the Arduino framework or ESP-IDF and provides a web CLI via WebSocket.
en.hot: The project has gained rapid popularity on GitHub, adding ~1,188 stars this month to reach 5,478 total, ranking #22 on the C++ monthly trending list. Its versatility and ease of use attract hardware hackers and embedded developers.
uses: Hardware hackers and security researchers for protocol sniffing, reverse engineering, and device debugging.
Embedded developers and hobbyists for rapid prototyping and interacting with various sensors/chips.
Educational settings for learning digital protocols and radio communications.
DIY projects as a portable multi-protocol tool.

zh.tag: 跨平台 Android 实时投屏与控制工具
zh.what: QtScrcpy 是一款通过 USB 或网络显示和控制 Android 设备的软件，无需 root 权限。它支持 GNU/Linux、Windows 和 macOS 三大平台，注重轻量、高性能、低延迟和非侵入性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 QtScrcpy 源代码、跨平台构建配置（Windows/macOS/Ubuntu）、截图、文档（如按键映射脚本规则），以及作者开发的更专业的投屏软件 QuickMirror 的推广信息。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架开发，依赖 adb 进行设备通信，支持 GPU 视频渲染（在 QuickMirror 中提及）。
zh.hot: 作为 scrcpy 的 Qt 图形化版本，它提供了更友好的界面和按键映射功能，方便游戏玩家和开发者使用。今日新增 174 星，总星数超 3.1 万，位列 C++ 日榜第三，持续受到关注。
uses: 安卓开发者：无需 root 即可调试和演示应用，实时查看设备屏幕。
游戏玩家：通过按键映射脚本，用键盘鼠标玩手机游戏（如 PUBG Mobile）。
技术支持：远程协助或批量管理多台 Android 设备（结合 QuickMirror 可管理 500+ 台）。

en.tag: Cross-platform Android real-time display and control tool
en.what: QtScrcpy is a software that displays and controls Android devices via USB or over the network, requiring no root privileges. It supports GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS, focusing on lightness, performance, low latency, and non-intrusiveness.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of QtScrcpy, cross-platform build configurations (Windows/macOS/Ubuntu), screenshots, documentation (e.g., key mapping script rules), and promotional info for the author's more professional screen casting software QuickMirror.
en.stack: Developed primarily with C++ and Qt framework, relies on adb for device communication, and supports GPU video rendering (mentioned in QuickMirror).
en.hot: As a Qt graphical version of scrcpy, it offers a friendlier UI and key mapping features, appealing to gamers and developers. With 174 stars today and over 31k total, it ranks #3 on the C++ daily trending list, maintaining steady popularity.
uses: Android developers: debug and demo apps without root, view device screen in real time.
Gamers: play mobile games (e.g., PUBG Mobile) with keyboard and mouse via key mapping scripts.
Tech support: remote assistance or batch management of multiple Android devices (with QuickMirror, manage 500+ devices).

zh.tag: 跨平台 Telegram 客户端开发库
zh.what: TDLib 是一个用于构建 Telegram 客户端的跨平台库，支持几乎所有编程语言。它封装了网络、加密和本地存储等复杂细节，提供简单易用的 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 库、Java 和 .NET 绑定、JSON 接口、示例代码、构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17，依赖 OpenSSL 和 zlib，支持 CMake 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Telegram 官方推荐的客户端开发库，star 数已超 9000，本周新增 32，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Telegram 客户端开发者，需要跨平台支持
需要高性能、可靠消息处理的机器人开发者
希望在多种语言中集成 Telegram 功能的团队

en.tag: Cross-platform library for building Telegram clients
en.what: TDLib is a cross-platform library for building Telegram clients, usable from almost any programming language. It handles network, encryption, and local storage, offering a simple API.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ library, Java and .NET bindings, JSON interface, examples, build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Built on C++17, depends on OpenSSL and zlib, supports CMake.
en.hot: As the official library for Telegram clients, it has over 9000 stars, with 32 new this week, consistently attracting developers.
uses: Developers building Telegram clients needing cross-platform support
Bot developers requiring high-performance and reliable messaging
Teams integrating Telegram features in multiple languages

zh.tag: 微软官方 Windows 终端与命令行宿主开源仓库
zh.what: 这是微软官方维护的 Windows Terminal 和 Windows 控制台主机的源代码仓库。它包含了 Windows Terminal、Windows Terminal Preview 以及 conhost.exe 的实现，并共享组件和示例项目。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Windows Terminal 和 Windows 控制台主机的完整源代码，以及 ColorTool 等工具和展示如何调用控制台 API 的示例项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Windows 平台 API，构建系统支持 PowerShell 和 Cmd。
zh.hot: 作为 Windows 官方终端工具的源码仓库，长期保持高关注度，star 数已超 10 万，今日新增 21 个，位列 C++ 日榜第 23 名。
uses: Windows 用户：获取最新版 Windows Terminal 或参与开发
开发者：学习微软大型 C++ 项目架构与 Windows 控制台实现
贡献者：提交代码、修复问题或改进终端功能

en.tag: Microsoft's official open-source repo for Windows Terminal and console host
en.what: This is Microsoft's official source repository for Windows Terminal and the Windows console host. It contains the implementation of Windows Terminal, Windows Terminal Preview, and conhost.exe, along with shared components and sample projects.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code for Windows Terminal and the Windows console host, along with tools like ColorTool and sample projects demonstrating how to consume the Windows Console APIs.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relies on Windows platform APIs, and supports building via PowerShell and Cmd.
en.hot: As the source repo for Windows' official terminal, it maintains high attention with over 100k stars, gaining 21 today and ranking #23 on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Windows users: get the latest Windows Terminal or contribute to development
Developers: learn Microsoft's large-scale C++ architecture and Windows console implementation
Contributors: submit code, fix issues, or improve terminal features

zh.tag: 开源离网 LoRa 网格通信设备固件
zh.what: Meshtastic 是一个开源项目，旨在通过 LoRa 技术实现无需互联网或蜂窝网络的远距离、低功耗通信。该固件支持多种硬件平台，提供短信、位置共享和遥测功能，适用于户外探险、应急准备和远程作业。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源代码、构建说明、刷机指南以及社区贡献的文档。支持 ESP32、nRF52、RP2040/RP2350 和 Linux 设备。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 PlatformIO 和 Arduino 框架，依赖 LoRa 库和多种硬件抽象层。
zh.hot: 本月新增 217 星，总星数达 8141，位列 GitHub 趋势榜 C++ 第 20 名。其去中心化、离网通信的特性在自然灾害或网络中断时极具价值，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 户外爱好者：在无信号区域进行团队通信和位置共享
应急响应人员：在灾害导致网络中断时保持联络
技术爱好者：学习 LoRa 和网状网络开发，参与开源贡献

en.tag: Open-source firmware for off-grid LoRa mesh communication devices
en.what: Meshtastic is an open-source project enabling long-range, low-power communication without internet or cellular via LoRa. This firmware supports multiple hardware platforms, offering text messaging, location sharing, and telemetry over a decentralized mesh network, ideal for outdoor adventures, emergency preparedness, and remote operations.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, build instructions, flashing guides, and community-contributed documentation. It supports ESP32, nRF52, RP2040/RP2350, and Linux devices.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, built on PlatformIO and Arduino frameworks, with dependencies on LoRa libraries and various hardware abstraction layers.
en.hot: Gained 217 stars this month, reaching 8,141 total, ranking #20 on GitHub Trending for C++. Its decentralized, off-grid communication capability is highly valuable during disasters or network outages, attracting significant attention.
uses: Outdoor enthusiasts: team communication and location sharing in no-signal areas
Emergency responders: staying connected when networks fail during disasters
Tech hobbyists: learning LoRa and mesh networking development, contributing to open source

zh.tag: 开源免费的三维参数化建模软件
zh.what: FreeCAD 是一款免费开源的跨平台三维参数化建模软件，主要用于设计真实物体。它支持参数化建模，允许用户通过修改历史参数来轻松调整设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 FreeCAD 的完整源代码，涵盖核心建模模块、图形界面、Python API 以及文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖 OpenCASCADE 几何内核、Coin3D 3D 场景库、Qt 图形界面，并提供 Python API。
zh.hot: FreeCAD 是开源 CAD 领域的明星项目，拥有超过 3.2 万 star，持续活跃，今日新增 23 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 15 名。
uses: 产品设计师和机械工程师，用于参数化建模和设计验证。
建筑师和建筑爱好者，用于建筑信息建模和设计。
学生和教师，用于学习 CAD 和三维建模。
程序员和开发者，利用 Python API 进行二次开发和自动化。

en.tag: Open-source parametric 3D modeler for real-life objects
en.what: FreeCAD is a free and open-source cross-platform parametric 3D modeler primarily for designing real-life objects. It supports parametric modeling, allowing users to easily modify designs by changing parameters in the model history.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of FreeCAD, including core modeling modules, GUI, Python API, and documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Developed in C++, relies on OpenCASCADE geometry kernel, Coin3D 3D scene library, Qt GUI, and offers a Python API.
en.hot: FreeCAD is a star project in the open-source CAD domain with over 32k stars, consistently active, gaining 23 stars today and ranking 15th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Product designers and mechanical engineers for parametric modeling and design validation.
Architects and architecture enthusiasts for BIM and design.
Students and teachers for learning CAD and 3D modeling.
Programmers and developers for customization and automation via Python API.

zh.tag: 跨平台 2D/3D 开源游戏引擎
zh.what: Godot 是一款功能丰富的跨平台游戏引擎，支持从统一界面创建 2D 和 3D 游戏。它提供了一套全面的常用工具，让用户专注于游戏开发，无需重复造轮子。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Godot 引擎的完整源代码、编辑器、导出模板以及官方文档和演示示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenGL/Vulkan 等图形 API，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 及 Web 平台。
zh.hot: 作为完全免费开源、无版税的游戏引擎，Godot 社区活跃，本月新增近 2000 星，持续吸引独立开发者和小型团队。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速制作 2D/3D 游戏并一键导出到多平台
游戏教育 —— 学习游戏开发原理，无需付费或授权
小型工作室 —— 低成本开发商业游戏，保留全部知识产权

en.tag: Cross-platform 2D and 3D open-source game engine
en.what: Godot Engine is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, allowing users to focus on making games without reinventing the wheel.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, editor, export templates, official documentation, and demo projects for the Godot Engine.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on graphics APIs like OpenGL/Vulkan, and supports Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
en.hot: As a completely free and open-source game engine with no royalties, Godot has an active community, gaining nearly 2000 stars this month, continuously attracting indie developers and small teams.
uses: Indie game developers — quickly create 2D/3D games and export to multiple platforms with one click
Game education — learn game development principles without licensing fees
Small studios — develop commercial games at low cost while retaining full IP

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码，包括核心引擎、CLI 客户端、Python/R/Java/Wasm 等客户端绑定，以及文档和测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持 Python、R、Java、Wasm 等客户端，并与 pandas、dplyr 等深度集成。
zh.hot: DuckDB 因其嵌入式分析数据库的独特定位而广受欢迎，star 数已超 4 万，本月新增 908，在 C++ 月榜中位列第 15。
uses: 数据科学家：在本地快速分析大型 CSV/Parquet 文件，无需部署数据库服务器
数据分析师：使用 SQL 直接查询数据文件，简化工作流程
应用开发者：将 DuckDB 嵌入应用中，提供分析功能，无需外部数据库

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database for fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of DuckDB, including the core engine, CLI client, client bindings for Python/R/Java/Wasm, as well as documentation and tests.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, supports clients for Python, R, Java, Wasm, and integrates deeply with pandas and dplyr.
en.hot: DuckDB is popular for its unique positioning as an embedded analytical database, with over 40k stars and 908 added this month, ranking 15th in the C++ monthly list.
uses: Data scientists: quickly analyze large CSV/Parquet files locally without deploying a database server
Data analysts: use SQL to directly query data files, simplifying workflow
Application developers: embed DuckDB in applications to provide analytical capabilities without an external database

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
